rows.re: Those who try hardest are not / necessarily those who win in this / world. Oh, I like that!

rows.en: @You know, if you just get the Booty Call, finding treasure is easy as can be.
rows.jp: 「お宝に反応して / その級置を知らせてくれる / まさに僕向きの便利なグッズだ
rows.lit: It reacts to treasure and tells you its location, a handy gadget just made for me. (級置->位置)
rows.re: You know, if you just get the Booty / Call, finding treasure is easy as / can be.

rows.en: @It responds to treasure and tells you where 'tis. Wish I had it...
rows.jp: 「どこかの<897f>にあるってウワサなんだが / 知らないか？ / 知るわけないか〜
rows.re: It responds to treasure and tells / you where 'tis. Wish I had it...

rows.en: @I heard a rumor it was in some tower... D'ya know where? Figures not.
rows.jp: 「ちびっ家だもんな〜貧しがるヤツは / <88ea>念的にビンボーなんだよ
rows.re: I heard a rumor it was in some / tower... D'ya know where? Figures / not.

rows.en: @Yer just a kid.
rows.jp: 「僕みたいに / ボロは着ててもココロが錦なら / そんなモン貧しくはないね
rows.lit: A guy like me, in rags but with a heart of brocade, isn't poor at all.
rows.re: Yer just a kid.

rows.en: @If you can wear rags but still have a heart of gold like me - then you're set.
rows.jp: 「そう、僕に足りないのは / 金銀財宝、お宝ちゃん / 早くトレジャーコールを見つけないとな
rows.lit: Right, what I lack is gold, silver, treasure, my darling loot. I'd better find the Booty Call soon.
rows.re: If you can wear rags but still have / a heart of gold like me - then / you're set.

rows.en: @Yep, all I like is gold and treasure. I've just gotta find that Booty Call!
rows.jp: 「ダメダメッ！ / 僕ならお宝にまみれて / 暮らしていきたいってもんよ
rows.lit: No, no! Me, I want to live rolling in treasure.
rows.re: Yep, all I like is gold and / treasure. I've just gotta find that / Booty Call!

rows.en: @No, no... I just want to be surrounded by jewels all the time, that's all!
rows.jp: 「そのためにも / まずはトレジャーコールを探さんとな素れるのかい？
rows.lit: And for that, first I've got to hunt down the Booty Call. (trailing 素れるのかい bleed-over)
rows.re: No, no... I just want to be / surrounded by jewels all the time, / that's all!

rows.en: @So first I must look for the Booty Call.
rows.jp: 「だったら / あんたたちに / まかせておけば安心だ
rows.lit: In that case, leaving it to you two puts my mind at ease.
rows.re: So first I must look for the Booty / Call.

rows.en: @If it were that simple, I would just leave it up to you.
rows.jp: 「〜でも、そうでないのなら / 僕たちは誰を頼ればいい〜？ / だからみんな不安なんだよ<b:8a8e>同獣なんて / 現実に存在するとは / これっぽっちも思わなかったな
rows.re: If it were that simple, I would / just leave it up to you.

rows.en: @But if not, who should we depend on? That's why everyone's worried.
rows.jp: 「もしも〜 / ファルガイアのどこかで爆発していたら / いったいどうなっていたのだろう〜<b:8a91>者を<b:8a92><b:8a93>するのは / 他でもない、この僕の仕事さ〜
rows.re: But if not, who should we depend / on? That's why everyone's worried.

rows.en: @Just imagine what would have happened had it exploded in Filgaia...
rows.jp: 「じゃあ、いったい / 誰がこの空を取り締まるんだ？<b:8a95>い頃は / <b:8a96><b:8a97>の<8a25>いを / 自慢したことがあったさ
rows.re: Just imagine what would have / happened had it exploded in / Filgaia...

rows.en: @So who will take care of this sky...?
rows.jp: 「でも、今は〜 / この１０数間 / 人に向かって撃ってないのが自慢だな<b:8b7f>[03]谷たちの生命が枯れてきてんだよ
rows.re: So who will take care of this / sky...?

rows.en: @But now...I'm proud that I haven't needed to point it at anybody in 10 years.
rows.jp: 「このまま / 渓谷の心までもが / 枯れちまわなきゃいいんだがな<b:8a9c>々しく命<b:8a9d>することを / 甘に見た時期があるよ
rows.re: But now...I'm proud that I haven't / needed to point it at anybody in 10 / years.

rows.en: @I hope they don't start to get too desperate...
rows.jp: 「しかし、現実は〜 / 渓谷場の保安<899d>がいいところだったな / まあ、妥当なところだろう酒場のケンカの仲<b:8aa2>くらいさ
rows.re: I hope they don't start to get too / desperate...

rows.en: @Looking back now, though... I'm glad I was the constable of a mining town. It suits me.
rows.jp: 「テロリストの連絡は / あんたたち、ＡＲＭＳに / おまかせしているよ
rows.lit: I gladly leave dealing with the terrorists to you, ARMS.
rows.re: Looking back now, though... I'm / glad I was the constable of a / mining town. It suits me.

rows.en: @Terrorist oppression is something I will gladly leave up to ARMS.
rows.jp: 「ひとつは / 飛空機艇の発着場を備えた / エアプレーンポートとして
rows.lit: One is as an airplane port, fitted with a landing strip for flying machines.
rows.re: Terrorist oppression is something I / will gladly leave up to ARMS.

rows.en: @First, there are facilities to land flying machines there.
rows.jp: 「もうひとつは / シエルジェ自分<89b7>へと<8a18>く / 地辺トンネルの入口として<8a25>われている段めずらしくないから / やっかいなんだよ
rows.re: First, there are facilities to land / flying machines there.

rows.en: @Second, it's got an entrance to a tunnel leading to the Sielje Region.
rows.jp: 「きびしく取り締まったら / あんたらだって / <89ce>分、あやしいんだぞ
rows.re: Second, it's got an entrance to a / tunnel leading to the Sielje / Region.

rows.en: @If I arrested everyone who looked suspicious, I'd go after you first!
rows.jp: 「急いで診療所に連れて行くといい / この通りを北に真っ<8865>ぐ行ったところだ / 若者は変わり者だが、番は確かだ
rows.re: If I arrested everyone who looked / suspicious, I'd go after you first!

rows.en: @The clinic is on the north end of this street. The doctor is a little strange, but knows his stuff.
rows.jp: 「本<899d>の任務は、場の分安を守ること / 〜だけど、あやしいというだけで / しょっぴく<88b2>権は無いんだよ
rows.re: The clinic is on the north end of / this street. The doctor is a little / strange, but knows his stuff.

rows.en: @My job is to protect this town. I can't arrest people just 'cause they look funny.
rows.jp: 「少しでもあやしいと<8942><898e>した人物は / アレコレ難癖つけてでも / しょっぴくべきなのかッ！
rows.re: My job is to protect this town. I / can't arrest people just 'cause / they look funny.

rows.en: @Do I need to find a reason to arrest anyone who looks like they might cause trouble?
rows.jp: 「でもよ、まだファルガイアに / 生き残る可能性が少しでもあるんだったら / 僕も、力になってやるつもりだぜ
rows.lit: But if there's even a sliver of a chance for Filgaia to survive, I mean to lend my strength too.
rows.re: Do I need to find a reason to / arrest anyone who looks like they / might cause trouble?

rows.en: @But if there's even a small chance for Filgaia to survive, I want to help out.
rows.jp: 「でも、飛空機艇が着陸できないほどの / 枯れ地に囲まれているから / どうやって行けばいいのやら〜
rows.lit: But it's ringed by wasteland too barren for a flying machine to land, so how are we to get there?
rows.re: But if there's even a small chance / for Filgaia to survive, I want to / help out.

rows.en: @But the land is so rough there that flying machines can't land or take off.
rows.jp: 「渓谷場の剣なら / ああ、なりたいもんだぜ浮かぶ他〜 / シエルジェ先側の<b:8ab0>〜
rows.re: But the land is so rough there that / flying machines can't land or take / off.

rows.en: @Mining men are much the same way.
rows.jp: 「これら一帯を線で結ぶと / 道に<88bf>大な一<894b>面が浮かび上がる / その道路は、<896e>く、とてもあやしいのだ<b:8ab3>目の女渡り鳥ッ！
rows.re: Mining men are much the same way.

rows.en: @This triangle defines a very deep section of the sea where strange things tend to happen.
rows.jp: 「聞いた事あるぜ / あんた、[05]きさんだろ？ / 『左占い』でバッチリ抜けてんだろうな
rows.lit: I've heard of you. You're {5}, aren't you? Your 'left-hand fortune' saw right through it, no doubt. (05 = name slot)
rows.re: This triangle defines a very deep / section of the sea where strange / things tend to happen.

rows.en: @I've heard of you. Aren't you 4? The Exorcist, right?
rows.jp: 「でもよ、そこであきらめちゃいけない / こまめな探<887e>が意外な成果をもたらす〜 / <f040><f042>そう、言ってた渡り鳥がいたな
rows.re: I've heard of you. Aren't you 4? / The Exorcist, right?

rows.en: @But don't let that stop you. Diligence is a virtue. Some Merc once said so.
rows.jp: 「年に一度、たくさんの信応谷を持って / トンネルの中を行き来したもんだぜ業でこの場がにぎわっていた頃 / アンダートラフィックスと / もうひとつ、<88fa><b:8ab8>用のトンネルがあったな
rows.re: But don't let that stop you. / Diligence is a virtue. Some Merc / once said so.

rows.en: @People go back and forth bearing Empathite about once a week.
rows.jp: 「ダムツェンの復興のためにも / あのトンネルは / 閉鎖しない方がよかったんじゃないか？別は興えていた渓谷場さ / あんたら他所者には授<b:8abe>なだけだぜ貧[03]好きだね / こんな何にもない場に / 何度も足を運ぶなんて
rows.re: People go back and forth bearing / Empathite about once a week.

rows.en: @Closing that tunnel really hurt Damzen City's prosperity.
rows.jp: 「なにが目的かはわからんが / まあ、せいぜい頑張ってくれ婆ちゃん / こんな何にもない場に / なにか用かい？<b:8ac1>作<b:8ac3><b:8ac1>作するんだ？<b:8ac1>作するんだ？<b:8ac1>作するか？<b:8ac1>作できないぜ<b:8ac4><b:8ac5><b:8ac6><898d><b:8ac1>作
rows.re: Closing that tunnel really hurt / Damzen City's prosperity.

rows.en: @Don't know what yer up to, but good luck anyhow.
rows.jp: 「でもそれは / 信応谷に頼ったものではないんだ
rows.lit: But that isn't something you rely on Empathite for. (信応谷=Empathite, corrupt)
rows.re: Don't know what yer up to, but good / luck anyhow.

rows.en: @This isn't something we can use Empathite for...
rows.jp: 「〜うまく言えないな〜
rows.re: This isn't something we can use / Empathite for...

rows.en: @It's hard to express...
rows.jp: 「強く生きるための、強い『想い』〜 / それで注がることができれば / 人はもっと強くなれる
rows.lit: A strong 'will' to live strongly; if you can pour that in, people can grow stronger still.
rows.re: It's hard to express...

rows.en: @If we can link ourselves through our strong desire to live, then we will all become stronger.
rows.jp: 「〜違うかな注がりは / 心の注がりだと思うんだが / <f040><f042>どう思う？
rows.re: If we can link ourselves through / our strong desire to live, then we / will all become stronger.

rows.en: @Am I right?
rows.jp: 「心を注いで / 不安を抱えることができるなら / うちのタワーが役に立つんだけど〜純度が / 大きく関わってくるんだ
rows.lit: If you can pour in your heart and hold your unease, our tower can be of use, but... purity matters greatly. (bleed-over tail)
rows.re: Am I right?

rows.en: @If we can link our hearts and overcome our fears, our Tower might come in handy.
rows.jp: 「でも、もっと重要なのは / 念話を伝えようとする / その人の<88ea>念力の強さだぜ<b:8a4e>理、<8934><88e0>ジャックをおこなうなら / テレパスタワー<8872>の信応谷が必要だ
rows.re: If we can link our hearts and / overcome our fears, our Tower might / come in handy.

rows.en: @But even more important is the strength of will of the person trying to send a thought.
rows.jp: 「でも、個人間の連絡くらいなら / 手の平サイズの信応谷で / <89ce>分事たりるぞ
rows.re: But even more important is the / strength of will of the person / trying to send a thought.

rows.en: @But to get in touch with an individual, a piece about as big as your hand would do the job.
rows.jp: 「もう、これで / <8934><88e0>ジャックなんてできないと思うぞ / 〜たぶんな
rows.re: But to get in touch with an / individual, a piece about as big as / your hand would do the job.

rows.en: @I'm sure that no one could use the Tower to broadcast clandestinely with it...I think...
rows.jp: 「さっそくタワーの信応谷に / プロテクトをかけて / 通信<88e0>に<8865>搭侵入できないようにしよう
rows.re: I'm sure that no one could use the / Tower to broadcast clandestinely / with it...I think...

rows.en: @We must make sure Telepath Tower's Empathite can't be used for a clandestine broadcast.
rows.jp: 「それよりもッ！ / あのテロリストどうするつもりなんだ？ / 何とかしてくれよッ！<b:8ad9>を行う / 放着<897f>なんだよ
rows.re: We must make sure Telepath Tower's / Empathite can't be used for a / clandestine broadcast.

rows.en: @Don't worry about that now! I'm more worried about the terrorists. Do something!
rows.jp: 「あの連中〜 / 勝手に入って何をするつもりか知らないけど / やめてほしいぜ
rows.lit: Those people... I don't know what they mean to do barging in, but I wish they'd stop.
rows.re: Don't worry about that now! I'm / more worried about the terrorists. / Do something!

rows.en: @I don't know what they intend to do there, but I doubt it's anything good.
rows.jp: 「寂いじゃないか〜身で設理しているテレパスタワーに / <8a22>な連中が立ち入っているんだ
rows.re: I don't know what they intend to do / there, but I doubt it's anything / good.

rows.en: @Isn't it scary?
rows.jp: 「そいつらが来てから / タワー街にモンスターも出没するんで / 近づくこともできやしない
rows.lit: Ever since they came, monsters show up in the tower district, so you can't even go near it.
rows.re: Isn't it scary?

rows.en: @Ever since they came, monsters have been appearing there. We can't even approach it!
rows.jp: 「何なんだ？ / あいつらは？
rows.re: Ever since they came, monsters have / been appearing there. We can't even / approach it!

rows.en: @Who are those people?
rows.jp: 「見るからにヤバそうな４人組だから / <88f7>意するのも、おっかないぜ勝手にタワーに / 入りこんだりしやがって〜来 / 少ししっかりしてきた気がします
rows.re: Who are those people?

rows.en: @It was four people, and they seemed very dangerous. I would be careful of them if I were you...
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアも / この異世事態を乗り抱えて / もっと素素らしい世界になれれば〜<b:8ae0>に / 念話通信が / 役立っているといいのですが〜
rows.re: It was four people, and they seemed / very dangerous. I would be careful / of them if I were you...

rows.en: @I hope that Filgaia can survive these days of peril and become a better place to live.
rows.jp: 「大きくて、純度の高い信応谷を使ってますが / テレパスタワーも / すいぶん古くなってしまいましたから〜<b:8ae1>、テレパスタワー街に / モンスターが棲みついてしまって〜
rows.re: I hope that Filgaia can survive / these days of peril and become a / better place to live.

rows.en: @We're using a very large, pure piece of Empathite, but the Telepath Tower is getting old.
rows.jp: 「信応谷のメンテナンスが / やりにくくなってしまいました身のテレパスタワーが / 手伝ったみたいで〜
rows.lit: Maintaining the Empathite has become difficult. (信応谷=Empathite; tail テレパスタワー bleed-over)
rows.re: We're using a very large, pure / piece of Empathite, but the / Telepath Tower is getting old.

rows.en: @Maintaining the Empathite has become more difficult.
rows.jp: 「やっぱり / 我が身の責任なんでしょうか？身はずっと / 谷のふもとのテレパスタワーの設理を / 任されてきたんです
rows.lit: Is it our own responsibility, after all? I've long been entrusted with the care of the Telepath Tower at the valley's foot. (設理->管理)
rows.re: Maintaining the Empathite has / become more difficult.

rows.en: @Does that make our family responsible?
rows.jp: 「どうしましょう〜 / 何か良くないことが / 起きなければいいのですが〜設理は / すべてムスメの靴に / 任せようと思う〜
rows.lit: What shall we do... I only hope nothing bad comes of it. (tail: I mean to leave the upkeep to my daughter)
rows.re: Does that make our family / responsible?

rows.en: @What'll we do now? I hope nothing bad comes of it.
rows.jp: 「まだまだなヤツだが / わしもあのくらいの腕には / あんなもんだったしな靴め / あんまりしっかりしてくると / わしが小言を言う楽しみがなくなるだろうが靴には / しっかりしてもらわないと〜靴め / 以前と比べると / だいぶマシになってきよった
rows.lit: He's still green, but I was about that good myself once. (rambling bleed-over: if my kid gets too competent, I lose the fun of nagging)
rows.re: What'll we do now? I hope nothing / bad comes of it.

rows.en: @I could wish for someone better to leave it to, but I wasn't much better at that age, I guess.
rows.jp: 「だが、まだまだだな〜靴が / すすんでタワーのメンテナンスに行きよった / こりゃ、めずらしいことだ靴も / あんたらみたいに / もっとしっかりしてくれたらな
rows.lit: But he's still got a ways to go. (bleed: the kid went off to do tower maintenance on his own, a rare thing)
rows.re: I could wish for someone better to / leave it to, but I wasn't much / better at that age, I guess.

rows.en: @But he's still got a long way to go...
rows.jp: 「ウジウジしているのは / 見ていて腹が立ってくるッ！<b:8ae7>どもにいいようにされるとはッ！
rows.re: But he's still got a long way to / go...

rows.en: @I get so mad when I see people goofing off all day!
rows.jp: 「タワーのみならず / あそこに保設しておいたトレジャーコールが / 悪用されなければよいが〜
rows.lit: I only hope the Booty Call I had stored there isn't put to ill use, on top of the tower. (保設->保管)
rows.re: I get so mad when I see people / goofing off all day!

rows.en: @And not just the Tower, either... I hope they don't use the Booty Call for their misdeeds...
rows.jp: 「ブツブツ〜身で設理してきた / テレパスタワーと呼ばれる放着<897f>がある
rows.re: And not just the Tower, either... I / hope they don't use the Booty Call / for their misdeeds...

rows.en: @Yeah, yeah...
rows.jp: 「実はな〜 / その<897f>の中に不<897c>な人物が / 出入りしておるようなんじゃ
rows.re: Yeah, yeah...

rows.en: @Actually... Strange people are loitering about there even now.
rows.jp: 「見つけたのは / ムスメの靴なんだが / どうしてその場で<88f7>意しないんだ
rows.re: Actually... Strange people are / loitering about there even now.

rows.en: @It was my daughter's husband who found them, but he didn't tell us about them.
rows.jp: 「わしには / それがわからんッ！
rows.re: It was my daughter's husband who / found them, but he didn't tell us / about them.

rows.en: @Why not I'll never know!
rows.jp: 「渓谷の抜け道なんて / 危なっかしい信じがしますが / 本当のところはどうなんでしょう？<b:8ae8>やそうと思っているんですが
rows.re: Why not I'll never know!

rows.en: @It seems that a secret route through a mine would be perilous, but what was it like?
rows.jp: 「よければ、ポンポコ谷の抜け道が / どこに通じていたか / 教えてもらえませんか？<b:8aea>は / 見つけられましたか？
rows.re: It seems that a secret route / through a mine would be perilous, / but what was it like?

rows.en: @Feel like telling me where the secret passage leads to?
rows.jp: 「一度に多くの人々に対してアピールする / その手段として、テレパスタワーは / 最も効果を発揮する場所ですから効果を上げる手段を
rows.lit: As a means of appealing to many people at once, the Telepath Tower is where it works best. (tail bleed-over)
rows.re: Feel like telling me where the / secret passage leads to?

rows.en: @It was the best way for them to get their message out to everyone at once.
rows.jp: 「この場にも / 何か作力な手がかりがあるかもしれない / さっそく、<8856>査を開始しようッ！若者 / 「人も、星も〜 / 命を<8a0c><b:8aec>にしてはいけない〜
rows.re: It was the best way for them to get / their message out to everyone at / once.

rows.en: @There might be something in this town that can help us find out. Let's get started quick!
rows.jp: 「死んでしまったら / やさしげな若者にも / お手上げなんじゃい〜若者 / 「<f040><f042>ファルガイアに滅亡の危機ッ！ / 滅亡はいかんぞ、滅亡は〜
rows.re: There might be something in this / town that can help us find out. / Let's get started quick!

rows.en: @If you die, not even the best doctor can save you.
rows.jp: 「ほどよいケガ人と / やさしげな若者のまなざし / 未来に必要なのは、このふたつじゃ若者 / 「く、くそッ！ / こんなモノ、お前らにくれてやるわいッ！若者 / 「こんな便利なモノがあるから / わしの生きがいが〜若者 / 「確かに渡したぞい若者 / 「な、何と、いじりがいのありそうな / <b:8aed><b:8aee>のボディではないか〜
rows.re: If you die, not even the best / doctor can save you.

rows.en: @We need more cheerful patients, and kind doctors like me to treat them!
rows.jp: 「悪いことは言わんから / おとなしく / わしにいじられてみないかね？
rows.lit: I'll tell you no lie, so won't you quietly let me examine you?
rows.re: We need more cheerful patients, and / kind doctors like me to treat them!

rows.en: @I promise I won't hurt you. Will you please let me examine you?
rows.jp: 「寂がらなくてもいい〜 / わしにいじられるのは / むしろ、カラダにエエくらいじゃ若者 / 「ほらほら〜 / やさしー目をしているだろう〜
rows.lit: No need to be shy. Being examined by me is, if anything, good for the body. (bleed: young man, see what gentle eyes I have)
rows.re: I promise I won't hurt you. Will / you please let me examine you?

rows.en: @No need to be afraid. My examinations are very pleasant.
rows.jp: 「『目は、口ほどにモノを言う』ッ！ / この、やさしー目で若者を呼び込むんじゃ
rows.lit: 'The eyes speak as plainly as the mouth'! With these gentle eyes I draw the young folk in.
rows.re: No need to be afraid. My / examinations are very pleasant.

rows.en: @You know the saying, |Eyes are a window to the soul.| Yessir, these eyes are why patients come to me.
rows.jp: 「わしの、やさしー目〜 / 世間性があると思わんか〜若者 / 「若者の年が / どうにもサッパリ<b:8ae8>えないはずだッ！
rows.re: You know the saying, |Eyes are a / window to the soul.| Yessir, these / eyes are why patients come to me.

rows.en: @You want to look into my eyes... You're getting drowsy...
rows.jp: 「アンダートラフィックスの / 崩落事<8808>埋合め〜 / わしの悪口をいろんな所で吹抜してやがる若者 / 「テロリストの依行で / 若者が<b:8ae8>えると期待したんじゃが〜
rows.re: You want to look into my eyes... / You're getting drowsy...

rows.en: @Those ingrates who were caught in the Under Traffic cave-in are saying bad things about me!
rows.jp: 「どうしてサッパリ / 客足が途絶えているんだろうか？若者 / 「渓谷のケガが少なくなってきたのを / ひとり<b:8af6>しく思っていたが〜
rows.re: Those ingrates who were caught in / the Under Traffic cave-in are / saying bad things about me!

rows.en: @...so why have patients stopped coming altogether!?
rows.jp: 「こりゃまた / 楽しくなってきそうじゃわい / うっし、うっしッ！若者 / 「いろいろいじらせてくれる若者は好きじゃが / そうでないのは、うるさいだけじゃい
rows.lit: Now this is getting fun. Yes, yes! (bleed: I like youngsters who let me poke around; the rest are just noise)
rows.re: ...so why have patients stopped / coming altogether!?

rows.en: @...but now it looks like things might be looking up again!
rows.jp: 「しかし、つまらんな / 渓谷のふもとのダムツェンじゃ / 骨<88dd>なんて珍しくもなんともないわい
rows.re: ...but now it looks like things / might be looking up again!

rows.en: @It's boring...Damzen's at the base of a mine, so I set broken bones all the time.
rows.jp: 「どうせなら / もっとワクワクするような若者を / 連れてきてほしいもんじゃ
rows.lit: If you're going to, I'd like you to bring me some more exciting young folk.
rows.re: It's boring...Damzen's at the base / of a mine, so I set broken bones / all the time.

rows.en: @Next time I hope I get a patient I can get more excited about treating.
rows.jp: 「ス、スミマセンね / 大騒ぎしたわりに / 指の骨<88dd>なんかで〜
rows.re: Next time I hope I get a patient I / can get more excited about / treating.

rows.en: @Oh...Sorry 'bout that...It's just a broken finger, it seems...
rows.jp: [17]来てくれなければ / 今ごろどうなっていたことやら
rows.lit: If you hadn't come, who knows what would have become of me by now. (17 = leading control code)
rows.re: Oh...Sorry 'bout that...It's just a / broken finger, it seems...

rows.jp: 「たまたまの崩落に / たまたま<8812>き込まれちゃってさ<b:8afa><89cd>が崩れる<8865>前に / 枯<b:8ac5>が爆発する<b:8afb>を聞いたんです

rows.en: @Good thing we found you after the cave-in, though.
rows.jp: 「それと、もうひとつ〜 / 人の話を抜いたのです / たぶん、まちがいありません〜鎖するカタチで起きていた
rows.lit: And one more thing... someone pumped a person for information. I'm almost certain of it. (tail bleed-over: it happened in a sealing pattern)
rows.re: Good thing we found you after the / cave-in, though.

rows.en: @Also, I heard human voices. I'm almost sure of it.
rows.jp: 「何者かのしわざと / 考えられないこともないが〜
rows.lit: It's not impossible to suppose it was someone's doing.
rows.re: Also, I heard human voices. I'm / almost sure of it.

rows.en: @It could be part of someone's plan...
rows.jp: 「通信機で / [0a]ぉさんに / 連絡とってみようよ標が<88b0>るから / わしらは未来が訪れていることを / 実信できていたんじゃ
rows.lit: Let's try contacting {0} on the communicator. (0a = name slot)
rows.re: It could be part of someone's / plan...

rows.en: @Try contacting {0} on the communicator.
rows.jp: 「青空に目標〜 / そんな、何でもない回世が / どれほど安心信を与えていたことか来おる〜
rows.lit: A goal in the blue sky; how much reassurance such an ordinary scene once gave. (tail bleed-over)
rows.re: Try contacting {0} on the / communicator.

rows.en: @The sun in the sky... We never knew how precious it was until now.
rows.jp: 「もしかして、更はお<88cc>えッ！ / 悪の招く誘<89dd>に乗せられて / 置使と共に舞い上がるのか？<b:8b08>って / 今度は〜 / <f040><f042>空が無くなる置変地異ッ！
rows.re: The sun in the sky... We never knew / how precious it was until now.

rows.en: @Maybe the Angel of Death will come to greet me, and take me to heaven aboard a chariot?
rows.jp: 「時代は、このジジイに / 何を見せようというのかッ！連絡のアジトが / こっそりと作られているなんてことは〜
rows.lit: What does the age mean to show this old man?! (tail bleed: that a secret hideout was quietly being built)
rows.re: Maybe the Angel of Death will come / to greet me, and take me to heaven / aboard a chariot?

rows.en: @What will the future show this old man before he dies?
rows.jp: 「考えていたら / おっかなくなって来おった〜連絡のアジトを持っているとすれば / そこは、めったに人が<b:8b0b>み込まない / あるいは<b:8b0b>み込めない場所に違いないッ！
rows.re: What will the future show this old / man before he dies?

rows.en: @It's kind of spooky just to think about it!
rows.jp: 「連絡のアジトとは / そういうモノじゃからのう
rows.lit: A hideout is that sort of thing, after all.
rows.re: It's kind of spooky just to think / about it!

rows.en: @Everyone knows those are the best locations for secret hideouts.
rows.jp: 「それになぞらえて / 空を『<89f9>の道』〜 / <88db><88dc>を『<88db>の道』と<895b>しておるのじゃ来て / どこへ行くのか〜
rows.re: Everyone knows those are the best / locations for secret hideouts.

rows.en: @So we can say that the sky is a |sea of wind,| and the desert is a |sea of sand.|
rows.jp: 「まあ、たいがいのヤツは / ポンポコ谷の地辺から / シエルジェに向かっているみたいじゃがのう来て / どこへ行くのか〜
rows.lit: Well, most folk seem to head from the underside of Ponpoko Valley toward Sielje. (bleed tail)
rows.re: So we can say that the sky is a / |sea of wind,| and the desert is a / |sea of sand.|

rows.en: @Well, most people seem to go to Sielje, using the tunnel...
rows.jp: 「まあ、たいがいのヤツは / アンダートラフィックスから / やって来ているみたいじゃがのう<b:8aec>じゃッ！
rows.re: Well, most people seem to go to / Sielje, using the tunnel...

rows.en: @Hmm...Most folks seem to come from Under Traffic...
rows.jp: 「信応谷という不思議な渓物によって / <8a10>く離れた者と意思を<88fa>わすことのできる / なかなか便利な機艇じゃて別はそれなりに興えておった / ダムツェンじゃが / 今となっては見る<88c0>もない〜
rows.re: Hmm...Most folks seem to come from / Under Traffic...

rows.en: @A useful device. It uses the mysterious ore Empathite to make thoughts known to those far away.
rows.jp: 「あの頃の名残といえば / 信応谷を使った放着<897f>が / この地方にあるくらいじゃのう<b:8b0d>しておく
rows.re: A useful device. It uses the / mysterious ore Empathite to make / thoughts known to those far away.

rows.en: @The most famous relic of that time is the broadcast tower, which uses Empathite.
rows.jp: 「何か飲んでくかい？[18]か払いなんだ
rows.lit: Want something to drink? It's on me. (18 = prompt code)
rows.re: The most famous relic of that time / is the broadcast tower, which uses / Empathite.

rows.en: @Ya want something to drink?2
rows.jp: 「ちょうど、ダムツェンから[11]お北側[11]ぉに / 変な建物があるらしいんだ / ま、何があるか自分の目で確かめてみなよ<b:8bb4>[08][10][01]払いなんだ<b:8b0e>と / ミルクのアンバランスさがいいね<b:8b0f>ち復りのキミにはそれが一番 / <b:8b11>に手を当てて一気に飲みほすんだ
rows.re: Ya want something to drink?2

rows.en: @1NE0 of Damzen City is a strange building, I hear. You seem like you might be interested...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>おお / いい飲みっぷりだ、ホレボレするね / そうだな、いいコトを教えてあげよう
rows.re: NE of Damzen City is a strange / building, I hear. You seem like you / might be interested...

rows.en: @Well, you certainly know how to drink, don't you! I'm impressed. Want to hear some good gossip?
rows.jp: 「ちょうど、ダムツェンから[11]お北側[11]ぉに / 変な建物があるらしいんだ / ま、何があるか自分の目で確かめてみなよ飲みっぷりがよかったからね / 結単にいいコトを教えてあげよう
rows.lit: Just to the north of Damzen there's a strange building, they say. Go see with your own eyes what's there. (bleed: you drink well, so let me tell you something good)
rows.re: Well, you certainly know how to / drink, don't you! I'm impressed. / Want to hear some good gossip?

rows.en: @1NE0 of Damzen City is a strange building, I hear. You seem like you might be interested...
rows.jp: 「ちょうど、ダムツェンから[11]お北側[11]ぉに / 変な建物があるらしいんだ / ま、何があるか自分の目で確かめてみなよ浮かない探して
rows.lit: Just to the north of Damzen there's a strange building, they say. Go see with your own eyes what's there. (11/ぉ = emphasis codes; bleed tail)
rows.re: NE of Damzen City is a strange / building, I hear. You seem like you / might be interested...

rows.en: @1NE0 of Damzen City is a strange building, I hear. You seem like you might be interested...
rows.jp: 「何か困っているんだったら / 僕に話してみないか？ / こう見えても僕とルカは〜
rows.lit: If something's troubling you, why not talk to me? Believe it or not, Luka and I...
rows.re: NE of Damzen City is a strange / building, I hear. You seem like you / might be interested...

rows.en: @If you get into trouble, just tell me about it. Luka and I ...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>いや、すまん / 何でもない〜<f05b> / 別のコトだったよ困ったものだよ
rows.re: If you get into trouble, just tell / me about it. Luka and I ...

rows.en: @Oh yeah...never mind... I didn't mean anything by it... That was a long time ago...
rows.jp: 「ま、僕がこんなところで手伝わせているのが / イケナイのかもしれないが〜
rows.lit: Well, maybe it's wrong of me to have her helping out in a place like this.
rows.re: Oh yeah...never mind... I didn't / mean anything by it... That was a / long time ago...

rows.en: @'Course, it's partly my fault for making her work in this place.
rows.jp: 「あんなに、おてんばだと嫁の貰い手が / つくかどうか心配でな〜困ったものだよ
rows.lit: As big a tomboy as she is, I worry whether she'll ever find a husband. What a handful.
rows.re: 'Course, it's partly my fault for / making her work in this place.

rows.en: @Do tom-boys like that ever find husbands...I get worried...
rows.jp: 「ま、僕がこんなところで手伝わせているのが / イケナイのかもしれないが〜
rows.lit: Well, maybe it's wrong of me to have her helping out in a place like this.
rows.re: Do tom-boys like that ever find / husbands...I get worried...

rows.en: @'Course, it's partly my fault for making her work in this place.
rows.jp: 「あんなに、おてんばだと嫁の貰い手が / つくかどうか心配でな〜
rows.lit: As big a tomboy as she is, I worry whether she'll find a husband.
rows.re: 'Course, it's partly my fault for / making her work in this place.

rows.en: @Do tom-boys like that ever find husbands...It makes me worried...
rows.jp: 「キミのように / 少しは可愛らしくしてくれれば / いいんだがね〜
rows.lit: If she'd make herself a little more charming, like you, it'd be fine, but...
rows.re: Do tom-boys like that ever find / husbands...It makes me worried...

rows.en: @I wish she'd make herself a little bit more cute...like you.
rows.jp: 「親<8a0e>がいないから / 一応、種のオレがしっかりしなくちゃな
rows.re: I wish she'd make herself a little / bit more cute...like you.

rows.en: @Our parents are gone, so as her older brother, it's all up to me.
rows.jp: 「関係ないけど、僕たちは異種種族なんだ / ま、本当の種族のように / ルカが僕を慕ってくれるから助かってるけど<b:8b1a>に来ている連中がいるんだ
rows.re: Our parents are gone, so as her / older brother, it's all up to me.

rows.en: @We have different mothers, but Luka still looks up to me. She's such a good kid...
rows.jp: 「<8815>往復復なのはいいんだが / ルカ目当てってのがね〜〜 / 種としては、複雑な気分だよ〜種さんはどうしたんだい？
rows.re: We have different mothers, but Luka / still looks up to me. She's such a / good kid...

rows.en: @It's good for business, but as her older brother, I'm worried about her, too...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>あ、やっぱりいいよ話さなくて / 聞かなくてもキミたちを見ればわかる / 変なことを聞いてすまなかったな〜<b:8a39>（？）がいたよな
rows.re: It's good for business, but as her / older brother, I'm worried about / her, too...

rows.en: @No, don't worry about it. You don't need to tell me. I can tell by looking at you. Sorry I asked...
rows.jp: 「かっこうは変だったけど / 何かとてつもないものを連めた信じだったな / <f040><f041><f042>もしかすると〜いや、なんでもない〜
rows.re: No, don't worry about it. You don't / need to tell me. I can tell by / looking at you. Sorry I asked...

rows.en: @She looked funny enough, but it looked like maybe she was hiding something pretty...Oh, never mind.
rows.jp: 「まだ、ポンポコ谷で / 信応谷がたくさん通れていた頃〜
rows.lit: Back when a lot of Empathite still passed through Ponpoko Valley... (信応谷=Empathite)
rows.re: She looked funny enough, but it / looked like maybe she was hiding / something pretty...Oh, never mind.

rows.en: @In the days when mining Empathite was like pickin' apples from a tree...
rows.jp: 「素れた時、目標の方向に目を凝らすと / 小さな他に、小さな建物の<88c0>が / ボンヤリと見える事があったんだ
rows.re: In the days when mining Empathite / was like pickin' apples from a / tree...

rows.en: @On clear mornings, if you looked towards the sun, you could see a small building on a small island...
rows.jp: 「あれはいったい / 何だったんだろうな〜<b:8b1f>にもなく、そう思えてくるんだ
rows.re: On clear mornings, if you looked / towards the sun, you could see a / small building on a small island...

rows.en: @I often wonder what that was...
rows.jp: 「だとしたら / 辛いんだろうな〜 / 苦しいんだろうな〜溜まり場があるらしい
rows.lit: If so, it must be painful... it must be agonizing... (tail bleed: there seems to be a hangout)
rows.re: I often wonder what that was...

rows.en: @If so, there will be pain... and suffering too...
rows.jp: 「そんなすげぇトコならば / 渓谷なんかも / たくさん通れるんじゃないか？
rows.lit: If it's such an amazing place, wouldn't a lot of ore pass through there too?
rows.re: If so, there will be pain... and / suffering too...

rows.en: @If such a place exists, there must be lots of ore around it.
rows.jp: 「いったい、どこにあるのやら〜真っ暗、なんて / 渓谷で働いていた僕たちは / <b:8b22>れっこだけどよ〜
rows.re: If such a place exists, there must / be lots of ore around it.

rows.en: @I wonder where it is...
rows.jp: 「この得体の知れない不気味さは / どうにもならねぇな〜<b:8b23><89cc>となってしまったものもある
rows.re: I wonder where it is...

rows.en: @It's hard to get used to something this mysterious...
rows.jp: 「そういうのを放っておくと / やがてモンスターたちが棲みついて / どうにもならない状態になるんだ
rows.lit: Leave that kind of thing be, and before long monsters settle in and it's beyond saving.
rows.re: It's hard to get used to something / this mysterious...

rows.en: @'Course, monsters love places like that, and once they get a foot-hold it's hard to get 'em out.
rows.jp: 「連中がねらうとすれば / ダムツェンよりも / むしろ、ホルストだな〜
rows.lit: If they're going to target somewhere, it's Holst rather than Damzen.
rows.re: 'Course, monsters love places like / that, and once they get a foot-hold / it's hard to get 'em out.

rows.en: @They'd be after Holst before they'd come after Damzen City, I'd bet...
rows.jp: 「連中にとっても / うまみの少ないダムツェンじゃ / 情報もなかなか<8880>まってこないんだ
rows.re: They'd be after Holst before they'd / come after Damzen City, I'd bet...

rows.en: @They aren't very interested in this place, though, so it's hard to find out anything about 'em.
rows.jp: 「そう、メリアブールの<89fb>方が言ったのかい？ / ホントに、そう言ったんだな？
rows.re: They aren't very interested in this / place, though, so it's hard to find / out anything about 'em.

rows.en: @The King of Meria Boule really said that? He really did?
rows.re: The King of Meria Boule really said / that? He really did?

rows.jp: 「ポンポコ谷が、さびれていく一方だから / てっきり僕たちは / <89fb>方に見捨てられたと思いこんでいたよ

rows.en: @Mt. Chug-Chug is dead now, so we all thought that the King had abandoned us.
rows.jp: 「まだ、僕たちのことを / おぼえていてくれたなんて〜
rows.lit: To think they still remembered us...
rows.re: Mt. Chug-Chug is dead now, so we / all thought that the King had / abandoned us.

rows.en: @So he still remembers us...
rows.jp: 「いや、こんなおいしい場所で / また使ってくれるなんて / ありがたい話だよ
rows.lit: No, that they'd use this fine place, and us, again, is a blessing.
rows.re: So he still remembers us...

rows.en: @I'm glad we can be of use again... especially like this.
rows.jp: 「僕たちダムツェンの渓谷は / あんたたちに協力するぜ
rows.lit: We miners of Damzen will cooperate with you.
rows.re: I'm glad we can be of use again... / especially like this.

rows.en: @We Damzen city miners will do anything to help you.
rows.jp: 「いっしょに戦っていこうッ！ / まずは、ポンポコ谷地辺トンネルの開放だな / こいつを持って行きなッ！
rows.lit: Let's fight together! First, opening the Ponpoko Valley underside tunnel. Take this with you!
rows.re: We Damzen city miners will do / anything to help you.

rows.en: @We'll fight together! First we'll have to free the tunnel. Bring this!
rows.jp: 「その別、メリアブールの<89fb>方からもらった / ポンポコ谷で / いちばん強いヤツの証だッ！所の銀世界が<89da>がっている
rows.re: We'll fight together! First we'll / have to free the tunnel. Bring / this!

rows.en: @It's proof from the King of Meria Boule that I'm the top-man at Mt. Chug-Chug!
rows.jp: 「シエルジェは / [11]お祈<89af>の中央[11]ぉに級置している自分<89b7>だ / <8954>いやすいから気をつけろよ
rows.re: It's proof from the King of Meria / Boule that I'm the top-man at Mt. / Chug-Chug!

rows.en: @The Sielje Region is 1in the middle of a snow field.0 I warn you - it's easy to get lost!
rows.jp: 「僕たちでできることなら / いくらでも協力するつもりだぜ<b:8b28>前の渓谷かしらだけど / 信応谷がたくさん通れているころは / 僕もちょっとしたモンだったんだぜ
rows.re: The Sielje Region is in the middle / of a snow field. I warn you - it's / easy to get lost!

rows.en: @We'll do whatever we can to help.
rows.jp: 「メリアブールの<89fb>方から / ポンポコ谷の地辺トンネルの設理を / まかされていた時期もあったんだ
rows.re: We'll do whatever we can to help.

rows.en: @There was a time when the King of Meria Boule left maintenance of the tunnel to me.
rows.jp: 「もっとも〜 / 脱出する信応谷が無ければ / 何の役に立たないトンネルだけどな
rows.lit: Though... with no Empathite to make an escape, it's a tunnel that's of no use at all. (信応谷=Empathite)
rows.re: There was a time when the King of / Meria Boule left maintenance of the / tunnel to me.

rows.en: @The tunnel wouldn't be of any use if there wasn't anything to export, of course.
rows.jp: 「<8934><88e0>ジャックなんてやらかした / テロリストと / 何か関係があるってんじゃないだろうな<b:8b22>れない飛空機艇が / かっ飛んでいったな〜
rows.re: The tunnel wouldn't be of any use / if there wasn't anything to export, / of course.

rows.en: @...Maybe it has something to do with the terrorists who started the clandestine broadcast...
rows.jp: 「たしかに、[11]おポンポコ谷[11]ぉの<88c4>上には / 飛空機艇用の / エアプレーンポートが作られているがよ〜
rows.re: ...Maybe it has something to do / with the terrorists who started the / clandestine broadcast...

rows.en: @There was an airplane port for flying machines on the peak of 1Mt. Chug-Chug0, but...
rows.jp: 「信応谷が通れなくなった今〜 / 脱出する必要が無いってのに / いったい誰が飛空機艇を飛ばしているんだ？
rows.lit: Now that the Empathite can't get through, when there's no need to escape, who on earth is flying the machines? (信応谷=Empathite)
rows.re: There was an airplane port for / flying machines on the peak of Mt. / Chug-Chug, but...

rows.en: @Now that there's no more Empathite to be mined and exported, who would be up there in a flying machine?
rows.jp: 「この先、１００数は使用に耐えられる / 最高<8872>の純度と大きさだぜ暮らしともオサラバさ
rows.re: Now that there's no more Empathite / to be mined and exported, who would / be up there in a flying machine?

rows.en: @From its size and purity, it should be good for at least 100 years or so...
rows.jp: 「くそったれッ！ / あの谷にはもう抜けになるほど / 信応谷が<89db>まっていないんだとよッ！<b:8ad3>回 / 酒ばかりのんでるっていうのも / そろそろ<b:8b2b>きてきてはいるんだが
rows.re: From its size and purity, it should / be good for at least 100 years or / so...

rows.en: @Now there's nothing in that mountain that anyone could make a living off of! What'll we do...?
rows.jp: 「かといって / ほかになにもすることがないしなぁ〜〜酒を飲んだくれる生命にも悪くないが / そればっかりっていうのもなぁ
rows.re: Now there's nothing in that / mountain that anyone could make a / living off of! What'll we do...?

rows.en: @But there's just nothing else to do...
rows.jp: 「なぁあんた / どこかで渓谷が見つかったとかいう話 / 聞いたことないかい？静かなものさ
rows.lit: Say, you, haven't you heard any talk of a mine being found somewhere? (tail bleed: it's quiet)
rows.re: But there's just nothing else to / do...

rows.en: @Didn't I hear something 'bout you finding a mine somewhere?
rows.jp: 「あまりの静かさに / 気が滅入ってきそうだ / 気素らしに酒を飲むくらいしかないよ奴らの仕業か？
rows.lit: The quiet's so heavy it gets me down. About all I can do to lift the mood is drink. (bleed: their doing?; 気素らし->気晴らし)
rows.re: Didn't I hear something 'bout you / finding a mine somewhere?

rows.en: @So quiet sometimes I think my crews 'll go loose. All there is to lighten the mood is drinking.
rows.jp: 「こんなことなら / 捕まえてとっちめとけば / よかったよ奴らの仕業か？
rows.lit: If I'd known it'd come to this, I should've caught them and given them what for. (bleed: their doing?)
rows.re: So quiet sometimes I think my crews / 'll go loose. All there is to / lighten the mood is drinking.

rows.en: @Now I wish I'd taken 'em out of commission like I wanted to then...
rows.jp: 「で、奴らの新体は何なんだ / あんた知ってんだろう？ / ちょっとくらい教えてくれよ
rows.lit: So what's their real nature? You know, don't you? Tell me even a little.
rows.re: Now I wish I'd taken 'em out of / commission like I wanted to then...

rows.en: @What're those guys really up to? I bet you know! Come on, tell me, Please?
rows.jp: 「渓谷は閉谷してしまったんだ / 何にも無い場だぜ、ここは乗り仲間から / 聞いた話なんですがね〜
rows.lit: The valley's been closed off. There's nothing here now. (bleed tail: something I heard from a fellow rider)
rows.re: What're those guys really up to? I / bet you know! Come on, tell me, / Please?

rows.en: @Now that the mine's closed, this place's got nothing to offer, though...nothing.
rows.jp: 「外道のはずれでは / 道の<8a07>も / おかしくなってきたらしいですぜ
rows.re: Now that the mine's closed, this / place's got nothing to offer, / though...nothing.

rows.en: @At the edge of the open sea, the color of the water is the wrong color, he says.
rows.jp: 「空に<8a18>いて / 道までも〜 / やっぱりもう、ダメなんですかい？乗りだった頃〜
rows.re: At the edge of the open sea, the / color of the water is the wrong / color, he says.

rows.en: @So now it's not just the sky, but the sea as well. What'll be next?
rows.jp: 「一度だけ / ゲートブリッジが開放しているのを / 見たことがあるんですよ
rows.lit: I saw the Gate Bridge open, just once.
rows.re: So now it's not just the sky, but / the sea as well. What'll be next?

rows.en: @I saw the Gate Bridge open just once.
rows.jp: 「それはそれは / 珍しいモンなんで / 思わず運んじまいました乗り時代に / いろいろ不思議なモノも / 見てきたつもりだったんですがね〜
rows.lit: It was such a rare sight I hauled it off without thinking. (bleed: back in my riding days I thought I'd seen my share of strange things)
rows.re: I saw the Gate Bridge open just / once.

rows.en: @It's such a rare thing, I said a prayer without even meanin' to!
rows.jp: 「さすがに / 空が無くなっちまうなんて / デタラメな事は初めてでさぁ乗りなんですよ
rows.lit: Even so, the sky vanishing, an absurd thing like that, was a first. (bleed: I'm a rider)
rows.re: It's such a rare thing, I said a / prayer without even meanin' to!

rows.en: @But this is the first time I've ever seen anything like the sky disappearing...
rows.jp: 「でも、乗っていた<89d3>は / <898f>没しちまうし / 渓谷（おやま）は閉鎖されるときた
rows.re: But this is the first time I've / ever seen anything like the sky / disappearing...

rows.en: @But my ship sank at about the same time the mine closed up.
rows.jp: 「あっしが何か / 悪いことでもしたんでしょうか？<b:8b2d>をもってしても / すべての探<887e>は難しいと聞いてますぜ
rows.re: But my ship sank at about the same / time the mine closed up.

rows.en: @Do you think I did something wrong?
rows.jp: 「いくつかの道路は / 海川や陸地、<89ec>なんかによって / 街道として封じられているんです
rows.re: Do you think I did something wrong?

rows.en: @There're parts of the sea that are surrounded by shoals, land, and bridges, too - the inland seas.
rows.jp: 「探<887e>に見落としがないよう / 気をつけてくださいよ難物の多くはそこに流れ着くって話ですぜ
rows.re: There're parts of the sea that are / surrounded by shoals, land, and / bridges, too - the inland seas.

rows.en: @Be careful not to miss any of these in your search!
rows.jp: 「[11]お街道の中央付近[11]ぉにも / 小さな他がありましてね / そこも道難物の流れ先って話ですぜ働きたいんですよ
rows.lit: Near the middle of the sea route there's a small island too, and they say driftwood washes ashore there. (11/ぉ emphasis; bleed tail)
rows.re: Be careful not to miss any of these / in your search!

rows.en: @There's an island 1near the center of the inland sea0 that also has flotsam and jetsam on it, I hear.
rows.jp: 「でもね、ポンポコ谷にはもう / 抜けが出るほど / 信応谷は<89db>まってないんですよ枯<b:8b30>たる大地が / <b:8b31>々と<89da>がってるんです
rows.re: There's an island near the center / of the inland sea that also has / flotsam and jetsam on it, I hear.

rows.en: @But there's not enough Empathite left in the mines to make a profit.
rows.jp: 「つまらないなんて / 言いっこ無しですよ
rows.lit: Don't go calling it boring, now.
rows.re: But there's not enough Empathite / left in the mines to make a profit.

rows.en: @Don't be saying this is boring you!
rows.jp: 「そこには / あっしらの渓谷（おやま）〜 / ポンポコ谷があるんですから難しい道<8a1b>かもしれませんな<b:8ac3>に往っている / 『テレポートジェム』言うんですかい？
rows.re: Don't be saying this is boring you!

rows.en: @There you'll find our mine... Mt. Chug-Chug.
rows.jp: 「そいつを使えば / 今まで行った場に瞬間移動できるって / 話じゃないですかい
rows.lit: They say if you use that, you can teleport in an instant to any place you've already been.
rows.re: There you'll find our mine... Mt. / Chug-Chug.

rows.en: @Isn't that the Gem you can use to transport yourself instantly to towns you've already been to?
rows.jp: 「もっとも、あっしは生まれてこのかた / ダムツェン以外の場を知らないので / 使っても意味が無いんですがね
rows.lit: Mind you, I've known nowhere but Damzen my whole life, so it'd be no use to me.
rows.re: Isn't that the Gem you can use to / transport yourself instantly to / towns you've already been to?

rows.en: @'Course, I've never been to a town besides Damzen City, so such a thing wouldn't do me any good...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>そうそう〜 / 指定できる行き先の場は / 一行のリーダーが訪れた場に権るそうで
rows.re: 'Course, I've never been to a town / besides Damzen City, so such a / thing wouldn't do me any good...

rows.en: @Yes, you can only use it to bring you to towns the group's leader has been to...
rows.jp: 「気をつけてください<b:8a39>ッ！ / いきなり、失<8928>じゃろがッ！
rows.re: Yes, you can only use it to bring / you to towns the group's leader has / been to...

rows.en: @Be careful, now.
rows.jp: 「この家たちは / わらわの幻幻術でつくりあげた / アカとアオじゃッ！施<89b1>所知ってるよ
rows.re: Be careful, now.

rows.en: @These are my friends made with ultra high-tech, Hob and Nob.
rows.jp: 「えーとね、これは種種とアタイが / 渡り鳥みたいなコトをしてたときに / 聞いたことなんだけど〜
rows.lit: Um, this is something I heard back when Grandpa and I were doing Merc-like work. (種種 = 'Grandpa'/kin, decode odd)
rows.re: These are my friends made with / ultra high-tech, Hob and Nob.

rows.en: @Something big bro' and I heard when we were being Mercs a while back...
rows.jp: 「[11]おシルヴァラントの先[11]ぉの / [11]お谷に囲まれた場所[11]ぉに変な施<89b1>所が / あるんだってさ
rows.re: Something big bro' and I heard when / we were being Mercs a while back...

rows.en: @Apparently there's a mysterious lab 1surrounded by mountains0 1south of Sylvaland0.
rows.jp: 「きっとそっちの方が幻幻術だってッ<b:8a39>ッ！
rows.re: Apparently there's a mysterious lab / surrounded by mountains south of / Sylvaland.

rows.en: @I bet they're REALLY ultra high-tech!
rows.jp: 「いいじゃろうッ / ノーブルレッドがファルガイアの / 真の支配者だと言うことを見せてやるわいッ
rows.lit: Very well! I'll show you that the Crimson Nobles are the true rulers of Filgaia!
rows.re: I bet they're REALLY ultra high- / tech!

rows.en: @That's OK. I'll show her that the REAL rulers of Filgaia are the Crimson Nobles.
rows.jp: 「では、さっそくその施<89b1>所を破滅〜〜 / もといッ、<8918>参してくるとしようかのッ！ / 行くぞ[05]ぉッ！施<89b1>所は見つかったかい？
rows.re: That's OK. I'll show her that the / REAL rulers of Filgaia are the / Crimson Nobles.

rows.en: @Now to destroy the lab! Or...maybe we should just check it out...Let's go, 0!
rows.jp: 「場所は、[11]おシルヴァラントの先[11]ぉの / [11]お谷に囲まれた場所岸り[11]ぉだからね / ま、がんばってねぇ種種の作る料理は置辺一<892e>だよッ！
rows.re: Now to destroy the lab! Or...maybe / we should just check it out...Let's / go, !

rows.en: @Remember, it's in a place that's 1surrounded by mountains0 1south of Sylvaland.0
rows.jp: 「アタイの好物の『サバの味噌煮』なんて / もう、ウマイのなんのって〜ッ！ / あんたたちも一度、食べてみなよッ！種種の作る料理は置辺一<892e>だよッ！
rows.re: Remember, it's in a place that's / surrounded by mountains south of / Sylvaland.

rows.en: @He makes my favorite dish, lasagna, better than anyone. Try some before you go?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>あ、アタイはちょっと苦手だけど〜<f05b> / あんたは、どうだい？ / 単に女だからって料理が苦手でもいいよな？腕なんだけどさ / 未成数がこんな酒場で働いてていいのかね？
rows.re: He makes my favorite dish, lasagna, / better than anyone. Try some before / you go?

rows.en: @My cooking's not very good though...How 'bout you? Women don't need be good cooks, right?
rows.jp: 「まったく、アタイに手伝わせる / 種種がイケナイんだ
rows.lit: Honestly, it's Grandpa's fault for making me help. (種種 kin term)
rows.re: My cooking's not very good / though...How 'bout you? Women don't / need be good cooks, right?

rows.en: @It's all my big-brother's fault, you understand.
rows.jp: 「ま、種種ひとりだと / この酒場つぶれちゃうからな / やっぱり、アタイがついてなきゃねぇ腕なんだけどさ / 未成数がこんな酒場で働いてていいのかね？
rows.lit: Well, Grandpa alone would run this tavern into the ground, so I do have to be here. (bleed: an underage girl working a bar like this, is that all right?)
rows.re: It's all my big-brother's fault, / you understand.

rows.en: @'Course, without me this place 'd fall apart in about a minute...
rows.jp: 「ちなみに種種は２６腕なんだけどさ / はやく嫁さんでももらえば / アタイが手伝わなくてもすむのに〜
rows.lit: Incidentally, Grandpa's 26. If he'd just take a wife, I wouldn't have to help. (腕->歳 corrupt 'years old')
rows.re: 'Course, without me this place 'd / fall apart in about a minute...

rows.en: @My brother's already 26, ya know. If he finds a wife I won't have to help out here anymore...
rows.jp: 「あ、そうだ / あんた、ウチの種種どうだい？ / もらってくれないかな？
rows.lit: Oh, that's right, how about our Grandpa for you? Won't you take him? (種種 kin term)
rows.re: My brother's already 26, ya know. / If he finds a wife I won't have to / help out here anymore...

rows.en: @Hey, how 'bout you? You wanna marry my brother?
rows.jp: 「いざとなったら、アタイと種種で / なんとかしてみせるさ / らくしょーッ！ らくしょーッ！
rows.lit: When it comes down to it, Grandpa and I will manage somehow. Easy! Easy!
rows.re: Hey, how 'bout you? You wanna marry / my brother?

rows.en: @If it gets really bad, bro and I'll do something about it. No problem!
rows.jp: 「なんたって、アタイたちは別〜 / <f040><f041><f042>あっと、それは連絡なんだ<f048>酒が飲みたいのかい？
rows.re: If it gets really bad, bro and I'll / do something about it. No problem!

rows.en: @You see, a long time ago we were... ...Oh! I forgot, that's a secret...
rows.jp: 「でも、まだダメだよ / アタイみたく、もっと大人になってからだね / それまでは我慢、我慢ッ！<b:8b37>れたときはいつでも来なよッ！
rows.re: You see, a long time ago we were... / ...Oh! I forgot, that's a secret...

rows.en: @You can't, you know, until you become more of an adult, like me. Until then...patience, patience!
rows.jp: 「いまを忘れて / 酔いつぶれるのも一興ってモンよ
rows.lit: Forgetting the now and drinking yourself senseless is a pleasure of its own.
rows.re: You can't, you know, until you / become more of an adult, like me. / Until then...patience, patience!

rows.en: @Sometimes you just have to drink 'til you forget everything, ya know...
rows.jp: 「でも、アンタたちには / やらなきゃならないことがあるんだよね / それが終ってからゆっくりしていってよッ！組み合わせだよね
rows.lit: But you've got things you must do, right? Come relax once that's done! (bleed tail: nice pairing)
rows.re: Sometimes you just have to drink / 'til you forget everything, ya / know...

rows.en: @Of course, y'all have things you have to do, I see. You can relax once that's done!
rows.jp: 「あはは〜ッ！ / よければ、この出式いのために / 一<88ec>おごらせてもらおうかなッ！酒におぼえれているなんて思わないでね
rows.re: Of course, y'all have things you / have to do, I see. You can relax / once that's done!

rows.en: @I got an idea! Why don't I treat y'all to a drink to celebrate our acquaintance!
rows.jp: 「誰でも飲みたいときはあるんだからさ〜 / <f040><f041><f042>なんてね<f048> / アタイのガラじゃなかったかな酒の２つの効力を / 結単におしえてあげるよッ！
rows.re: I got an idea! Why don't I treat / y'all to a drink to celebrate our / acquaintance!

rows.en: @Everyone goes through their periods, you see... Wait a sec...What am I saying?
rows.jp: 「お酒は、いやなことをいっとき忘れさせ / うれしいことを / さらにうれしく信じさせてくれるんだよッ！
rows.lit: Drink makes you forget the unpleasant things for a while, and makes the happy things feel happier!
rows.re: Everyone goes through their / periods, you see... Wait a / sec...What am I saying?

rows.en: @It'll make you forget the bad things - for a while - and it'll make the good things better!
rows.jp: 「でも、アタイぐらい / お酒の味がわかるには / まだまだ時間がかかりそうだねッ！種さんは / ずいぶんとお酒に強そうな信じだね
rows.lit: But it'll be a good while yet before I can taste drink the way I do. (bleed: {n} looks like a strong drinker)
rows.re: It'll make you forget the bad / things - for a while - and it'll / make the good things better!

rows.en: @But you have a long way to go until you become an expert like me!
rows.jp: 「よければこんど / アタイと飲み比べでもしてみないか？ / 言っとくけどアタイは強いよぉッ！別、そうだったから / <89a3>伸びをしたい数頃なのはわかるけどさ
rows.re: But you have a long way to go until / you become an expert like me!

rows.en: @Why don't we see next time who can drink who under the table! I warn you, though, I'm pretty good...
rows.jp: 「そのまえに / もっと自分を磨かなくちゃねッ！酒の味がわかるようになってから来なよ
rows.lit: Before that, I've got to polish myself more. Come back once you can appreciate the taste of drink.
rows.re: Why don't we see next time who can / drink who under the table! I warn / you, though, I'm pretty good...

rows.en: @But first you have to get some real experience.
rows.jp: 「そん時を楽しみにしてるからさ<f044>策い目つきをしてるね / まるで別の自分を見ているようだよ
rows.re: But first you have to get some real / experience.

rows.en: @I'll look forward to it...
rows.jp: 「よければ一<88ec>おごらせてもらおうかなッ！ / 別のアタイのような目の人に、乾<88ec>ッ！
rows.re: I'll look forward to it...

rows.en: @Why don't I treat you to a drink? Cheers to my younger self!
rows.jp: 「今回は、なんの用かな？ / 最近はこの前の放着の話ばかりだよね
rows.lit: So what is it this time? Lately it's nothing but talk of that earlier business.
rows.re: Why don't I treat you to a drink? / Cheers to my younger self!

rows.en: @What d'ya want now? All they talk about these days is that broadcast a while ago.
rows.jp: 「それよりさ、せっかく来たんだから / 一<88ec>、ひっかけていかない？ / サービスするよ<f044>婆ちゃんには、まだここは早いかもね / おウチに帰ったほうがいいんじゃない？
rows.re: What d'ya want now? All they talk / about these days is that broadcast / a while ago.

rows.en: @That's gotten old, though. Now that you're here, why don't you put one back on the house?
rows.jp: 「この場に何か目的があるとすれば / テレパスタワー〜〜 / あとはポンポコ谷ってとこかな鳥』みたいなコトをしてたんだけど〜
rows.lit: If there's a target around here, it'd be the Telepath Tower, or maybe Ponpoko Valley. (bleed: I used to do Merc-like work)
rows.re: That's gotten old, though. Now that / you're here, why don't you put one / back on the house?

rows.en: @If they're after something 'round here, it's got to be the Telepath Tower or Mt. Chug-Chug...
rows.jp: 「今じゃすっかり酒場のウェイトレスが / 板についちゃったよ / アタイのエプロン姿なかなかのモンだろ？
rows.lit: Now I've settled right into being a tavern waitress. My apron looks pretty good, don't you think?
rows.re: If they're after something 'round / here, it's got to be the Telepath / Tower or Mt. Chug-Chug...

rows.en: @But now I've settled down into the life of a waitress. Don't you think this apron looks good on me?
rows.jp: 「それからさ、たまにはウチに寄って行きなよ / お宝のシッポを / つかむチャンスがあるかもよ仲間って大事なもんだぜ
rows.lit: And drop by our place now and then; you might get a chance to grab the tail of some treasure. (bleed: comrades matter)
rows.re: But now I've settled down into the / life of a waitress. Don't you think / this apron looks good on me?

rows.en: @Come to think of it, why don't you drop by my house sometime? You might get a lead on that treasure!
rows.jp: 「僕も渡り鳥なんて甘見ないで / 渓谷仲間がいる、このダムツェンで / 何とかやっていくよ鳥デビューは / 早くも<b:8b3e><88dd>してしまったよ〜 / 仲間が誰もノってきてくれないんだ
rows.re: Come to think of it, why don't you / drop by my house sometime? You / might get a lead on that treasure!

rows.en: @I'll not go chasin' dreams of being a Merc. I'll do something here with my miner friends.
rows.jp: 「渡り鳥にデビューするには / いいチャンスかも知れんなッ！鳥になったら / 僕はまず、道に出たいな / ずっと渓谷暮らしだったからな
rows.lit: It might be a good chance to debut as a Merc! (bleed: if I became a rider I'd want to hit the road first, I've lived my whole life in the valley)
rows.re: I'll not go chasin' dreams of being / a Merc. I'll do something here with / my miner friends.

rows.en: @This might be a good chance to become a Merc...
rows.jp: 「それに、道は<89da>いから / お宝のチャンスとか / まだまだありそうだぜッ！
rows.re: This might be a good chance to / become a Merc...

rows.en: @The sea is so big there still might be a chance for me to find some treasure!
rows.jp: 「信応谷の通れない渓谷に / いつまでもしがみついているよりも / いっそ、遺跡でひとやま当てた方が〜鳥になって / 気ままに暮らすってのも悪くないな / 生命の保証は無いけれど〜<b:8b3f>任を考えるか？<b:8b40>地にはもっと / 単のモノが<89db>まっているそうじゃないか？
rows.re: The sea is so big there still might / be a chance for me to find some / treasure!

rows.en: @I'd rather try to make my fortune in a ruin than stick around a dead mine with no more Empathite.
rows.jp: 「そう、お宝だよッ！ / 渡り鳥にでもなって / 渓谷ならぬ、お宝を<885f>りあてようかな？<b:8b40>地へ脱出されたんだぜ
rows.re: I'd rather try to make my fortune / in a ruin than stick around a dead / mine with no more Empathite.

rows.en: @That's it...treasure! I'll become a Merc and dig for treasure, not Empathite!
rows.jp: 「<88c4>上のエアプレーンポートも / 脱出のために / 設けられた<88e4>設なんだぜ<b:8b40>地へ脱出されたんだぜ
rows.re: That's it...treasure! I'll become a / Merc and dig for treasure, not / Empathite!

rows.en: @The airplane port on the peak was built as an export facility, you know.
rows.jp: 「お得意先だったシエルジェ自分<89b7>とは / 地辺のトンネルで / つながっていたんだよな谷に / 任を与えてくれるんなら大<b:8ad0><88cc>だ<b:8b41>地にあった渓谷だ
rows.re: The airplane port on the peak was / built as an export facility, you / know.

rows.en: @And there was a tunnel straight to Sielje, since they were such good customers.
rows.jp: 「まわりは何にもない枯れ地だが / ポンポコ谷から渓谷が通れなくなったから / 本当に何にも無い荒地になっちまった<b:8a97>胞でもないのに / 聞き込みしてまわっているのか？抜け話かい？ / カンタンに<b:8b3f>がっているんなら / 僕がひとくち乗りてェところさ
rows.re: And there was a tunnel straight to / Sielje, since they were such good / customers.

rows.en: @It's surrounded by barren wilderness. Nothing much remains now that the Empathite's gone.
rows.jp: 「あたしだけじゃないッ！
rows.re: It's surrounded by barren / wilderness. Nothing much remains / now that the Empathite's gone.

rows.en: @I'm not the only one!
rows.jp: 「戦う力は無くても / あんたらの力になりたいと考えている人間は / この世界中にたくさんいるはずさ
rows.lit: Even without the power to fight, there must be many people the world over who want to be of help to you.
rows.re: I'm not the only one!

rows.en: @I'm sure there're many people in this world who'd help you out if they had the power to fight.
rows.jp: 「この想いを / 戦う力に<88fb>えることができたら / どんなに、心強いだろうな〜説の時代とは何かが〜
rows.re: I'm sure there're many people in / this world who'd help you out if / they had the power to fight.

rows.en: @If we could turn this desire into actual strength, imagine how strong we'd be...
rows.jp: 「たしかに、ファルガイアは / かつてない絶対の危機にさらされている〜 / でもさ<f040><f042>
rows.re: If we could turn this desire into / actual strength, imagine how strong / we'd be...

rows.en: @Filgaia is facing a danger that could be the end of everything...But still...
rows.jp: 「これまでは、人間の力が<f040><f042> / あんたらＡＲＭＳが / くいとめてくれているんだ
rows.re: Filgaia is facing a danger that / could be the end of / everything...But still...

rows.en: @It seems like normal people, including you all of ARMS, are doing something about it.
rows.jp: 「伝説のように / 依頼の出現を待たずとも / 何とかなるかもしれないッ！<b:8b44>う / 全世界<b:8a47>域の啓示〜
rows.re: It seems like normal people, / including you all of ARMS, are / doing something about it.

rows.en: @We might be able to stop it without waiting for a hero, like in the legends.
rows.jp: 「オデッサなんかとは / 比物にならない未曾作の危機〜
rows.lit: An unprecedented crisis Odessa can't even compare to. (比物->比べ物; 未曾作->未曾有)
rows.re: We might be able to stop it without / waiting for a hero, like in the / legends.

rows.en: @Compared to that, Odessa is nothing!
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアは今〜 / ＜剣の巫女＞を<f040><f042> / 『依頼』を集めているんじゃないかな？剣の巫女＞が<b:8b4b>るったっていう / ガーディアンブレード・アガートラームって / そんなに強力な神獣だったのかな？
rows.re: Compared to that, Odessa is / nothing!

rows.en: @It seems like Filgaia isn't looking for another <Sword Magess> or a |Hero.|
rows.jp: 「古代の幻同獣でもかなわなかった / 『救の啓示』を授けたんだから / すごい神獣なんだろうけれど〜
rows.lit: It granted the 'Revelation of Salvation' that even the ancient phantom-beasts couldn't match, so it must be an amazing divine beast, but... (幻同獣->幻獣)
rows.re: It seems like Filgaia isn't looking / for another <Sword Magess> or a / |Hero.|

rows.en: @Well, it defeated the |Blaze of Disaster,| which none of the other weapons of old did, so it must be.
rows.jp: 「今に残る伝説を / もっと、ひもといてみないと〜<b:8b4d>物を見ていると / ふと考えることがあるよ〜
rows.re: Well, it defeated the |Blaze of / Disaster,| which none of the other / weapons of old did, so it must be.

rows.en: @We should look more deeply into the legends left over from the old times.
rows.jp: 「あんなスゴイものをもってしても / ご先祖方たちは『救の啓示』を / 授けることができなかったんだね〜<b:8b40>地に残る遺跡と枯埋って〜 / 『救の啓示』が頼れまわった / <b:8b4f><b:8b50>みたいなものかもね〜別、ファルガイアは / 空あふれる星だったってさ / 信じられるかい？
rows.re: We should look more deeply into the / legends left over from the old / times.

rows.en: @Even wielding something that powerful, our ancestors couldn't defeat the |Blaze of Disaster.|
rows.jp: 「このダムツェンのまわりに / たくさんの木や草が生えていたって / ちょっと想像つかないね枯埋が多いのは / あの『救の啓示』の伝説が / 大きく関係しているらしいね
rows.lit: I can hardly picture Damzen once ringed with trees and grass. (bleed: the barrenness has much to do with that 'Revelation of Salvation' legend; 枯埋->枯れ地)
rows.re: Even wielding something that / powerful, our ancestors couldn't / defeat the |Blaze of Disaster.|

rows.en: @It's hard to imagine a place like Damzen City surrounded by plants and trees...
rows.jp: 「あっという間に / 焼き払われたってのはわかるけど〜
rows.lit: I get that it was burned away in an instant, but...
rows.re: It's hard to imagine a place like / Damzen City surrounded by plants / and trees...

rows.en: @Even if everything was scorched and burned away...
rows.jp: 「あれから時間は流れているのに / どうして空が元に戻らないんだろう？<b:8a6f>は、いただけないねぇ〜 / 〜でも、ひと稼ぎできそうな<888e>信<f044>
rows.re: Even if everything was scorched and / burned away...

rows.en: @...Why hasn't the green returned even after all this time...?
rows.jp: 「[11]おこの場のずっと側[11]ぉにある渓谷〜 / 『ポンポコ谷』の新儀な名前は / ケルテペッキョシルトリンゲロン谷なんだ
rows.lit: The valley way off to the side of this place, 'Ponpoko Valley', has the formal name Keltepekkyoshirtlingeron Valley. (新儀->正式)
rows.re: ...Why hasn't the green returned / even after all this time...?

rows.en: @It's the mine 1far east of here.0 Its Mt. Chug-Chug, but its real name is Keltepekio Siltolingelon.
rows.jp: 「もう、おぼえたよね？<b:8ad9><897f>って話だよ抜け話を探しに来たんだけど / しくじったね〜 / こんなにシケた場とは思わなかったよ
rows.re: It's the mine far east of here. Its / Mt. Chug-Chug, but its real name is / Keltepekio Siltolingelon.

rows.en: @You got it, right?
rows.jp: 「〜ファルガイアの中心から / 始まってるんじゃないかな？
rows.lit: It starts from the center of Filgaia, doesn't it?
rows.re: You got it, right?

rows.en: @...has to come from Filgaia's center. That's what I think.
rows.jp: 「[11]お世界の中央[11]ぉには / 地辺に向かって<89c1>さに伸びている<897f>が / 隠されているんだってさ
rows.re: ...has to come from Filgaia's / center. That's what I think.

rows.en: @They say that at the 1center of the world0 lies a hidden tower built downwards, not upwards.
rows.jp: 「これって〜 / 何か絶対にあると思うよッ！<b:8b56>設ともいえる / ライブエネルギー発<89ca>、レイライン〜
rows.re: They say that at the center of the / world lies a hidden tower built / downwards, not upwards.

rows.en: @I have a feeling it just has to exist!
rows.jp: 「そのレイラインの先には / 『レイポイント』と呼ばれる / 強力な気溜りがあるらしいね
rows.lit: At the end of that ley line there's said to be a powerful pool of energy called a 'Raypoint'.
rows.re: I have a feeling it just has to / exist!

rows.en: @At the ends of the Ralines, they say, lie the Raypoints, where energy pools.
rows.jp: 「[11]おダムツェンの北東[11]ぉにも / レイポイントのひとつが確認されているけど / どうやったら行けるのかわからないんだよ<b:8b57>保設の役<8913>があるらしいね
rows.re: At the ends of the Ralines, they / say, lie the Raypoints, where / energy pools.

rows.en: @A Raypoint has been sighted 1NW of Damzen0, but I wouldn't know how to get there.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>かつて、ファルガイアを<8832>った / ＜剣の巫女＞に関する情報も / 朽ちることなく残っているみたいだよ路は / どこかよどんだ、気味の悪い道なんだ
rows.re: A Raypoint has been sighted NW of / Damzen, but I wouldn't know how to / get there.

rows.en: @There will be more information about the <Sword Magess> there than any place else.
rows.jp: 「<89d3>乗りたちも / おっかながって / 近寄らないって話だよ
rows.re: There will be more information / about the <Sword Magess> there than / any place else.

rows.en: @The sailors are scared of it, too. They won't get near it.
rows.jp: 「全部で４つあるうちのひとつは / 道からにょっきり建っているそうだ業とする場があるんだ
rows.lit: One of the four in all is said to jut straight up out of the sea. (bleed tail)
rows.re: The sailors are scared of it, too. / They won't get near it.

rows.en: @One of the four of them is said to rise above the sea.
rows.jp: 「その場の名はホルスト〜 / でも、聞いた話じゃ / オデッサにねらわれているんだってさ
rows.lit: That place is called Holst. But from what I hear, it's being targeted by Odessa.
rows.re: One of the four of them is said to / rise above the sea.

rows.en: @It's called Holst. I heard that Odessa was after it, though.
rows.jp: 「<89e7>の名前はリキキス〜 / 『<88db><88dc>が流した涙』って意味らしいね
rows.re: It's called Holst. I heard that / Odessa was after it, though.

rows.en: @The river is called the Likikis, which they say means |Tears of the Desert.|
rows.jp: 「[11]お祈<89af>の真ん中[11]ぉに結界を張って / 誰にも術式施<89b1>のジャマを / されないようにしているらしいね騒がせ連中が / この地方を後にするとすれば〜
rows.re: The river is called the Likikis, / which they say means |Tears of the / Desert.|

rows.en: @They've got barriers around their laboratory 1in the middle of the snow-fields0 so no one can intrude.
rows.jp: 「ポンポコ谷がクサイと / あたいはにらんだね平く渡り鳥さ
rows.lit: I've got my eye on Ponpoko Valley as suspicious. (bleed: I'm just a plain Merc; 平く->ただの?)
rows.re: They've got barriers around their / laboratory in the middle of the / snow-fields so no one can intrude.

rows.en: @I think they just might aim for Mt. Chug-Chug.
rows.jp: 「ひとりはいいよ〜 / いつでも自由だし / 何より気ままで、肩がこらない<b:8b5b>な行<b:8a58>は<b:8b37>労が溜まるだけです
rows.lit: Being alone is fine; always free, and above all easygoing, no stiff shoulders.
rows.re: I think they just might aim for Mt. / Chug-Chug.

rows.en: @I love being alone. No one bugs me, and I can do whatever I please.
rows.jp: 「おひとり方につき一緒[02]ギャラ / [02]人方ですので、[02]ギャラとなりますが / よろしいですか？[18]か
rows.lit: It's one Gella per person, and for {n} people that's {n} Gella. Is that all right? (02 = number slots, 18 prompt)
rows.re: I love being alone. No one bugs me, / and I can do whatever I please.

rows.en: @We charge Gella per night per guest. For people, that will be Gella. OK?2
rows.jp: 「だったら / わらわの言うことを聞くがよい<b:8a39>の分<89d2>で / 生意気な口をききおるわッ！
rows.re: We charge Gella per night per / guest. For people, that will be / Gella. OK?2

rows.en: @If you do, you'll listen to me with utmost care.
rows.jp: 「わらわの知る権り / スレイハイム解放戦役以降 / あの面儀の飛空機艇を保作している者は無い
rows.lit: As far as I know, no one has kept that peculiar flying machine in service since the Slayheim Liberation War. (面儀->? 'peculiar type'; 保作->保有)
rows.re: If you do, you'll listen to me with / utmost care.

rows.en: @As far as I know, no country has used that type of flying machine since the Slayheim Liberation Army.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>となれば / あとはわかるじゃろう〜
rows.re: As far as I know, no country has / used that type of flying machine / since the Slayheim Liberation Army.

rows.en: @So...you should be able to figure out the rest...
rows.jp: 「でも、キミは / なぜそんなに<88a9>しいんだ？ / どうして俺たちに、その情報を？
rows.re: So...you should be able to figure / out the rest...

rows.en: @But why would you know so much about such things? And why would you give the information to us?
rows.jp: 「〜いや、それ以前に / キミは、いったい誰なんだ？
rows.lit: ...No, before that, who on earth are you?
rows.re: But why would you know so much / about such things? And why would / you give the information to us?

rows.en: @Wait...before that...who are you?
rows.jp: 「紫外線はおハダの大相ゆえ / 着ぐるみ抱しにチラっと / 探と名前をサービスじゃッ！
rows.lit: Ultraviolet is the great foe of the skin, so from inside this costume I'll flash you a glimpse of my face and name as a treat! (探->顔 corrupt)
rows.re: Wait...before that...who are you?

rows.en: @Beware of ultraviolet rays! I'll tell you my face and name from within this protective costume!
rows.jp: 「思い出すがよい
rows.re: Beware of ultraviolet rays! I'll / tell you my face and name from / within this protective costume!

rows.en: @You should remember...
rows.jp: 「それなのに / なぜ、キミは俺の名前を〜？
rows.lit: And yet, why do you know my name...?
rows.re: You should remember...

rows.en: @And...how do you know my name?
rows.jp: 「いたしかたあるまい〜 / それよりも / ヤツらのこと任せたぞ
rows.lit: It can't be helped. More to the point, I leave those fellows to you.
rows.re: And...how do you know my name?

rows.en: @Oh well...it's not a big deal, I guess... I'll leave the other matter up to you!

rows.en: @As far as I know, no country has used that type of flying machine since the Slayheim Liberation Army.
rows.jp: 「紫外線はおハダの大相ゆえ / 着ぐるみ抱しにチラっと / 探と名前をサービスじゃッ！
rows.lit: Ultraviolet is the great foe of the skin, so from inside this costume I'll flash my face and name as a treat! (dup of 3406)
rows.re: As far as I know, no country has / used that type of flying machine / since the Slayheim Liberation Army.

rows.en: @So...you should be able to figure out the rest...
rows.jp: 「思い出すがよい
rows.re: So...you should be able to figure / out the rest...

rows.en: @But why would you know so much about such things? And why would you give the information to us?
rows.jp: 「それなのに / なぜ、キミは俺の名前を〜？
rows.lit: And yet, why do you know my name...? (dup of 3408)
rows.re: But why would you know so much / about such things? And why would / you give the information to us?

rows.en: @Wait...before that...who are you?
rows.jp: 「いたしかたあるまい〜 / それよりも / ヤツらのこと任せたぞ
rows.lit: It can't be helped. More to the point, I leave those fellows to you. (dup of 3409)
rows.re: Wait...before that...who are you?

rows.en: @Beware of ultraviolet rays! I'll tell you my face and name from within this protective costume!
rows.jp: 「古代の幻同獣でもかなわなかった / 『救の啓示』を授けたんだから / すごい神獣なんだろうけれど〜
rows.lit: It granted the 'Revelation of Salvation' that even the ancient phantom-beasts couldn't match, so it must be an amazing divine beast, but... (dup of 3379)
rows.re: Beware of ultraviolet rays! I'll / tell you my face and name from / within this protective costume!

rows.en: @You should remember...
rows.jp: 「今に残る伝説を / もっと、ひもといてみないと〜<b:8b4d>物を見ていると / ふと考えることがあるよ〜
rows.re: You should remember...

rows.en: @And...how do you know my name?
rows.jp: 「あんなスゴイものをもってしても / ご先祖方たちは『救の啓示』を / 授けることができなかったんだね〜<b:8b40>地に残る遺跡と枯埋って〜 / 『救の啓示』が頼れまわった / <b:8b4f><b:8b50>みたいなものかもね〜別、ファルガイアは / 空あふれる星だったってさ / 信じられるかい？
rows.re: And...how do you know my name?

rows.en: @Oh well...it's not a big deal, I guess... I'll leave the other matter up to you!
rows.jp: 「このダムツェンのまわりに / たくさんの木や草が生えていたって / ちょっと想像つかないね枯埋が多いのは / あの『救の啓示』の伝説が / 大きく関係しているらしいね
rows.lit: I can hardly picture Damzen once ringed with trees and grass. (dup of 3382)
rows.re: Oh well...it's not a big deal, I / guess... I'll leave the other / matter up to you!

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
@Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません

rows.en: *Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: ＊〜ですが、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません

rows.en: @If you have lost something, then you should strive to find something else.
rows.jp: 「何かを無くしたのなら / そこから何かを / 押い上げるようにしなくては〜
rows.lit: If you've lost something, then from there you must strive to pick something up. (JP 押い上げる->拾い上げる corrupt)
rows.re: If you have lost something, then / you should strive to find something / else.

rows.en: @Maybe time flows quicker for objects that posses power?
rows.jp: 「過ぎた力を持つということは / 時間の流れが / 乗りよりも早くなるということなの？<b:8a38>気のいい回には / [11]おホルストから道を<89ae>てた<8995>か北[11]ぉに / とても高い<897f>がボンヤリ見えますよ
rows.re: Maybe time flows quicker for / objects that posses power?

rows.en: @When that happens, the miners come out in full force to kill the beasts.
rows.jp: 「そんな時は / この場の渓<b:8a39>たちが<b:8a3a>出で / 追い<b:8a3b>いに行くんだけどね<b:8a3c>らないわ〜
rows.re: When that happens, the miners come / out in full force to kill the / beasts.

rows.en: @There must be new monsters coming from somewhere...
rows.jp: 「もしかして / どこからか、新しいモンスターが / やってきているのかしら〜<b:8a3d>通、渓<b:8a39>になるのなら / ツルハシや発破のあつかいを / おぼえるもんだけどね〜
rows.re: There must be new monsters coming / from somewhere...

rows.en: @But here in Holst, miners learn how to fight as part of their trade.
rows.jp: 「ここホルストじゃ / 戦いのやり方も / いっしょにおぼえなくちゃいけないんだよ
rows.lit: Here in Holst, you have to learn how to fight along with your trade.
rows.re: But here in Holst, miners learn how / to fight as part of their trade.

rows.en: @It's the |Ruins Mine,| you see.
rows.jp: 「何てったって / ここは『遺跡渓谷』だからね<b:8a3e>にある渓<89f4>を<b:8a3a><895b>して / 『遺跡渓谷』と呼んでいます
rows.re: It's the |Ruins Mine,| you see.

rows.en: @When you go far down the mine shaft, stone walls begin to appear. That's where the valuable ore is.
rows.jp: 「<89cc>道を<892a>に進んでいくと / <b:8a3f>中から古い谷<b:8a40>が見えてくるそうです / <b:8a41><8875>のある渓谷は、その付近より通れるとか<b:8a42>一<89e8>は / 単名『遺跡渓谷』って / 呼ばれているんです
rows.re: When you go far down the mine / shaft, stone walls begin to appear. / That's where the valuable ore is.

rows.en: @Unlike far Damzen City, they don't mine ores, but Energy Crystals stored in ruins.
rows.jp: 「<8a10>いダムツェンのように<b:8a38><8844>の渓谷ではなく / 遺跡に<b:8a43>えられたエネルギーの結<b:8a44>体を / <885f>り出しているんですって<b:8a45>いで何とかなるもんだ
rows.re: Unlike far Damzen City, they don't / mine ores, but Energy Crystals / stored in ruins.

rows.en: @We can't give up on this planet while it's still got life left on it.
rows.jp: 「まだ、この星の命は終っちゃいねぇ〜 / みっともなくても / あがいてみるだけの<b:8a41><8875>はあるはずだ
rows.re: We can't give up on this planet / while it's still got life left on / it.

rows.en: @And there are said to be abundant resources there, such as ores.
rows.jp: 「そこでは、渓谷をはじめ / いろんな<b:8a46><8869>が<b:8a47><b:8a48>に通れるって話だ
rows.re: And there are said to be abundant / resources there, such as ores.

rows.en: @These energy collection points within the earth are called Raypoints.
rows.jp: 「そういう地<89f4>の終着帯を / レイポイントと呼ぶらしい〜
rows.re: These energy collection points / within the earth are called / Raypoints.

rows.en: @We can't let ourselves feel already defeated.
rows.jp: 「そうしないと / 考え方まで辺降<b:8a49>をたどっちまうぜ<b:8a4a>の無いオデッサが / 大<886f>のエネルギーを<8880>めるとなると / いったいどんな方法なんだ？
rows.re: We can't let ourselves feel already / defeated.

rows.en: @It might not just be a rumor that Odessa is looking for an energy source...
rows.jp: 「だけどよ、オデッサのヤツらが / エネルギーを<b:8a4b>めているのは / あながちデマではないと思うぞ
rows.re: It might not just be a rumor that / Odessa is looking for an energy / source...

rows.en: @Neither miners nor terrorists can do very much on an empty stomach....
rows.jp: 「渓<b:8a39>もテロリストも / <b:8a4c>が空いていると / 力が入らないのはいっしょだからな
rows.re: Neither miners nor terrorists can / do very much on an empty / stomach....

rows.en: @There's a rumor that the terrorists are after this town's ore...
rows.jp: 「テロリストがこの場の渓谷を / ねらっているってウワサ〜
rows.lit: There's a rumor the terrorists are after the ore of this valley.
rows.re: There's a rumor that the terrorists / are after this town's ore...

rows.en: @They're amateurs, though. They're after the mine to the 1northeast0 of town.
rows.jp: 「だけど、所<b:8a4d>はシロートよ / 連中のねらいは / この場の[11]お北側にある[11]ぉ<89cc>道〜
rows.re: They're amateurs, though. They're / after the mine to the northeast of / town.

rows.en: @Or should I say the OLD mine that used to operate on the 1northeast0 side of town.
rows.jp: 「新しくは / [11]おこの場の北側[11]ぉにあった<b:8a4e><89cc>道を / ねらっているみたいなんだな
rows.re: Or should I say the OLD mine that / used to operate on the northeast / side of town.

rows.en: @Seems to me that going after an old closed-down mine is pretty foolish...
rows.jp: 「すでに閉<b:8a4f>された / <b:8a4e><89cc>道をねらうなんて / まぬけというか、何というか〜<b:8a4e><89cc>道をねらうなんて / オデッサは所<b:8a4d>シロート / 渓谷に関しては僕たちの<b:8a50>ちだッ！<b:8a4e><89cc>道へは / ここからじゃ<b:8a51>いていけないぞ
rows.re: Seems to me that going after an old / closed-down mine is pretty / foolish...

rows.en: @You have to get there by boat from the north shore of the island.
rows.jp: 「一度、<89d3>に<b:8a52>って / この他の北の海岸から / 向かわなくてはいけないのだ
rows.re: You have to get there by boat from / the north shore of the island.

rows.en: @Don't think too much, just do lots of physical labor. Becoming a terrorist will never occur to you.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a53>しいことなんて考えないで / カラダだけを動かしていれば / テロなんて起こす気にもならないもんだ
rows.re: Don't think too much, just do lots / of physical labor. Becoming a / terrorist will never occur to you.

rows.en: @Those who don't do physical labor come up with strange ideas... then they lose all morality!
rows.jp: 「カラダを<b:8a54>えてないヤツが / アタマだけで考えてるから / <b:8a55>性まがってしまうんだッ！<b:8a54>えてない<b:8a56><b:8a57>が / <b:8a58><b:8a59>なんぞにたよって通<885f>するんだ
rows.re: Those who don't do physical labor / come up with strange ideas... then / they lose all morality!

rows.en: @Just the other day I kicked a bomb maniac out of my inn.
rows.jp: 「このあいだも / マニアな<b:8a5a><89b9>モノを / <b:8a5b><b:8a5c>から<b:8a5d>き出してやったわい<b:8a5e><b:8a5f> / <b:8a54>えに<b:8a54>えたチカラとワザがあれば / <b:8a58><b:8a59>いらずの通<885f>が可能だッ！
rows.re: Just the other day I kicked a bomb / maniac out of my inn.

rows.en: @A dream come true. Right, little miss?
rows.jp: 「<b:8a60>のようだろ？ / お<b:8a61>ちゃん<b:8a54>えろッ！ / <b:8a58><b:8a59>なんかにたよって通<885f>するヤツは / <b:8a5b><b:8a5c>から<b:8a5d>き出してやるぞッ！<b:8a62>な空に / 終りは来ないのだろうか？
rows.re: A dream come true. Right, little / miss?

rows.en: @...And Filgaia will never feel the light of the sun again. No, I can't let myself believe that!
rows.jp: 「そして、終りが<b:8a64>れるのは / ファルガイアの未来〜 / <f040><f042>なんてことはないだろうな〜<b:8a65>と<88d2>数ッ！
rows.re: ...And Filgaia will never feel the / light of the sun again. No, I can't / let myself believe that!

rows.en: @I've never seen anything like this sky, though.
rows.jp: 「〜だけど / こんな空域方は見たことがねぇ〜<b:8a66>人相手に / ケンカの<b:8a67>前自<b:8a68>しても / やっぱりプロにはかなわねぇ〜
rows.re: I've never seen anything like this / sky, though.

rows.en: @I'll leave Odessa up to others, thank you very much!
rows.jp: 「オデッサを相手にするのは / もう、けっこうだよ<b:8a69><b:8a45>なヤツは / なかなかいないもんだぜ
rows.re: I'll leave Odessa up to others, / thank you very much!

rows.en: @Us miners are all scrappers, so they wouldn't get away with their skins, if you know what I mean!
rows.jp: 「なんせ、僕たち渓<b:8a39> / 全<b:8a39>が<b:8a67>自<b:8a68>ときたもんだ / ケガじゃあ、すまないぜ
rows.re: Us miners are all scrappers, so / they wouldn't get away with their / skins, if you know what I mean!

rows.en: @But there's no place to dock a ship close by, so it's difficult to export what we mine.
rows.jp: 「ただ、<89d3>を<b:8a6a>せる / 海岸が近くに無いから / <b:8a6b>出に不<b:8a6c>なのがイタイな<b:8a6d><b:8a6e>ヶ<b:8a6f>ッ！
rows.re: But there's no place to dock a ship / close by, so it's difficult to / export what we mine.

rows.en: @1. Narrow, dark places have good ore! 2. Never walk away from a fight!
rows.jp: 「その１ 暗いの、<b:8a70>いの<b:8a71>がらないッ！ / その２ ケンカに<b:8a72>けるなッ！ / その３ じゃまな<b:8a73>には発破をかけろッ！
rows.re: . Narrow, dark places have good / ore! 2. Never walk away from a / fight!

rows.en: @We can't see into the future of Filgaia, either... What will happen to us, I wonder?
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアの未来だって / これっぽっちも見えやしない〜 / どうなっちまうんだろう〜<b:8a74>同<b:8a75>を使う度<89e5>なんて / 無かったんじゃないかな〜？
rows.re: We can't see into the future of / Filgaia, either... What will happen / to us, I wonder?

rows.en: @Sometimes when you start a fight, you don't know how to back out of it without losing face. I know.
rows.jp: 「ケンカをおっぱじめてから / <b:8a76>り上げた<b:8a77>の降ろす先に / <b:8a78>っちまうことってあるだろ？
rows.re: Sometimes when you start a fight, / you don't know how to back out of / it without losing face. I know.

rows.en: @I bet that was it!
rows.jp: 「そういうもんじゃなかったのかな？<b:8a79>われる』〜
rows.re: I bet that was it!

rows.en: @I forget who it was that said that, but the description fits all too well...
rows.jp: 「どこの誰が / 言い出しっぺなのか忘れたけど / 実に言いえて<8a22>だな〜<b:8a7a>力に<b:8a7b>えてちゃ / できる<b:8a7c>達も、できないぞッ！<b:8a7d>人にとって / <b:8a7e>通の相だぜッ！
rows.re: I forget who it was that said that, / but the description fits all too / well...

rows.en: @Something I first realized when they came attacking my own village...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>って、自分の場が攻われて / やっと実信できたな〜来る前に / とっとと帰りな〜
rows.re: Something I first realized when / they came attacking my own / village...

rows.en: @There are fierce monsters that inhabit the area around Holst.
rows.jp: 「ホルストの渓<89f4>には / おっかないモンスターがいっぱいだ<b:8a39>連中は / 元渡り<b:8a7f>ってヤツがほとんどさ
rows.re: There are fierce monsters that / inhabit the area around Holst.

rows.en: @That's because in Holst you have to be able to deal with monsters.
rows.jp: 「ホルストじゃ / モンスター相手に<b:8a67>っぷしも / 必要とされるからな
rows.re: That's because in Holst you have to / be able to deal with monsters.

rows.en: @The chaos is what people here love about it.
rows.jp: 「ホルストは / <88ad>全自由通<885f>が大きな結<b:8a80>なのさ
rows.re: The chaos is what people here love / about it.

rows.en: @If you can mine and watch your back for monsters at the same time, then you're set in this town!
rows.jp: 「つまり、モンスターがうようよいる渓<89f4>で / 自分の身を<b:8a81>りつつ、通<885f>ができるヤツに / どーんと開放しているんだ<b:8a82>の<b:8a83>きは失われちゃいませんッ！
rows.re: If you can mine and watch your back / for monsters at the same time, then / you're set in this town!

rows.en: @We can still do something to save ourselves! Now is the time to fight, not to give in!
rows.jp: 「これならまだ / どんな脅威にも立ち向かえますッ！ / あきらめちゃダメですよッ！
rows.lit: With this much, we can still stand against any threat! Don't give up!
rows.re: We can still do something to save / ourselves! Now is the time to / fight, not to give in!

rows.en: @You all are fighting to protect Filgaia, too?
rows.jp: 「みなさんも / ファルガイアを<b:8a81>る / 新義の<b:8a84>方だったんですね
rows.re: You all are fighting to protect / Filgaia, too?

rows.en: @Defenders of Justice like us should stick together, right?
rows.jp: 「これからは / お<b:8a85>い、新義の<b:8a84>方同胞 / <b:8a86>力していきましょうッ！<b:8a87><b:8a88>に思うことがあるんだ〜
rows.re: Defenders of Justice like us should / stick together, right?

rows.en: @...Filgaia is waiting - hoping - for someone to step forward and protect it.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアは今〜 / 新義の<b:8a84>方の<b:8a89>場を / <b:8a8a>んでいるんじゃないかって
rows.re: ...Filgaia is waiting - hoping - / for someone to step forward and / protect it.

rows.en: @Yes... A Defender of Justice like me, right?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>そう〜 / ボクのような新義の<b:8a84>方を、ね〜<b:8a72>けないよね？ / <b:8a8b><b:8a8c>大怪獣<b:8a8d><897d>（？）なんかに / <b:8a8e>したりしないよね？
rows.re: Yes... A Defender of Justice like / me, right?

rows.en: @It won't all end like this, right?
rows.jp: 「このまま / 終っちゃうなんてことないよね？<b:8a8f>の安定を<b:8a8a>んで渓<b:8a39>になるべきか / 新義の<b:8a84>方になって / <8a2b>険<b:8a90><b:8a91>に<b:8a69>いしれるか〜
rows.re: It won't all end like this, right?

rows.en: @Only children can dream about the future so freely, you know.
rows.jp: 「未来を自由に<b:8a60>見られるのは / 家族だけの結<88b2>なんだよ<b:8a39>になるか / 新義の<b:8a84>方の<b:8a60>を追い<8a18>けるか〜 / ボクなりに<b:8a87><b:8a88>に考えているんだよ<b:8a92><b:8a93>も / キミの<b:8a94>せも / 悪の<b:8a8d><897d>にねらわれているんだって
rows.re: Only children can dream about the / future so freely, you know.

rows.en: @We must do something now, or regret our inaction later! We boys and girls won't be bullied around!
rows.jp: 「今こそ、いっしょに立ち上がろうッ！ / 新しい、少数少女の心は / 悪者なんかに<b:8a72>けないぞッ！<b:8a92><b:8a93>をおびやかす / 悪の<b:8a95><b:8a96>の魔の手が / ボクたちに<b:8a97>び<b:8a6a>っているんだって
rows.re: We must do something now, or regret / our inaction later! We boys and / girls won't be bullied around!

rows.en: @Do not fear, though. I will become a Defender of Justice and protect you all!
rows.jp: 「でも、安心して / ボクが新義の<b:8a84>方になって / やっつけてあげるよ<b:8a98><b:8a99>儀の大<b:8a9a><b:8a73><89cd><885f><b:8a9b>機だよ
rows.re: Do not fear, though. I will become / a Defender of Justice and protect / you all!

rows.en: @The force from the explosives drives a metal stake into the stone and splits it apart.
rows.jp: 「発破の<b:8a9c>撃で / <b:8a9d>く、強力な<b:8a9e>の一撃を<b:8a9f>り出して / カッコよく<b:8a73>を<b:8aa0>くんだって<b:8a73>をぶっ飛ばす機艇があるんだって
rows.re: The force from the explosives / drives a metal stake into the stone / and splits it apart.

rows.en: @That's so cool... I wish I were a grown-up so I could use one...
rows.jp: 「カッコいいよな〜 / オトナだけでひとり<b:8aa1>めするなんて / ズルイや〜
rows.re: That's so cool... I wish I were a / grown-up so I could use one...

rows.en: @I know it doesn't mean much, but it makes me feel better until the danger passes.
rows.jp: 「そうすれば、少し心が強くなった気がします / 不安や<b:8a71>れが<b:8aa2>かながら / <b:8aa3>れていくような気がするのです
rows.re: I know it doesn't mean much, but it / makes me feel better until the / danger passes.

rows.en: @We adults can't even guarantee our children a world to grow up in...
rows.jp: 「わたしたち大人は / これからを生きていく家族たちに / 未来すら<b:8aa4>えられないのでしょうか？来には不安や<b:8a71>れが / ありませんように〜
