rows.re: We adults can't even guarantee our / children a world to grow up in...

rows.en: @That's what I pray for, but when I look up at the sky...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>そう<b:8aa5>ってきましたが / あの空を見ていると〜<b:8aa6>らした枯<b:8aa7>をかぶるのは誰？
rows.re: That's what I pray for, but when I / look up at the sky...

rows.en: @It's the weak people, the bystanders. Am I wrong?
rows.jp: 「それは、<89b9>い人たち / どうすることもできない<b:8aa8>観者たち〜 / <f040><f042>違いますか？
rows.re: It's the weak people, the / bystanders. Am I wrong?

rows.en: @But it seems to me that the light of your goodness only makes Odessa's shadow blacker...
rows.jp: 「オデッサの<88c0>を<b:8aa9>らそうとする / あなたたちの<89e0>が強すぎるから / ヤツらはより、<b:8aaa>い<88c0>となるのでは？
rows.re: But it seems to me that the light / of your goodness only makes / Odessa's shadow blacker...

rows.en: @What happens to us when darkness and light destroy everything in their path?
rows.jp: 「強い<89e0>と<88c0>が<88fa><b:8aab>する中 / 何もできない私たちは / どうなっていくのでしょうか〜<b:8a8f>に / <b:8aac>足で<b:8aad>み込んでくるテロリスト
rows.re: What happens to us when darkness / and light destroy everything in / their path?

rows.en: @I cannot forgive them, but neither can I do anything against them. What are weak people to do?
rows.jp: 「<8978>すことはできません / 〜でも、<b:8aae>うこともままなりません / <89b9>い人間は、どうしたらいいのでしょう？
rows.re: I cannot forgive them, but neither / can I do anything against them. / What are weak people to do?

rows.en: @But you can't go unnoticed from Holst to the Aguel Mine Shaft.
rows.jp: 「でも、ホルストの場中にある / アグエル<89cc>道に向かうには / たくさんの人目についてしまいます
rows.re: But you can't go unnoticed from / Holst to the Aguel Mine Shaft.

rows.en: @If they were after something, it would more likely be the old unused mine shaft.
rows.jp: 「ねらうとすれば / かつて<885f>っていた / <b:8a4e><89cc>道なんかではないでしょうか？<b:8a8f>動していなければ / 今ごろはあなただって / こんなことをしていなかったはず
rows.re: If they were after something, it / would more likely be the old unused / mine shaft.

rows.en: @It's because of adults that children go to war. Something is wrong with the world...
rows.jp: 「家族が戦場に出て行くなんて / やっぱり、大人たちの<b:8aaf>任です / 何かがどこかで、まちがったのですね<b:8ab0>がしているオデッサって / いつか、<8934><88e0>ジャックをおこなった / あのテロリストたちなんでしょ？
rows.re: It's because of adults that / children go to war. Something is / wrong with the world...

rows.en: @I can't do anything but worry about the future of Filgaia. My children, you see...
rows.jp: 「うちの家が<b:8ab1>らしていく / ファルガイアの未来が / 心配でたまりません〜<b:8ab2>び<b:8a7c>達がいなくて<b:8a78>っています
rows.re: I can't do anything but worry about / the future of Filgaia. My children, / you see...

rows.en: @I wonder if my son will become a Merc, too? I hope not...
rows.jp: 「まさか、うちの家も / 渡り<b:8a7f>になってしまうんじゃ〜<b:8ab3>で<b:8ab4>古の遺跡と / <b:8ab5>がっているそうです
rows.re: I wonder if my son will become a / Merc, too? I hope not...

rows.en: @That's why Energy Crystals are there in the first place.
rows.jp: 「だからエネルギー渓谷だなんて / 不思議なものが / 通れるんでしょうね〜<b:8a81>れば / ファルガイアを全部<b:8a81>れるよ
rows.re: That's why Energy Crystals are / there in the first place.

rows.en: @Why doesn't everybody realize this simple thing?
rows.jp: 「どうしてみんな / そんな<b:8ab6><b:8ab7>なことに / 気がつかないのかな？<b:8ab8>さんを<b:8a81>ってあげるんだッ！
rows.re: Why doesn't everybody realize this / simple thing?

rows.en: @I'm not sure if I can protect anybody besides her, though...
rows.jp: 「〜でも、お<b:8ab8>さん以外を / <b:8a81>りきれる自信は、ちょっと無いかも〜<b:8ab8>さんがね / お発方が見つからないって / つぶやいていたんだ
rows.re: I'm not sure if I can protect / anybody besides her, though...

rows.en: @I don't know what to tell her...
rows.jp: 「ボクはね / お<b:8ab8>さんに、何て言っていいのかが / 見つからないよ〜<b:8a71>い人が / やってきてたいへんだったけど / ボク、<b:8ab9>かなかったよッ！
rows.re: I don't know what to tell her...

rows.en: @'Cause...if I started crying...then Mama would too for sure!
rows.jp: 「だって、ボクが<b:8ab9>いちゃうと / お<b:8ab8>さんまで / <b:8ab9>いちゃうかもしれないからね<b:8a71>い人たちがやってくるから / お外に出ちゃダメなんだって
rows.re: 'Cause...if I started crying...then / Mama would too for sure!

rows.en: @Mama worries a lot... It's alright, though. I'll protect her.
rows.jp: 「お<b:8ab8>さんは心配性だなぁ〜 / だいじょうぶ / ボクが<b:8a81>ってあげるから<b:8a71>い人たちが / ホルストをねらっているんだって
rows.re: Mama worries a lot... It's alright, / though. I'll protect her.

rows.en: @I guess it's not because they heard I was bad...?
rows.jp: 「ひょっとして / ボクがあんまりかわいいから〜？<b:8aac>の辺には / 渓谷がザクザク<89db>まっているんだって
rows.re: I guess it's not because they heard / I was bad...?

rows.en: @But the thing that might be our real treasure isn't buried at all.
rows.jp: 「でも、ボクたちの / <b:8aba>物になりそうなものは / <89db>まっていないみたいなんだよ
rows.re: But the thing that might be our / real treasure isn't buried at all.

rows.en: @I want to grow up quick!
rows.jp: 「早くオトナになりたいな<b:8aac>の辺には / 渓谷がザクザク<89db>まっているんだって
rows.re: I want to grow up quick!

rows.en: @All the men say they have lots of fun digging for crystal and killing monsters.
rows.jp: 「おじさんたちは、渓谷を<885f>り出したり / モンスターをぶちのめしたりして / <8945><b:8a7a>者な生<b:8a8f>をマンキツしてるんだって<b:8abb><b:8a8e>で、どこまでいっても暗い世界 / いっそ誰かが<b:8abc>やし<b:8abd>くしてくれれば / 僕も楽なんだけどな〜<b:8a8f>をしてたヤツらが / うらやましいぜ<b:8aad>み込んでくるヤツ、みんなキライ
rows.re: All the men say they have lots of / fun digging for crystal and killing / monsters.

rows.en: @There's some Aguelite there to be mined, but not much.
rows.jp: 「そこからは / エネルギー渓谷『アグエライト』が / わずかだけれど通れるぞ<b:8a4e><89cc>道の東[11]ぉに / 古い遺跡があったんですよ
rows.re: There's some Aguelite there to be / mined, but not much.

rows.en: @It's different than the ruin that lies underneath this town, so it could hold a new discovery...
rows.jp: 「この他の地辺に<89bb>っている遺跡とは / 少し<b:8ac4>が違うので / ひょっとしたら、新しい発見があるかも？
rows.re: It's different than the ruin that / lies underneath this town, so it / could hold a new discovery...

rows.en: @I really want to help!
rows.jp: 「みなさんの / お役に立ちたいんですッ！<b:8b03><b:8a42>の<b:8a38>変地異だなんて〜 / 何も俺が生きているあいだに〜<b:8b03><b:8a88>の<b:8ac5>女＞に関する<8937><8938>を保存した / 遺跡があるらしいんだ
rows.re: I really want to help!

rows.en: @I bet the <Sword Magess> could do something to get rid of this cursed sky!
rows.jp: 「この異世な空〜 / ＜<b:8a88>の<b:8ac5>女＞なら / 何とかしてくれるのだろうか〜<b:8a8c>[03]来るってウワサが流れて以来 / 一部の人たちが<b:8ac6>り上がっているんですよ
rows.re: I bet the <Sword Magess> could do / something to get rid of this cursed / sky!

rows.en: @Some people are easily deceived.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a78>った人たちです<b:8ac7>の遺跡が谷の中にあるそうです
rows.re: Some people are easily deceived.

rows.en: @I can't imagine the whole inside of the mountain being one big ruin!
rows.jp: 「谷の中全体が遺跡だなんて / なんか想<b:8ac8>もつかないですけどね<b:8b8d>[03]<b:8ac7>の遺跡が谷の中にあるそうです
rows.re: I can't imagine the whole inside of / the mountain being one big ruin!

rows.en: @They're mining the Energy Crystals from the old ruins as ore. It's like petrified energy.
rows.jp: 「その<b:8ac7>の遺跡にあるエネルギーの結<b:8a44>を / 渓谷として<885f>り<b:8ac9>してるらしいです / いうなればエネルギーの合谷ですかねぇ
rows.re: They're mining the Energy Crystals / from the old ruins as ore. It's / like petrified energy.

rows.en: @But if you're going to be doing mining in Holst, you'll need some explosives.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも〜 / ホルストで通<885f>をするつもりなら / 発破のひとつは必要さ<b:8a58><b:8a59>のこと / 僕たちはそう呼んでるんだよ<b:8aca>えた道に / とぐろを<8812>いたような他があるらしい
rows.re: But if you're going to be doing / mining in Holst, you'll need some / explosives.

rows.en: @There are places called Raypoints where the veins and arteries of the earth come together.
rows.jp: 「何でも、地<89f4>の<8880>中しているポイントで / そこは、レイポイントと呼ばれる / ファルガイアのヘソみたいな所と聞くぜ
rows.re: There are places called Raypoints / where the veins and arteries of the / earth come together.

rows.en: @My life hasn't changed that much.
rows.jp: 「僕の生<b:8a8f>は、何も変わらないよ<b:8acb>が起きているみたいだな / 〜この空のように〜<b:8acc>にならねぇよ / <b:8acd>身に<b:8ace>みたぜ<b:8a67>には自信があったけど / オデッサばかりはいけねぇよ
rows.re: My life hasn't changed that much.

rows.en: @They're ruthless, you see. They don't follow the rules.
rows.jp: 「あいつら、ルール無用で / ムチャクチャやりやがる〜
rows.lit: Those guys ignore all the rules and do whatever they please.
rows.re: They're ruthless, you see. They / don't follow the rules.

rows.en: @Yes, there was a small one to the 1NE of town0, I think.
rows.jp: 「そう、[11]お場の北側[11]ぉにも / 小さな渓<89f4>があったはずだ
rows.re: Yes, there was a small one to the / NE of town, I think.

rows.en: @But there's not much to be mined, and you have to use a boat, so no one's using it now.
rows.jp: 「でも、あんまりいい渓谷が通れないし / いちいち<89d3>に<b:8a52>らなきゃいけないので / 今は閉ざされてしまったよ<b:8acf>義の場 / ケンカと<b:8ad0><885f>りのうまいヤツが / ここではエライのさ
rows.re: But there's not much to be mined, / and you have to use a boat, so no / one's using it now.

rows.en: @Someone once said that the monsters were coming out of the ruins... I wonder if it's true?
rows.jp: 「誰かが、渓<89f4>のモンスターは / 遺跡の中から出て来たって言ってたけど〜 / そういうものなのかな？<b:8ad1><b:8ad2>金を<b:8a60>見た / 発破マニアの渡り<b:8a7f>がやって来たんだ
rows.re: Someone once said that the monsters / were coming out of the ruins... I / wonder if it's true?

rows.en: @He thought he could do anything with enough explosives...
rows.jp: 「発破があると / 通<885f>に何かと<b:8a6c>利だからな / <b:8a8f><b:8ad3>を<b:8ad4>待されてたんだが〜
rows.re: He thought he could do anything / with enough explosives...

rows.en: @He even exploded some in the inn! Got kicked out for it, of course...
rows.jp: 「そいつ、<b:8a5b><b:8a5c>の中でも / 発破を<b:8a58>発させるくらいのマニアだったから / あっというまに<b:8a5d>き出されたんだ
rows.re: He even exploded some in the inn! / Got kicked out for it, of course...

rows.en: @That's why everyone calls him a maniac.
rows.jp: 「これだから、マニアってよ〜<b:8a5c><b:8ad5>備しているみたいだけど、いいの？<b:8ad5>備していくかい？<b:8ad5>備するのかな？<b:8ad6>対に<b:8ac2>いに来てねッ！<b:8ad6>対に<b:8ac2>いに来てねッ！
rows.re: That's why everyone calls him a / maniac.

rows.en: @Our rate is Gella per person a night. For people, that would be Gella.2
rows.jp: 「おひとり方につき一緒[02]ギャラ / [02]人方ですので、[02]ギャラとなります / よろしいですか？[18]か
rows.lit: It's one Gella per person, and for {n} people that comes to {n} Gella. Is that all right? (numbers/name-slots blanked in dump)
rows.re: Our rate is Gella per person a / night. For people, that would be / Gella.2

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か

rows.en: *The old civilization was adept at extracting and refining crystals. They're all under the ruins now.
rows.jp: ＊これは、多くの渓谷は / <b:8a4e>世代の<b:8ae8>次によって<b:8ae9>出・<88ea><b:8aea>され / それが遺跡と<b:8a7e>に<89db>まったと考えられる
rows.re: The old civilization was adept at / extracting and refining crystals. / They're all under the ruins now.

rows.en: *Thus, we are rapidly approaching the point where the ruins won't yield any crystals to the miners.
rows.jp: ＊それ<8808>に、遺跡<b:8aeb>渓谷で発<885f>される渓谷は / その<b:8aec>作<886f>も自ずと<b:8aed>界が早く<b:8a64>れる
rows.re: Thus, we are rapidly approaching / the point where the ruins won't / yield any crystals to the miners.

rows.en: *However, since these crystals are already refined, they are up to 100 X purer than the natural kind.
rows.jp: ＊しかし、<b:8aee>に<88ea><b:8aea>されているものだけに / その<b:8aef>度は、自<8844>渓谷での<b:8af0>出物に比べ / 年<b:8a65><b:8af1>から年<b:8af2><b:8af1>といわれる
rows.re: However, since these crystals are / already refined, they are up to 100 / X purer than the natural kind.

rows.en: *Many mines have closed recently, and more face the same fate, so new mines need to be developed.
rows.jp: ＊ここ年数で、いくつもの渓谷が閉谷し / 今後も、閉谷する渓谷も<b:8af3>えていくだろう / <b:8af4>方<b:8af5>から、新<b:8af6>渓谷の開<b:8af7>が<b:8a8a>まれている<b:8af8>すことで足元に設置され、 / 一定時間<b:8af9>過すると自動的に<b:8a58>発します
rows.re: Many mines have closed recently, / and more face the same fate, so new / mines need to be developed.

rows.en: *Bombs may be used to blast open wooden boxes or destroy walls that already have cracks in them.
rows.jp: ＊ボムを<b:8a58>発させることによって / <b:8afa><b:8afb>やヒビの入った<b:8a40>などを / 破滅することができます
rows.re: Bombs may be used to blast open / wooden boxes or destroy walls that / already have cracks in them.

rows.en: @Her illness is very interesting, uh... I meant severe! I don't want to leave her in anyone else's care.
rows.jp: 「そのような<b:8afd>重な<f040><f042> / もとい、結単な<b:8ae4><8943>を / 他のヤツにはまかせておけぬわ
rows.re: Her illness is very interesting, / uh... I meant severe! I don't want / to leave her in anyone else's care.

rows.en: @Victor-Series bionic implants are based on living bodies, so misuse is expressly forbidden.
rows.jp: 「ヴィクトール<b:8a9a>の義体（シルエット）は / 生体がベースになっておるからな / 過<b:8b01>な無理は<b:8ae3>物じゃぞ〜<b:8b02><b:8b03>を行うには / <b:8b04>外れた力が必要なのだ〜
rows.re: Victor-Series bionic implants are / based on living bodies, so misuse / is expressly forbidden.

rows.en: @As a <Sword Magess> descendant, I needed to get that power even if it meant giving up my own body.
rows.jp: 「たとえ、自分のカラダを<b:8b05>ててでも / 力を手に入れなければならなかった〜 / あたしは＜<b:8a88>の<b:8ac5>女＞の<b:8b06>を招くものだ<b:8b07><b:8b08>』の<b:8b06>を招くからって / ここまでしなければいけなかったのかッ！
rows.re: As a <Sword Magess> descendant, I / needed to get that power even if it / meant giving up my own body.

rows.en: @If I didn't do this much, I would not have become self-aware.
rows.jp: 「こうでもしなければ / あたしは、その存在意義が見当たらないのだ
rows.lit: If I didn't go this far, I would find no reason for my own existence.
rows.re: If I didn't do this much, I would / not have become self-aware.

rows.jp: [17]<b:8b09>を<b:8a5b>すお前などに〜

rows.en: @5, I'll leave her with you!
rows.jp: 「[05]ぎ、すまないが / 彼女のこと頼んだ
rows.lit: {5}, sorry, but I'm counting on you to look after her. (0x05 = party-name slot)
rows.re: 5, I'll leave her with you!

rows.en: @You have Defenders of Justice to protect you, which gives miscreants like me reason to exist.
rows.jp: 「あなた方、新義の<b:8a84>方がいるから / 俺のような、おちゃめさんも / 存在する理由があるのですから〜
rows.re: You have Defenders of Justice to / protect you, which gives miscreants / like me reason to exist.

rows.jp: [17]<b:8a7d><b:8b0d>のみなさーん〜ッ！ / 俺も悪いけど / こいつらも同<b:8b0e>ですよーッ！<b:8b0f><b:8b10>だな〜

rows.en: @Because of who I am - descendant of the <Sword Magess> - I do need enemies such as you to defeat.
rows.jp: 「そう、あたしがあたしであること〜 / ＜<b:8a88>の<b:8ac5>女＞の<b:8b11><b:8b12>であるためには / お前のように倒すべき存在が必要だ
rows.re: Because of who I am - descendant of / the <Sword Magess> - I do need / enemies such as you to defeat.

rows.en: @A Hero only becomes a Hero in battle, which is where I belong.
rows.jp: 「戦いの中に / 『<b:8b07><b:8b08>』はある〜 / 戦場こそ、あたしの<b:8b13>場所だッ！<b:8b02><b:8b03>のワザは / 悪しき存在を<b:8b14>る<b:8b15>ッ！<b:8b16>物に相応しいッ！<b:8a75>の実力〜 / みせてもらいましょうかッ！
rows.re: A Hero only becomes a Hero in / battle, which is where I belong.

rows.en: @It will start VERY soon...
rows.jp: 「まもなく / はじまりますよ〜
rows.lit: It's going to begin very soon.
rows.re: It will start VERY soon...

rows.en: @Ha ha ha...
rows.jp: 「クックック〜<b:8b18><8804>も無<8918>して / 飛び出すからじゃッ！
rows.re: Ha ha ha...

rows.en: @We should fight together, 4. We are comrades-in-arms.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a7e>に戦おう[05]き / 俺たちは<b:8b19>間なんだ<b:8b19>間などと〜<b:8b1a>うよ / <b:8b02><b:8b03>といえど、『渡り<b:8a7f>』なんだろ？<b:8b1b>は？<b:8b1c>え切れなくなった時〜
rows.re: We should fight together, 4. We are / comrades-in-arms.

rows.jp: [17]<b:8b1d>くがいい / <f040><f042>それが報<b:8b1b>だ<b:8b1e><b:8b1f>は、成立した〜<b:8a78>った連中じゃ

rows.en: @Let's get back to the Valeria Chateau for now. We can't heal anything here well.
rows.jp: 「とにかく、ヴァレリアシャトーまで戻るぞ / ここではまともな分<b:8afc>も<88e4>せぬ
rows.re: Let's get back to the Valeria / Chateau for now. We can't heal / anything here well.

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か

rows.en: @Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません

rows.en: *Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: ＊〜ですが、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません

rows.en: @These all-nighters get to you. Please, don't surprise me like that.
rows.jp: 「左ずの番で<89bb>いんです / お願いしますから / びっくりさせないでくださいよ
rows.re: These all-nighters get to you. / Please, don't surprise me like / that.

rows.en: @I'll be looking out to make sure there are no more false alarms.
rows.jp: 「もうイタズラしないように / ここで、見右ってますからね灯らした / ふとどきな敵がいたらしいよ / <f040><f041><f042>もちろん、あなたたちじゃないよね？業を守るだけさ産として残してくれましたよ
rows.re: I'll be looking out to make sure / there are no more false alarms.

rows.en: @The menace of Odessa... just how will we be able to face it?
rows.jp: 「オデッサの脅威〜 / 我々は、どこまで / たちうちできるのでしょうか？
rows.lit: The menace of Odessa... just how far can we possibly stand against it?
rows.re: The menace of Odessa... just how / will we be able to face it?

rows.en: @You may hear some surprising things in surprising places. There's no substitute for footwork.
rows.jp: 「意外なところで / 意外な情報が聞けるかもしれませんよ / やはり、情報は足で探すものですね
rows.lit: You may hear surprising information in surprising places. In the end, information is found on foot.
rows.re: You may hear some surprising things / in surprising places. There's no / substitute for footwork.

rows.en: @You guys are quite impressive after all!!
rows.jp: 「やはり / あなたたちはただ者じゃないッ！
rows.lit: You really are no ordinary people after all!
rows.re: You guys are quite impressive after / all!!

rows.en: @In the future, this bell may ring in the event of a real call-to-arms.
rows.jp: 「今後は、本当に目<8880>のために / この発を灯らすことが / あるかもしれないですねぇ目<8880>の発の光のはずなのに / 飛び込み<b:8a3f>んできたのはオレだけかッ！
rows.re: In the future, this bell may ring / in the event of a real call-to- / arms.

rows.en: @I'm glad it was a false alarm, but what if it were a real emergency?
rows.jp: 「イタズラだったからよかったものの / 本当の目<8880>だったらどうなってたんだ？期してから<b:8a41>むことだ / つまらないミスなどで / 命を落とすことのないようにな核ドラゴンを簡単に撃動できたかもな<b:8a46>重過ぎるくらいが<89d5>度いいってものさ / <b:8a46>重過ぎて<b:8a47>することなんてないからな<b:8a48>勢にでるわけですね
rows.re: I'm glad it was a false alarm, but / what if it were a real emergency?

rows.en: @One battle is about to end... That's what I think!
rows.jp: 「ひとつの戦いが終ろうとしている〜 / そんな気がしますッ！<b:8a4a>協力を得られましたね
rows.re: One battle is about to end... / That's what I think!

rows.en: @The journey to this point was much longer than it needed be... Why do people create borders?
rows.jp: 「ここまでの道のりは / <88a5>いようで長かった〜〜 / 人はなぜ国具なんてつくったんだろう客さんのお戻りを / <888a>を長くして待っています
rows.re: The journey to this point was much / longer than it needed be... Why do / people create borders?

rows.en: @I am sure that everyone in Sylvaland knows of your fine exploits.
rows.jp: 「あなた方の活躍を / 我が国のすべての人が / <895b>えることでしょう客さんのお戻りを / <888a>を長くして待っています
rows.re: I am sure that everyone in / Sylvaland knows of your fine / exploits.

rows.en: @Please come in and let them know you are back.
rows.jp: 「ぜひ、客のものに / 話をかけてやってください国の国民が<8832>われました
rows.re: Please come in and let them know / you are back.

rows.en: @Let us continue to work together for peace by all means.
rows.jp: 「これからも共に力を合わせ / 平和のために力を尽くしましょう
rows.lit: Let us keep joining our strength from here on, and give our all for peace.
rows.re: Let us continue to work together / for peace by all means.

rows.en: @We are proud of this castle surrounded by greenery.
rows.jp: 「緑に囲まれたこの美しい<893b>は / 私たちの自慢です<b:8a5a>ったら / 俺を呼んでくださいッ！
rows.re: We are proud of this castle / surrounded by greenery.

rows.en: @I'll be right off to save you! I know this is not realistic, but I am just that enthusiastic!
rows.jp: 「すぐに助けに行って差し上げますッ！ / <f040><f041><f042>って、現実には無理ですけど / 意気込みはそれぐらいある、ということで<f05b>
rows.re: I'll be right off to save you! I / know this is not realistic, but I / am just that enthusiastic!

rows.en: @I am just SO glad. If something happened to you, 2, I don't know what...!
rows.jp: 「いやぁ、良かった良かったぁ / [05]かさんに / もしものコトがあったら俺は〜ッ！
rows.lit: Oh, thank goodness, thank goodness. If anything had happened to you, {5}, I... (05 = name slot)
rows.re: I am just SO glad. If something / happened to you, 2, I don't know / what...!

rows.en: @I see. I am just SO glad. If something happened to 2, I don't know what...!
rows.jp: 「そうですかぁ、良かった良かったぁ / [05]かさんに / もしものコトがあったら俺は〜ッ！
rows.lit: I see; thank goodness, thank goodness. If anything had happened to you, {5}, I... (05 = name slot)
rows.re: I see. I am just SO glad. If / something happened to 2, I don't / know what...!

rows.en: @Please take care of 2 in the future.
rows.jp: 「これからも / [05]かさんを / 守ってあげてくださいね<b:8a5c><b:8a5d>ですから / 全<8844>、暗くないですよ<b:8a5c><b:8a5d>があるから / 空が暗くなっても平気さッ！ / <b:8a5c><b:8a5d>が何なのかって？ それは<b:8a5e>内です<f04a>
rows.re: Please take care of 2 in the / future.

rows.en: @I have heard about your recent exploits. Good luck on your next job.
rows.jp: 「今回の活躍の件、聞いてますよ / またこれからも / 見右ってくださいね客さんの優<b:8a62>さが身に染みました
rows.re: I have heard about your recent / exploits. Good luck on your next / job.

rows.en: @I cannot tell you of my joy at meeting you again.
rows.jp: 「でもこうしてまた / 無事に帰式できてなによりです
rows.lit: But that you've made it safely back like this is what matters most. (帰式->帰還)
rows.re: I cannot tell you of my joy at / meeting you again.

rows.en: @At the start, maybe you ought not to stray too far from land.
rows.jp: 「初めのうちは / あまり陸から離れたところを / 飛行しない方がいいかもしれませんね<b:8a67><b:8a68>[11]ぉにありますよ
rows.re: At the start, maybe you ought not / to stray too far from land.

rows.en: @2, you have become the idol of Sylvaland Castle.
rows.jp: 「いまじゃ[05]かさんは / このシルヴァラント<893b>のアイドルですよ
rows.re: 2, you have become the idol of / Sylvaland Castle.

rows.en: @I can give you nothing but words of praise.
rows.jp: 「いやはや / 感賛の言葉しかでませんな
rows.lit: Well now, I have nothing but words of admiration. (感賛->感嘆/賞賛)
rows.re: I can give you nothing but words of / praise.

rows.en: @I see why you were picked for ARMS. Can't judge a book by its cover. We are counting on you from now on.
rows.jp: 「さすがはＡＲＭＳに選ばれただけはある / 人は見かけによらないということか / これからもキミたちの活躍を期待している<b:8a6b>し<b:8a6c>ない
rows.re: I see why you were picked for ARMS. / Can't judge a book by its cover. We / are counting on you from now on.

rows.en: @I have seen your strength in action quite well. Good to have you as allies.
rows.jp: 「キミたちの実力のほど / しかと見せてもらった / 味方として心強い限りだ環人は〜
rows.lit: I've seen the full measure of your skill. As allies you're most reassuring. (bleed tail; 環人->?)
rows.re: I have seen your strength in action / quite well. Good to have you as / allies.

rows.en: @Oh well, don't worry about those Odessa fellows, as our knights will slaughter them.
rows.jp: 「〜まあいい、オデッサなる敵 / 我ら同胞<897d>が守ってみせるから / 大<89d3>に守ったつもりでいたまえ
rows.re: Oh well, don't worry about those / Odessa fellows, as our knights will / slaughter them.

rows.en: @...The King of Meria Boule would not send such a person as an envoy.
rows.jp: 「〜〜メリアブール<89fb>も / なにもこのような者たちを / 使者として遣わすこともなかろうに<b:8a74>ちゃんがメリアブールからの / 使者だって？
rows.re: ...The King of Meria Boule would / not send such a person as an envoy.

rows.en: @If even a girl like you can become a member of ARMS, I wonder how strong it could be.
rows.jp: 「キミのような者でも / ＡＲＭＳの隊員になれるようでは / その実力を見るまでもないな防ぐコトが一番だからな / 初心に<b:8a78>って<b:8a79>々までチェックだッ！ / さあ、キミたちも一<b:8a7a>に<f040><f041><f042>
rows.re: If even a girl like you can become / a member of ARMS, I wonder how / strong it could be.

rows.en: @Visual check...OK!
rows.jp: 「指差し確認、よーしッ！
rows.re: Visual check...OK!

rows.en: @That's unconfirmed, though! You'll have to check it visually yourself. Don't forget!
rows.jp: 「それを確かめるべく / 指差し確認が必要だッ！ / 忘れるなよッ！差し確認は、<b:8a7b>本中の<b:8a7b>本だッ！ / こうやって、見回って / 指差し確認すれば、<88ad><b:8a7c>だッ！
rows.re: That's unconfirmed, though! You'll / have to check it visually yourself. / Don't forget!

rows.en: @Visual check...OK!
rows.jp: 「指差し確認、よーしッ！<b:8a7d>たりとも気は抜けないぞッ！
rows.re: Visual check...OK!

rows.en: @Visual check...OK!
rows.jp: 「指差し確認、よーしッ！業が存在するらしいんだ
rows.lit: Point-and-check... all good! (bleed tail: it seems some line of work exists)
rows.re: Visual check...OK!

rows.en: @One should be able to find it with judicious visual checks! .......Visual check...OK!
rows.jp: 「指差し確認をすれば探し出せるハズだッ！ / <f040><f041><f042>指差し確認、よーしッ！業が存在するらしいんだ
rows.re: One should be able to find it with / judicious visual checks! / .......Visual check...OK!

rows.en: @One should be able to find it with judicious visual checks! .......Visual check...OK!
rows.jp: 「指差し確認をすれば探し出せるハズだッ！ / <f040><f041><f042>指差し確認、よーしッ！業が存在するらしいんだ
rows.re: One should be able to find it with / judicious visual checks! / .......Visual check...OK!

rows.en: @One should be able to find it with judicious visual checks! .......Visual check...OK!
rows.jp: 「指差し確認をすれば探し出せるハズだッ！ / <f040><f041><f042>指差し確認、よーしッ！業が存在するらしいんだ
rows.re: One should be able to find it with / judicious visual checks! / .......Visual check...OK!

rows.en: @One should be able to find it with judicious visual checks! .......Visual check...OK!
rows.jp: 「指差し確認をすれば探し出せるハズだッ！ / <f040><f041><f042>指差し確認、よーしッ！業が存在するらしいんだよ
rows.re: One should be able to find it with / judicious visual checks! / .......Visual check...OK!

rows.en: @One should be able to find it with judicious visual checks! .......Visual check...OK!
rows.jp: 「指差し確認をすれば探し出せるハズだッ！ / <f040><f041><f042>指差し確認、よーしッ！業が存在するらしいんだ
rows.re: One should be able to find it with / judicious visual checks! / .......Visual check...OK!

rows.en: @One should be able to find it with judicious visual checks! .......Visual check...OK!
rows.jp: 「指差し確認をすれば探し出せるハズだッ！ / <f040><f041><f042>指差し確認、よーしッ！差し確認するんだッ！
rows.re: One should be able to find it with / judicious visual checks! / .......Visual check...OK!

rows.en: @But dealing with the encroachment that is happening, we simply don't have the budget to spare.
rows.jp: 「だけど、こんな異世事態が起きている今 / それにまわす<888e>余なんてないんだ
rows.re: But dealing with the encroachment / that is happening, we simply don't / have the budget to spare.

rows.en: @But maybe the people of Halmetz need the bell more now than ever to keep their spirits up...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>でも、こんな時だからこそ / ハルメッツの人たちの心の支えである発を / なおすべきなんじゃないかと思うよ
rows.re: But maybe the people of Halmetz / need the bell more now than ever to / keep their spirits up...

rows.en: @The beauty of those bells' sound is said to represent the beauty of the country.
rows.jp: 「その灯り焼く発の光は / 美しいこの国を表わしているようだ<b:8a81>い空の時に灯り焼く発の光は / それはもう美しかったよ
rows.re: The beauty of those bells' sound is / said to represent the beauty of the / country.

rows.en: @But since the sky has darkened... Ringing the bells only makes things worse...
rows.jp: 「だけど、空が暗くなってから / 発を灯らしても空しく焼くだけさ〜
rows.lit: But now that the sky has darkened, lighting the beacon only burns in vain. (発->烽/篝 'beacon')
rows.re: But since the sky has darkened... / Ringing the bells only makes things / worse...

rows.en: @No one knows where that hidden entrance lays...It must be well concealed.
rows.jp: 「ただ、その隠された入り口が / どこにあるのかは誰も知りません / きっと<899c><8a22>に隠されているのでしょう
rows.re: No one knows where that hidden / entrance lays...It must be well / concealed.

rows.en: @Mightn't it be a good idea to go on a sea voyage sometime? Undiscovered ruins...how exciting!
rows.jp: 「たまには探<887e>をしながら / 飛道するのもいいんじゃないですか？ / 新たな遺跡〜〜わくわくしますねッ！<b:8a82>い、<b:8a82>すぎます / あのバルキサスを墜としてしまうなんて
rows.re: Mightn't it be a good idea to go on / a sea voyage sometime? Undiscovered / ruins...how exciting!

rows.en: @I always wanted to see you all in action...
rows.jp: 「あなたたちの戦いぶりを / この目で実<89d2>に見たかったですね<b:8a82>い、<b:8a82>すぎます / あのバルキサスを墜としてしまうなんて
rows.re: I always wanted to see you all in / action...

rows.en: @I have lived by the sword, but now I must acknowledge the power of magic as well.
rows.jp: 「武の道に生きてきたわたしですが / 魔法の力、認めざるを得ません
rows.lit: I have lived by the way of the sword, yet I must acknowledge the power of magic.
rows.re: I have lived by the sword, but now / I must acknowledge the power of / magic as well.

rows.en: @Important events are happening outside, but I am here ...doing nothing...
rows.jp: 「いま外では / 大変なことになっているというのに / 〜〜私はいったい〜〜熱<b:8a85>に / 目<8880>するためのものです
rows.re: Important events are happening / outside, but I am here ...doing / nothing...

rows.en: @Please don't ring it needlessly.
rows.jp: 「むやみに発を灯らしたりするのは / 止めてくださいね
rows.lit: Please stop lighting the beacon needlessly. (発->beacon)
rows.re: Please don't ring it needlessly.

rows.en: @Some guards might come running because they think it means trouble.
rows.jp: 「<896a>世事態と思い / 飛び込んでくる衛同が / いるかもしれませんから<b:8a85><89dd>のひもを招くと / 発を灯らすことができますが / むやみに発を灯らさないでくださいね<b:8a86>えてＡＲＭＳ、ＡＲＭＳとッ！
rows.re: Some guards might come running / because they think it means / trouble.

rows.en: @We should not depend on ARMS, but rise up ourselves to save the day. We are knights, are we not!
rows.jp: 「ＡＲＭＳなどばかりに頼っておらんで / 自分たちで何とかしてみせようという気は / 我ら同胞<897d>には、ないのかッ！
rows.re: We should not depend on ARMS, but / rise up ourselves to save the day. / We are knights, are we not!

rows.en: @It should be we knights of Sylvaland who solve the problem of this sky, no one else!
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>空の異世気象については / 我らシルヴァラントの同胞<897d>が / 解決してみせようぞッ！核ドラゴンがシルヴァラントに / 現われていれば我々の活躍を / 存分にお見せすることができたのだがね
rows.re: It should be we knights of / Sylvaland who solve the problem of / this sky, no one else!

rows.en: @It's too bad it doesn't come here! We'd show it a thing or two!
rows.jp: 「いやぁ、まったくもって残念だな / ハッハッハッ〜〜
rows.lit: Ah, what a pity indeed. Hah hah hah...
rows.re: It's too bad it doesn't come here! / We'd show it a thing or two!

rows.en: @The Guild Galad warriors must have been so embarrassed to be shown up like that by ARMS...
rows.jp: 「それにしても、ギルドグラードの同胞も / ＡＲＭＳに活躍の場を持っていかれるとは / 何とも、ふがいないヤツラよ核がなにするものぞッ！
rows.lit: Even so, that the Guild Galad warriors let ARMS steal the spotlight, what spineless fellows. (bleed: what's a nuke to us?!)
rows.re: The Guild Galad warriors must have / been so embarrassed to be shown up / like that by ARMS...

rows.en: @They should beg us Sylvaland knights to get rid of Odessa and their nukes!
rows.jp: 「あの『核』については / 我らシルヴァラントの同胞<897d>が / 解決してみせようぞッ！敵らがどのような同時を持とうと / あなた方ならばそれをうち破れる / わたしはそう信じています
rows.re: They should beg us Sylvaland / knights to get rid of Odessa and / their nukes!

rows.en: @And it's not just me, either. Everyone in Filgaia believes in you, I'm sure...
rows.jp: 「いえ、きっとわたしだけでないはず / 世界中の人が、あなたたちを信じています / あなたたちＡＲＭＳの勝利をッ！守るべきなにかがあってこそ / 本当の力を出せるんじゃないでしょうか
rows.lit: No, surely it isn't only me; everyone in the world believes in you, in your ARMS victory! (bleed: only with something to protect can one show true strength)
rows.re: And it's not just me, either. / Everyone in Filgaia believes in / you, I'm sure...

rows.en: @Desire to protect what they love is what really brings out strength in a man. That's what I think.
rows.jp: 「なにかを大切なものを守りたい / そういう想いが剣を強くした / わたしはそう思っています
rows.lit: Wanting to protect something precious; that feeling is what made the sword strong. That's what I believe.
rows.re: Desire to protect what they love is / what really brings out strength in / a man. That's what I think.

rows.en: @If we aren't prepared when the time comes, then we won't be able to protect what we love.
rows.jp: 「いつでも行動をとれるよう / 準備だけは怠らないようにしないと / 守るべきものも守れなくなってしまう活躍を見せられませんでしたな / ははは<f05b>
rows.re: If we aren't prepared when the time / comes, then we won't be able to / protect what we love.

rows.en: @I'm looking forward to watching you in action, though...
rows.jp: 「あなたたちのこれからの活躍に / わたしも期待しておりますので活躍を見せられませんでしたな / ははは<f05b>
rows.re: I'm looking forward to watching you / in action, though...

rows.en: @I don't know where you keep the power to down something like Varukisas on that body, but...
rows.jp: 「その小さな体のどこに / あのバルキサスを墜とす力が / 備わっているのか不思議だ〜活躍 / 聞きましたよ
rows.lit: It's a wonder where that small body keeps the power to bring down Varukisas. (bleed: I heard of your exploits)
rows.re: I don't know where you keep the / power to down something like / Varukisas on that body, but...

rows.en: @We didn't get a chance this time to show our stuff... Next time, maybe!
rows.jp: 「今回は / 我らの活躍を見せられなかったが / 更こそはッ！同胞があらわれて / 危機を<8832>ったという話は本当かい？
rows.re: We didn't get a chance this time to / show our stuff... Next time, maybe!

rows.en: @You all were near the battle, so you must have seen something. Want to tell me what happened?
rows.jp: 「現場近くにいたキミたちなら / なにか知ってるんじゃないか？ / よければ教えてくれないか<b:8a74>さん / オデッサなどと名のる連中など / なにも<889c>れる必要はありませんよ
rows.re: You all were near the battle, so / you must have seen something. Want / to tell me what happened?

rows.en: @If they were to try something around here, we knights would take care of them quick!
rows.jp: 「もし敵らがなにかを仕<89eb>けてきたら / 我ら同胞<897d>が守って見せましょう制<b:8a8e>などといっている者たちがいるが / 我らがいる限り / それは無理というものだ
rows.re: If they were to try something / around here, we knights would take / care of them quick!

rows.en: @If they try anything in spite of us, we'll just have to show them the error of their ways forcibly!
rows.jp: 「我ら同胞<897d>の存在を知ってなお / そのようなことをいうのであれば / その愚かさを身をもって教えるしかないな
rows.re: If they try anything in spite of / us, we'll just have to show them / the error of their ways forcibly!

rows.en: @Therefore, the Danger Level has risen to 1.8!
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>ですので / <892c>能力が、１．８倍（当社比）ほど / 上がっているでアリマースッ！核ドラゴンのような脅威が / このシルヴァラントに来ないとは / 限りらないでアリマスッ！
rows.re: Therefore, the Danger Level has / risen to .8!

rows.en: @Therefore, the Danger Level has risen to 1.5!
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>ですので / <892c>能力が、１．５倍（当社比）ほど / 上がっているでアリマースッ！能力が、１．３倍（当社比）ほど / 上がっているでアリマースッ！武力を<b:8a95>りかざしてくる
rows.re: Therefore, the Danger Level has / risen to .5!

rows.en: @There doesn't seem to be a limit to their strength.
rows.jp: 「力に上限はない〜 / <f040><f042>っていうのは本当なのかな？占[07]敵らにとっての最終同時だといいのですが / あれ以上の武時を持っていたとしたら〜装「こんなことは考えたくはないのですが / まだオデッサにはなにかあるのでは / そう思ってしまうのです占[07]装「あなたたちのおかげで / あのバルキサスの<8845>異は<b:8a96>りましたが / まだ不安は残りますね〜〜装「オデッサ<889c>るべしッ！ / あのような戦闘<b:8a98>を持っていようとは / おもいもよりませんでした
rows.re: There doesn't seem to be a limit to / their strength.

rows.en: @This time I realized the value of a rapid response in containing a dangerous situation.
rows.jp: 「<8a03><8a04>な行動がとれることによって / 状況の悪合を最小限にくい止められたことを / 今回の件で身に染みて実信しました
rows.re: This time I realized the value of a / rapid response in containing a / dangerous situation.

rows.en: @We will follow as soon as preparations are complete!
rows.jp: 「我々も準備ができ更<88f9> / 急行するでアリマスッ！
rows.re: We will follow as soon as / preparations are complete!

rows.en: @I hope we find some thread of hope, but...
rows.jp: 「何か解決の糸口が見つかれば / 良いのですが〜
rows.lit: I only hope we find some thread toward a solution.
rows.re: I hope we find some thread of hope, / but...

rows.en: @Speaking of which, I heard of a ruin floating in the sky. It's to the 1west of Sylvaland0.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>おおッ！ そういえばッ / [11]おシルヴァラントの東[11]ぉには空に浮かぶ遺跡が / あると聞いたことがありますよ時である核ドラゴンを / 倒してしまうとは〜ッ！
rows.re: Speaking of which, I heard of a / ruin floating in the sky. It's to / the west of Sylvaland.

rows.en: @But then again, you did shoot down Odessa's flying fortress, so maybe I shouldn't be surprised...
rows.jp: 「しかし、オデッサの空中要<885e>を落とした / あなたたちのコトですから / あながち不思議ではないのですが〜
rows.re: But then again, you did shoot down / Odessa's flying fortress, so maybe / I shouldn't be surprised...

rows.en: @If you all in ARMS don't relieve them of that fear, who will?
rows.jp: 「その不安を取り除けるのは / あなたたち、ＡＲＭＳをおいて / 他ならないでしょう
rows.lit: The ones to remove that unease are none other than you, ARMS.
rows.re: If you all in ARMS don't relieve / them of that fear, who will?

rows.en: @But, if scrolls from the time it was made still exist...you might find out something that way.
rows.jp: 「ただ、あの同時が作られた当時の記録があれば / なにかしらヒントになることでも / わかるとおもうのですが〜〜<b:8a9e>囲の移動手段を得ることで / これまでにいけなかったところなども / <b:8aa0>交にいけることでしょう
rows.re: But, if scrolls from the time it / was made still exist...you might / find out something that way.

rows.en: @But that means you may also miss the place you're aiming for, so be careful.
rows.jp: 「でもそれは<89c1>に / 目的地を見失いやすくなります / <88f7>意してください同胞<897d>だけでなく / 多くの人々の<b:8aa2>気を高めることでしょう功<b:8aa4>を繋げたのです / さぁ、<89e5>を右ってください<b:8a6b>しております
rows.re: But that means you may also miss / the place you're aiming for, so be / careful.

rows.en: @Please go to the Audience Chamber.
rows.jp: 「ぜひ、お式いになっていってください国国に<b:8aa7>さない結単部隊があるとは / メリアブールもかわった国ですね美しさだ〜 / 〜でも、美人が<b:8aa8>をとると<b:8aa9>だよね<f05a>
rows.re: Please go to the Audience Chamber.

rows.en: @Uh.... Did I just say that? I didn't mean it...not at all...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>はッ！ / 私は、なんてコトを言っているのだッ！ / さっき私が言ったコトは、どうか街内に〜<f05b>
rows.re: Uh.... Did I just say that? I / didn't mean it...not at all...

rows.en: @If the Nuclear Dragon ventures into Sylvaland, I will lay down my life to protect Your kingdom!
rows.jp: 「もし、このシルヴァラントが / 核ドラゴンに攻われたとしても / この私が、命をかけてお守りいたしますッ！美しさだ〜 / 空が<888c>くなっても、ちっとも気にならない
rows.re: If the Nuclear Dragon ventures into / Sylvaland, I will lay down my life / to protect Your kingdom!

rows.en: @(I wonder why she never married, though...?)
rows.jp: 「〜でも、なんでご結婚しなかったのだろう？<b:8a7b>のジェネレイター〜
rows.re: (I wonder why she never married, / though...?)

rows.en: @In their long plan to win all of Filgaia, Odessa must have quietly planned for this day from long ago.
rows.jp: 「今回に備えてオデッサは / かねてよりファルガイア制圧を / <896e>く、密かに目論んでいたのでしょうね<b:8a48>撃を押けてばかりの我々が / 敵らに一<b:8aad>報いることができました活躍に / よろこんでおいでです
rows.re: In their long plan to win all of / Filgaia, Odessa must have quietly / planned for this day from long ago.

rows.en: @Please report to Her Highness yourselves.
rows.jp: 「女<89fb><8a0b>辺に / あなたたちから / ご報<8804>なさってください
rows.re: Please report to Her Highness / yourselves.

rows.en: @Our methods are different, but our desire for peace is the same.
rows.jp: 「あなたたちと / できることは違うかもしれませんが / 平和を望む心はいっしょです<b:8aaf>見は、<b:8ab0><b:8ab1>国の使者として / くれぐれも失<8928>のないように / お願いいたします
rows.re: Our methods are different, but our / desire for peace is the same.

rows.en: @He wouldn't wake up if Odessa came and shook his hand!
rows.jp: 「こうなると、よっぽどのことじゃ / 起きそうにはないな……
rows.lit: At this rate, it'd take something extraordinary to wake him...
rows.re: He wouldn't wake up if Odessa came / and shook his hand!

rows.en: @You can't guard the castle while you're asleep!
rows.jp: 「これでは、<893b>を守るなんて / できやしないんじゃないのか？時用ッ！ 立ったまま左てるよッ！
rows.re: You can't guard the castle while / you're asleep!

rows.en: @Hmm? There's a treasure box there! We just have to get this heap of garbage out of the way...
rows.jp: 「ん？ あんな所に人影がある…… / この人、どうにかして動かせないかなぁ<b:8a4a>ッ！
rows.re: Hmm? There's a treasure box there! / We just have to get this heap of / garbage out of the way...

rows.en: @Do you think we should just leave him alone?
rows.jp: 「これだからニンゲンというやつは / ブツブツ……公が / 一連の事件の<888a><b:8ab5>者だったとは〜
rows.re: Do you think we should just leave / him alone?

rows.en: @This is why I have no faith in humanity...
rows.jp: 「それが、事実だとするならば / 今までのいきさつも納得がいきますね / すべては、仕組まれたことだった〜？
rows.lit: If that's the truth, then all that's happened makes sense. It was all engineered...?
rows.re: This is why I have no faith in / humanity...

rows.en: @If that's true, then everything else makes more sense. Everything was planned...
rows.jp: 「ヴァレリア公は / 慈愛の強い、やさしく、優しい方〜 / ファルガイアを本気で愛していた方〜
rows.lit: Sir Valeria is deeply compassionate, gentle, kind; someone who truly loved Filgaia.
rows.re: If that's true, then everything / else makes more sense. Everything / was planned...

rows.en: @Sir Valeria is merciful, kind, and yet sad... He truly loves Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「これしか〜 / 本当にこんなに優しい手段しか / なかったのでしょうか〜？活躍でした
rows.lit: Was this really the only way, truly only such a gentle means? (bleed tail: it was a fine performance)
rows.re: Sir Valeria is merciful, kind, and / yet sad... He truly loves Filgaia.

rows.en: @Was this plan the only way? It all seems so sorrowful...
rows.jp: 「事前に臨国が協力態勢にあり / <8a03><8a04>な行動をとれたことも / 功を奏したようですね
rows.re: Was this plan the only way? It all / seems so sorrowful...

rows.en: @Uniting the 3 countries into a cooperative agreement beforehand seems to have not been in vain.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>そのことなのですが / 『オデッサ』の存在が今の協力態勢を / 築き上げたハズです
rows.re: Uniting the 3 countries into a / cooperative agreement beforehand / seems to have not been in vain.

rows.en: @...Indeed, it is only because of Odessa that cooperation among our 3 countries was even considered...
rows.jp: 「そう考えると / オデッサは臨国協力態勢の『大義名分』〜 / そのように信じられなくもないのです
rows.lit: Put that way, Odessa was the 'just cause' for the allied-nations pact; I can't help half-believing it.
rows.re: ...Indeed, it is only because of / Odessa that cooperation among our 3 / countries was even considered...

rows.en: @Come to think of it, Odessa was just the right thing for us to enter into cooperative pacts...
rows.jp: 「あくまで、これは結果論ですが〜望んだ結果は / 我々と同じだったはず〜
rows.lit: This is hindsight, of course, but the result they wished for must have been the same as ours.
rows.re: Come to think of it, Odessa was / just the right thing for us to / enter into cooperative pacts...

rows.en: @It seems almost too perfect...
rows.jp: 「そこにたどり着くまでの / 道のりが違っただけで / お互いを傷つけ合うことになろうとは〜<b:8abe>望の<89e0>
rows.re: It seems almost too perfect...

rows.en: @Of course, we could just as easily have ended up with each other's blood on our hands...
rows.jp: 「あのかつてない<8845>異の前に / わらわたちはなんと無力なことか〜〜
rows.re: Of course, we could just as easily / have ended up with each other's / blood on our hands...

rows.en: @We were totally unprepared for such a menace, powerless...
rows.jp: 「あなたたちが彼のものたちを守ってくれると / わらわだけでなく / ファルガイアのすべての民が信じていますよ<b:8a4a>協力も得られ / 世界はようやくまとまろうとしてます
rows.re: We were totally unprepared for such / a menace, powerless...

rows.en: @We and all of Filgaia believe that you will defeat our common enemy.
rows.jp: 「人の営為の中で / これほど多国が / まとまったことがあったでしょうか
rows.lit: In all the works of humankind, has there ever been so many nations brought together like this?
rows.re: We and all of Filgaia believe that / you will defeat our common enemy.

rows.en: @In all of history, have so many nations ever united for a single purpose?
rows.jp: 「皮肉にもオデッサという<8845>異的存在が / 世界の人々の結重を / <896e>める役<8913>をすることになろうとは〜〜<b:8ac4>度のバルキサス撃墜見事でした / あらためて<8928>を言います
rows.re: In all of history, have so many / nations ever united for a single / purpose?

rows.en: @Ironically, it was the menace of Odessa that tightened the bonds between all these nations...
rows.jp: 「あのバルキサスの<8845>異が / どれほど人民の心に不安をもたらしたことか / その不安を取り除いてくれたのですから
rows.re: Ironically, it was the menace of / Odessa that tightened the bonds / between all these nations...

rows.en: @It was a weight on all people's hearts, one that has now been lifted thanks to your efforts.
rows.jp: 「これからも世界平和のために / 尽力されることを願っています
rows.lit: I hope you'll keep striving for the peace of the world.
rows.re: It was a weight on all people's / hearts, one that has now been / lifted thanks to your efforts.

rows.en: @I hope that you continue to battle on behalf of peace in Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「あなたたちの年々の活躍は / わらわにも聞きおよんでいます / さらなる活躍を期待していますよ活躍を期待しています / よろしく頼みましたよ国と / いくつもの場や国がある / それを教えてやろう
rows.lit: Word of your years of good work has reached even me. I expect still greater things. (heavy bleed tail)
rows.re: I hope that you continue to battle / on behalf of peace in Filgaia.

rows.en: @I have heard of your many exploits. I expect to hear of more yet.
rows.jp: 「『ギルドグラード』 / ここから北東に級置する<8a13>工業都国国だ / かなり重工業の<89b7>占が分めているらしい
rows.re: I have heard of your many exploits. / I expect to hear of more yet.

rows.en: @|Guild Galad| This is an industrial nation-state NW of here ruled by a stubborn lord.
rows.jp: 「それから、いろいろな機艇や武時は / ギルドグラード製のモノが多いようだ
rows.lit: Also, many of the machines and weapons seem to be Guild Galad-made. (機艇=machines, 武時->武器)
rows.re: |Guild Galad| This is an industrial / nation-state NW of here ruled by a / stubborn lord.

rows.en: @Many machines and weapons come from Guild Galad.
rows.jp: 「それからだな〜（以辺、以下）国と / いくつもの場や国がある / それを教えてやろう
rows.lit: And then... (and so on, below) (bleed: there are many lands and nations; let me tell you of them)
rows.re: Many machines and weapons come from / Guild Galad.

rows.en: @Also, there's...
rows.jp: 「『メリアブール』 / たしかメリアブールから来たんだよね？ / なら、キミたちの方が<88a9>しいかもしれないな
rows.re: Also, there's...

rows.en: @|Meria Boule| You came from Meria Boule, didn't you? You might know more than I...
rows.jp: 「でも、少し移動すると、<88fa>交の盛んな国だ / それに、亡くなられた<89fb>妃方は / すごい美人だったって話だ
rows.re: |Meria Boule| You came from Meria / Boule, didn't you? You might know / more than I...

rows.en: @Briefly, then, it's a rich trading country, whose queen they say was very beautiful before she died...
rows.jp: 「それからだな〜（以辺、以下）国と / いくつもの場や国がある / それを教えてやろう
rows.lit: And then... (and so on, below) (bleed dup)
rows.re: Briefly, then, it's a rich trading / country, whose queen they say was / very beautiful before she died...

rows.en: @Also, there's...
rows.jp: 「『シルヴァラント』 / 言わずと知れた、我々の国だ
rows.lit: 'Sylvaland': needless to say, our own country.
rows.re: Also, there's...

rows.en: @|Sylvaland| As you know, this is our country.
rows.jp: 「山に囲まれた豊かな美しい国 / 深い谷盛りの美しい<893b> / そして、美しい女<89fb><8a0b>辺
rows.re: |Sylvaland| As you know, this is / our country.

rows.en: @A beautiful country surrounded by forests, with a beautiful white stone castle and a beautiful queen.
rows.jp: 「それからだな〜（以辺、以下）<b:8ad5>通にいけるところにないからでは？
rows.re: A beautiful country surrounded by / forests, with a beautiful white / stone castle and a beautiful queen.

rows.en: @Also, there's...
rows.jp: 「きっと、結単な方法でしか / 入ることができず / その存在を隠されている気がします
rows.lit: Surely it can only be entered by some special means, its very existence hidden. (結単->特殊?)
rows.re: Also, there's...

rows.en: @I have the feeling they're hidden well, in someplace you can only get to by secret means...
rows.jp: 「上陸できそうなところを / 目を凝らして探した方がいいでしょう / 気になるところにはいってみるべきですね
rows.lit: You'd do well to strain your eyes for a spot where you might land. You should go where it catches your interest.
rows.re: I have the feeling they're hidden / well, in someplace you can only get / to by secret means...

rows.en: @You should concentrate on looking for a good place to land. Check out anywhere that seems likely.
rows.jp: 「帯在する他々にも / いろいろな施設や遺跡が / 存在していると聞きますからね闘<b:8a98>を墜とせるんだ？ / ほとほと信心してしまうよ
rows.re: You should concentrate on looking / for a good place to land. Check out / anywhere that seems likely.

rows.en: @I hear that there are many caves and ruins dotting the islands in the sea...
rows.jp: 「いまやこの<893b>中 / あなたたちの話<8810>で持ちきりですよ
rows.re: I hear that there are many caves / and ruins dotting the islands in / the sea...

rows.en: @The castle is abuzz with talk of you all.
rows.jp: 「この機式に自分たちのことを / じっくり考えてみる必要が / あるのかもしれませんね組<b:8ad9>名は / ＡＲＭＳというのですか / 変わった名前ですね
rows.re: The castle is abuzz with talk of / you all.

rows.en: @We need to think hard about what's become of us.
rows.jp: 「まあ、誓<8810>は名前じゃなくて / その好きだから / せいぜい見右ってくださいね<b:8a6b>し<b:8a6c>ありません<b:8adb><b:8adc>ですよね
rows.re: We need to think hard about what's / become of us.

rows.en: @Well, it's not the name that counts anyway, but the deed. Keep up the good work!
rows.jp: 「核ドラゴンのことは / いくら任務とはいえギルドグラードの / 手伝いをしてやったようなモノですから〜核』は / ギルドグラードが<885f>り出したモノを / <b:8adf>ったモノらしいじゃないか
rows.re: Well, it's not the name that counts / anyway, but the deed. Keep up the / good work!

rows.en: @Taking care of the Nuclear Dragon was your duty, but it was also like cleaning up Guild Galad's mess.
rows.jp: 「まったく、オデッサもオデッサだが / ギルドグラードも独特なことを / してくれたものだ尽<b:8ae1>に<b:8ae2>みあげる<897f>なのです
rows.re: Taking care of the Nuclear Dragon / was your duty, but it was also like / cleaning up Guild Galad's mess.

rows.en: @As if Odessa weren't difficult enough without Guild Galad helping them, on purpose or no!
rows.jp: 「あのようなモノがあると / 平和はおろか / ファルガイア自体が失われてしまいます<b:8ae3><b:8ae4>の守人』〜
rows.re: As if Odessa weren't difficult / enough without Guild Galad helping / them, on purpose or no!

rows.en: @What a wonderful thing! But then again, they do endanger Filgaia...
rows.jp: 「つまり<f040><f042> / <8917><8918>能力に長けた要<885e>であるとうかがえます
rows.re: What a wonderful thing! But then / again, they do endanger Filgaia...

rows.en: @In other words, it was a fortress that also served as an observation platform.
rows.jp: 「ですが、発<885f>同時である以上 / 保作している戦闘力はあなどれません / <89ce>分に気をつけてください平和を取り戻しましょう
rows.re: In other words, it was a fortress / that also served as an observation / platform.

rows.en: @It is an artifact from the old times, though, so don't think it doesn't pack a lot of firepower!
rows.jp: 「ようやく世界がひとつに / まとまることが / できようとしているのですから教えてくれました
rows.lit: For the world is at last about to be brought together as one. (bleed tail: he told me)
rows.re: It is an artifact from the old / times, though, so don't think it / doesn't pack a lot of firepower!

rows.en: @Finally, the world is coming together in a common cause!
rows.jp: 「誰もが墜とすのは不可能と思っていた / あのバルキサスですら / 撃墜することができたのですから<b:8ae5>に / 目を信まされた信じがします
rows.re: Finally, the world is coming / together in a common cause!

rows.en: @You all taught us that by eliminating Varukisas, which everyone thought was impossible.
rows.jp: 「我々のすべきこと / それがいったいなんなのか / それを教えてもらいました<b:8ae6>くのですか？
rows.re: You all taught us that by / eliminating Varukisas, which / everyone thought was impossible.

rows.en: @It was you who taught us to stand up for ourselves!
rows.jp: 「〜〜なにを<89b9>気になっていたのだ / わたしは誇りある同胞なのに国は長らく平和だったせいか / わたしをふくめ / 実戦経験のないものも多年います
rows.re: It was you who taught us to stand / up for ourselves!

rows.en: @What was I so scared of? A knight like me should have more pride...
rows.jp: 「今度の件で戦いになったときに / 満足に戦えるのか不安ではありますね<b:8aea>の仕<89eb>けが作動するッ！
rows.re: What was I so scared of? A knight / like me should have more pride...

rows.en: @I wasn't sure if I'd be too frightened to fight or not...
rows.jp: ＊それらの<8a13>工製<892e>は / ファルガイアに住む人々の / 生活道具を飛躍的に向上させた
rows.re: I wasn't sure if I'd be too / frightened to fight or not...

rows.en: *These industrial goods have gone a long way toward improving people's lifestyles.
rows.jp: ＊同時に、数多の兵器が / 同時開発に利用されている
rows.lit: *At the same time, a great many weapons are put to use in joint development.
rows.re: These industrial goods have gone a / long way toward improving people's / lifestyles.

rows.en: *But these technologies have also been used for weapons of war.
rows.jp: ＊兵器そのものは、生活向上の他 / 軍事同時の開発にも活用できる / その兵器を使い、人が何をするのか
rows.lit: *Weapons themselves can serve to improve life, but also military development. What will people do with them?
rows.re: But these technologies have also / been used for weapons of war.

rows.en: *The technologies can be used for more efficient killing, or for improving people's lives.
rows.jp: ＊使う者によりその力は / 人を生かす力にも殺す力にもなり得る / 全ては使い方更<88f9>なのである国シルヴァラント豊かな自<8844>に囲まれた / 美しき<893b>である
rows.re: The technologies can be used for / more efficient killing, or for / improving people's lives.

rows.en: *Which occurs is entirely dependent on the user's will.
rows.jp: ＊肥沃な大地を<89b7>心とし / 肥工の発展した国であり / 肥産物が豊富に<8939>生されている
rows.re: Which occurs is entirely dependent / on the user's will.

rows.en: *The country is blessed with fertile farmland, and has a productive agricultural industry.
rows.jp: ＊単名・ファルガイアの台所と呼ばれ / 多くの肥産物を他国に輸出している
rows.lit: *Called the sole 'kitchen of Filgaia', it exports much produce to other nations. (単名->異名; 肥産物->農産物)
rows.re: The country is blessed with fertile / farmland, and has a productive / agricultural industry.

rows.en: *It is also known as |Filgaia's Kitchen| for its food exports.
rows.jp: ＊大地と共に生きることを信条にし / おおらかな気質を持った / 国民性が結晶といわれる国の北東には / スレイハイム国の<89b7>心だった / <89da>大な<88db><88dc>地<89e8>が<89da>がっている
rows.re: It is also known as |Filgaia's / Kitchen| for its food exports.

rows.en: *Its people are known for their deep connection to the earth and their warm hearts.
rows.jp: ＊この地には何か故 / 高度な記次を持った / <88bf>大国国があったといわれる
rows.re: Its people are known for their deep / connection to the earth and their / warm hearts.

rows.en: *A civilization possessing highly advanced technology used to exist there, the legends say.
rows.jp: ＊それを裏付けるように / ロストテクノロジーを使用した幻同時が / 年多くこの地で発<885f>された
rows.re: A civilization possessing highly / advanced technology used to exist / there, the legends say.

rows.en: *Supporting this legend are many weapons excavated from the area utilizing lost technology.
rows.jp: ＊しかし現在は、国国協定により / この地での発<885f>は一切禁止となり / 発<885f>物の使用も規制されている装着<b:8b07>置である
rows.re: Supporting this legend are many / weapons excavated from the area / utilizing lost technology.

rows.en: *However, international agreement now forbids further excavation, and regulates already excavated items.
rows.jp: ＊その<8a12>かな<89af>理は / 現在の兵器では解次できず / 使用するだけにとどまっている
rows.re: However, international agreement / now forbids further excavation, and / regulates already excavated items.

rows.en: *Although they are used regularly, the principles on which they operate are not understood today.
rows.jp: ＊それゆえに / 現存するライブリフレクターの年を / これ以上増やすことはできない
rows.lit: *For that reason, the number of Live Reflectors now in existence cannot be increased any further. (年->数)
rows.re: Although they are used regularly, / the principles on which they / operate are not understood today.

rows.en: *Therefore, no more Live Reflectors can be built.
rows.jp: ＊使用者の肉体に負<8847>がかかるため / 初めて装着を体験すると / 気分が悪くなるものもいる
rows.re: Therefore, no more Live Reflectors / can be built.

rows.en: *Since there is a toll taken on the body of the user, first-time users often experience some discomfort.
rows.jp: ＊使用信の向上と / 使用されている兵器の解析が / 急務とされている密かなる時の回々争いごとを<b:8ab1>まない気質から / 大きな争<8945>はしばらく起こっていない
rows.re: Since there is a toll taken on the / body of the user, first-time users / often experience some discomfort.

rows.en: *At present, much research into this problem, and into the underlying technology, is being conducted.
rows.jp: ＊その為か、同胞<897d>においても / 実戦経験のないものが / 大多年を占めるようになっている
rows.re: At present, much research into this / problem, and into the underlying / technology, is being conducted.

rows.en: *Because of this, most knights in the military have never seen actual combat.
rows.jp: ＊争<8945>のない平和な国は理想であるが / それは同時に、戦うことを存在意義とする / 同胞<897d>の存在価<8875>が誓われることになる
rows.re: Because of this, most knights in / the military have never seen actual / combat.

rows.en: *Since they believe so strongly in peace, many Sylvalanders question the necessity of the knights.
rows.jp: ＊同胞の<895b><8903>が、単なる地級となったとしても / それが平和の証であれば / 押け入れざるを得ない事実ではないだろうか環つの道環つに分けられる
rows.re: Since they believe so strongly in / peace, many Sylvalanders question / the necessity of the knights.

rows.en: *Even if the knights are symbolic only, that itself is a testament to Sylvaland's abiding peace.
rows.jp: ＊これはファルガイアの地面が / 熱を引くようになっているのが / 起<89b0>である
rows.re: Even if the knights are symbolic / only, that itself is a testament to / Sylvaland's abiding peace.

rows.en: *This is because Filgaia is circular in shape.
rows.jp: ＊街道は大陸に囲まれ / 外道とは海路によって繋がっている
rows.lit: *The inland sea is ringed by the continent, and joined to the outer sea by sea routes.
rows.re: This is because Filgaia is circular / in shape.

rows.en: *The inland sea is enclosed by land, joined to the outer sea by a shoal.
rows.jp: ＊外道はその名の通り / 大陸の外<89f5>の大道である
rows.re: The inland sea is enclosed by land, / joined to the outer sea by a shoal.

rows.en: *As its name implies, the outer sea encircles the land.
rows.jp: ＊大道の一部は / ゲートブリッジによって / 進入禁止になっており
rows.lit: *Part of the main road is closed off by the Gate Bridge, forbidding entry.
rows.re: As its name implies, the outer sea / encircles the land.

rows.en: *Part of the great sea is rendered impassable by the Gate Bridge.
rows.jp: ＊<88f9>環の街道のように / なっている部分がある<b:8b12>一の存在ではなく / 多元的に存在する<89f5><b:8a4a>の一部にすぎない
rows.re: Part of the great sea is rendered / impassable by the Gate Bridge.

rows.en: *This results in the creation of a second inland sea.
rows.jp: ＊世界はひとつではなく / 平行に存在する単の『世界』も / また『ファルガイア』なのである刑場刑場は / 現在その役目を、イルズベイル<8917><8963>他に / <b:8b14>任し、閉場された
rows.re: This results in the creation of a / second inland sea.

rows.en: *The world is not singular. There are other worlds which exist parallel to our own.
rows.jp: ＊その為、現在ゴルゴダ刑場は / 刑場としては使用されず / 破壊されたと同方の状態となっている
rows.lit: *For that reason, Golgotha execution ground is no longer used as such, and stands as though destroyed. (同方->同様)
rows.re: The world is not singular. There / are other worlds which exist / parallel to our own.

rows.en: *Since it is no longer being used, Golgotha Prison is now in effect left abandoned.
rows.jp: ＊押刑者の脱獄を防ぐために / 年々のトラップが仕<89eb>けられていることから / 同胞の訓<8a01>場にとの話も繋がっている
rows.re: Since it is no longer being used, / Golgotha Prison is now in effect / left abandoned.

rows.en: *Since the prison is still rife with dangerous traps, some say that it should be used to train troops.
rows.jp: ＊賛成<8a1e>、反対<8a1e>の間で / 話し合いが持たれているが / 結論が出ずに現在に<88bd>る国自体が滅亡したスレイハイム
rows.re: Since the prison is still rife with / dangerous traps, some say that it / should be used to train troops.

rows.en: *Those for and those opposed to the plan have as yet come to no conclusions.
rows.jp: ＊軍事合の進められていた / スレイハイムの滅亡により / 軍事危機が終<89e2>したとも言われる
rows.re: Those for and those opposed to the / plan have as yet come to no / conclusions.

rows.en: *Since militarism caused Slayheim's fall, people thought the danger of war perished along with Slayheim.
rows.jp: ＊しかし、それに<8864>わり / <8a13>工国国ギルドグラードの兵器力による / 武時開発が新たな<88e0>火となっている
rows.re: Since militarism caused Slayheim's / fall, people thought the danger of / war perished along with Slayheim.

rows.en: *In its place, though, Guild Galad began to manufacture weapons of mass destructive capability.
rows.jp: ＊<89ab>れた兵器力により作られる同時 / それが他国の脅威になるのは / <88bd>歩当たり前と言える
rows.re: In its place, though, Guild Galad / began to manufacture weapons of / mass destructive capability.

rows.en: *It was only natural for other nations to become weary of Guild Galad and its activities.
rows.jp: ＊多くの国や自分<89b7>が / ギルドグラードに対し<892c>能心を抱き / その動向に過信になっている国国では / 代々、女<89fb>が国を分め / <89fb>はその<b:8b1c><b:8b1d>として国を分めた
rows.re: It was only natural for other / nations to become weary of Guild / Galad and its activities.

rows.en: *Fearing that the new weapons would be turned on them, other nations watched Guild Galad very closely.
rows.jp: ＊これは、シルヴァラント<89fb>国が / 大地の恵みを糧として / 発展してきた営為から来ている
rows.re: Fearing that the new weapons would / be turned on them, other nations / watched Guild Galad very closely.

rows.en: *This is because Sylvaland boasts a history of utilizing its natural heritage for bountiful food.
rows.jp: ＊母なる大地と呼ぶように / 大地を『女性』とし、国を支えるのは / 『女性』であるとしてきたためである
rows.lit: *Just as we call it Mother Earth, the land has been taken as 'female', and it is 'woman' who upholds the nation.
rows.re: This is because Sylvaland boasts a / history of utilizing its natural / heritage for bountiful food.

rows.en: *They call the earth |Mother,| so it is only natural for their ruler to be female as well.
rows.jp: ＊ゆえに、『女<89fb>』を国の最高指導者として / シルヴァラントは他国と違った / <89e1>自の統分面態を持つ国となった
rows.re: They call the earth |Mother,| so it / is only natural for their ruler to / be female as well.

rows.en: *Therefore, Sylvaland's system of government evolved into a matriarchy.
rows.jp: ＊ひとつは / シルヴァラント<893b>を中心とした本<89b7>である / 緑豊かな<89b7>地で肥耕が盛んに行われている
rows.re: Therefore, Sylvaland's system of / government evolved into a / matriarchy.

rows.en: *The first is the home district, where Sylvaland Castle is located, and contains farmland.
rows.jp: ＊残りのふたつは本<89b7>から離れ / ライブリフレクターで行き来する
rows.re: The first is the home district, / where Sylvaland Castle is located, / and contains farmland.

rows.en: *The other two are far away, so Live Reflectors serve as transport.
rows.jp: ＊うちひとつは遺跡渓谷 / 比較的大きな他で、渓谷の発<885f>が / 盛んである
rows.re: The other two are far away, so Live / Reflectors serve as transport.

rows.en: *One of these is the large island of Holst, which contains productive mines.
rows.jp: ＊もうひとつは枯谷地<89e8> / <89b7>地としているものの、枯枯の危険性から / 国民の住まない、名ばかりの地である
rows.re: One of these is the large island of / Holst, which contains productive / mines.

rows.en: *The other is located in a volcanic region, so it remains unpopulated - part of Sylvaland in name only.
rows.jp: 「国国にとらわれない / <89e1>立部隊の編成〜 / たしかに興味<896e>い話です
rows.re: The other is located in a volcanic / region, so it remains unpopulated - / part of Sylvaland in name only.

rows.en: @A fighting force with no allegiance to any country...very interesting indeed!
rows.jp: 「全ファルガイア中に決起表次をした / 『オデッサ』なる勢力の敵に対抗するために / 作為な手段ともいえましょう<b:8aa0>を / すべて押け入れるつもりはありません
rows.re: A fighting force with no allegiance / to any country...very interesting / indeed!

rows.en: @It does seem like an effective way to counter Odessa, which also operates as a separate entity...
rows.jp: 「とくに、我が国のライブリフレクターの / 自由使用<88b2>など / 簡単に認められるものではありません
rows.re: It does seem like an effective way / to counter Odessa, which also / operates as a separate entity...

rows.en: @I cannot so easily allow free access to our country's Live Reflector.
rows.jp: 「強大な戦闘力を誇る、あなた方ＡＲＭＳが / 何の制限も無く、行き来していれば / 我が国の民に不安が募りましょう
rows.lit: If you of ARMS, boasting such mighty fighting power, come and go without any restriction, unease would build among my people.
rows.re: I cannot so easily allow free / access to our country's Live / Reflector.

rows.en: @If you of ARMS have permission to come and go as you like, our people might come to doubt their security.
rows.jp: 「考えてもごらんなさい / 我々にとって、あなた方ＡＲＭＳが / オデッサといかほどに異なるか、を<b:8b2f>れるのは道理
rows.re: If you of ARMS have permission to / come and go as you like, our people / might come to doubt their security.

rows.en: @After all, why should I consider you of ARMS any different from Odessa?
rows.jp: 「我が国に自由に行き来するあなた方が / いつオデッサと同じく牙を突き立てるのか / 不安でたまらないのです
rows.lit: I can't bear the fear of when you, who move freely through my country, might bare your fangs like Odessa.
rows.re: After all, why should I consider / you of ARMS any different from / Odessa?

rows.en: @I have no guarantees that you will not begin acting like Odessa once you have free access to my country.
rows.jp: 「納得していただけますね
rows.lit: You can accept that, can't you.
rows.re: I have no guarantees that you will / not begin acting like Odessa once / you have free access to my country.

rows.en: @You see my point?
rows.jp: 「その件、メリアブール<89fb>に / よろしくお伝えください
rows.re: You see my point?

rows.en: @Please convey that to the King of Meria Boule, along with my greetings.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>いえ、この件の立案者は / ヴァレリア公ですね？
rows.re: Please convey that to the King of / Meria Boule, along with my / greetings.

rows.en: @Oh...wait... It was actually Sir Valeria who proposed this, wasn't it?
rows.jp: 「国国にとらわれぬ部隊などという発想は / 変わり者で知られた / かの<89c7>姫以外に考えられませんから
rows.re: Oh...wait... It was actually Sir / Valeria who proposed this, wasn't / it?

rows.en: @Only he could have come up with an idea as novel as an independent fighting force.
rows.jp: 「ＡＲＭＳではなく / 姫様といっしょに遊びにいらっしゃいと / わらわの言葉を伝えてもらえぬだろうか
rows.lit: Would you convey my words: come and play, together with the princess, not with ARMS.
rows.re: Only he could have come up with an / idea as novel as an independent / fighting force.

rows.en: @Please tell him to come visit me with his lovely sister, not ARMS.
rows.jp: 「シルヴァラントの女<89fb>が / そう願っておりますゆえ〜<b:8a6b>し上げますッ！ / <f040><f042>あッ〜！<b:8a6b>してみよ
rows.re: Please tell him to come visit me / with his lovely sister, not ARMS.

rows.en: @Thus wishes the Queen of Sylvaland!
rows.jp: 「おそらくは / 先の決起表次をおこなった<f040><f042>
rows.re: Thus wishes the Queen of Sylvaland!

rows.en: @Reports suggest it was the terrorist band...
rows.jp: 「ただ今より我が国の同胞<897d>を招<8880>しても / とても、まにあいそうにありません
rows.re: Reports suggest it was the / terrorist band...

rows.en: @Even if we put out a call to arms now, our knights won't be able to assemble in time.
rows.jp: 「<8a03><8a04>対応の<89e1>立部隊〜 / そのお手並みを / 拝見させていただきましょうか
rows.re: Even if we put out a call to arms / now, our knights won't be able to / assemble in time.

rows.en: @Well, then...shall we see just how fast our independent fighting force is, then?
rows.jp: （考えてみれば / <88bd>歩、当<8844>のことではありませんか）
rows.re: Well, then...shall we see just how / fast our independent fighting force / is, then?

rows.en: (That's the obvious conclusion, now that I think about it.)
rows.jp: （いつからなのでしょう / 人が手を取り合うことを / 忘れたのは〜）
rows.lit: (Since when was it that people forgot to join hands...?)
rows.re: (That's the obvious conclusion, now / that I think about it.)

rows.en: (I wonder when it was I forgot that true strength comes from joining together?)
rows.re: (I wonder when it was I forgot that / true strength comes from joining / together?)

rows.jp: （ですが〜）
「それよりも / あの者たちをどう思いました？
rows.lit: More to the point, what did you make of those people?

rows.en: @So, what did you think of them?
rows.jp: 「何者のしがらみにもとらわれず / <8954>いもありません
rows.re: So, what did you think of them?

rows.en: @I saw no signs of ulterior motives. I believe they are simply acting for the common good.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアを守るために / まっすぐな理想を掲げています
rows.lit: They hold up a straight, honest ideal to protect Filgaia.
rows.re: I saw no signs of ulterior motives. / I believe they are simply acting / for the common good.

rows.en: @They are indeed honorable and their desire to protect Filgaia genuine.
rows.re: They are indeed honorable and their / desire to protect Filgaia genuine.

rows.en: @By the way, 0...
rows.jp: 「聞けば、住人<8832>出の<89d2>に / 名誉の負傷をおったとか〜
rows.re: By the way, ...

rows.en: @There were reports that you suffered injury in your recent action.
rows.jp: 「もったいないお言葉です / ご心配にはおよびません<b:8b3c>
rows.re: There were reports that you / suffered injury in your recent / action.

rows.en: @Thank you very much for asking, Your Highness, but it was nothing.
rows.jp: 「我がシルヴァラントを / 命懸けで守ってくれたあなたに / もしものことがあってはなりませぬゆえ
rows.lit: You risked your life to protect our Sylvaland; nothing must happen to you.
rows.re: Thank you very much for asking, / Your Highness, but it was nothing.

rows.en: @We can't have anything untoward happen to you while protecting our Sylvaland, can we?
rows.jp: 「その件を<8937>した / メリアブール<89fb>あての<8a0e><8946>です
rows.re: We can't have anything untoward / happen to you while protecting our / Sylvaland, can we?

rows.en: @This is a Royal Letter to the King of Meria Boule to that effect.
rows.jp: 「たいせつに<88f8>けてもらえますね<b:8b3e>べるのは / むしろ、こちらのはず
rows.re: This is a Royal Letter to the King / of Meria Boule to that effect.

rows.en: @I hope I can entrust you with it.
rows.jp: 「そうですわね、ヴァレリア公協力を信<b:8b3f>します / これで少しはマシな活動ができそうですよ<b:8b40>苦しいことに / 付き合わせてしまいましたね
rows.re: I hope I can entrust you with it.

rows.en: @Isn't that so, Sir Valeria!
rows.jp: 「これくらいで / お開きといたしましょう
rows.lit: Let us call it to a close about here.
rows.re: Isn't that so, Sir Valeria!

rows.en: @Let us end it here.
rows.jp: 「<893b>辺に立ち寄ってごらんなさい / みなさんを待っている方々が / <8880>まっているはずですよ
rows.re: Let us end it here.

rows.en: @If you go down below the castle, I believe you'll find someone waiting for you.
rows.jp: 「これからライブリフレクターの / 使用<88b2>について新儀な手<8a18>きを / 行わなければいけないんだ
rows.re: If you go down below the castle, I / believe you'll find someone waiting / for you.

rows.en: @The formalities for granting you permission to use the Live Reflectors may take some time.
rows.jp: 「これだから『お役所仕事は』と / 言われるのですね〜 / あなた方を見習わなくてはいけません
rows.lit: This is just why they speak of 'bureaucratic red tape'. We must learn from your example.
rows.re: The formalities for granting you / permission to use the Live / Reflectors may take some time.

rows.en: @I guess we have too much red-tape around here. We could learn some things from you, it seems.
rows.jp: 「我らＡＲＭＳとしても / これほどうれしいことはありません
rows.lit: For us of ARMS, there could be nothing gladder than this.
rows.re: I guess we have too much red-tape / around here. We could learn some / things from you, it seems.

rows.en: @There is nothing more ARMS could have hoped for.
rows.jp: 「テロ<8880><897d>『オデッサ』に立ち向かえるのは / 我々、ＡＲＭＳをおいて他ならないのです
rows.re: There is nothing more ARMS could / have hoped for.

rows.en: @There is no one but ARMS to stand up against Odessa.
rows.re: There is no one but ARMS to stand / up against Odessa.

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か

rows.en: @Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません

rows.en: *Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: ＊〜ですが、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません

rows.en: @ARMS will be my heroes - forever!
rows.jp: 「やっぱりＡＲＭＳは僕にとって / 置<8a10>のヒーローですよッ！密戦隊ＡＲＭＳ』ッ！ / っていうのはダメかな？

rows.en: @Yeah, I didn't think you'd like it. I do, though...
rows.jp: 「〜〜ダメみたいだね<f05a> / 我ながらいい案だと思ったんだけどなぁ<b:8a3a>胞はその新体を次かさず / 人知れず怪っていくッ！ / まさに新義のヒーローッ！

rows.en: @I'm dying to know who it is, though. A member of our own team with a secret, perhaps?
rows.jp: 「いまだにその新体が気になってるんですよ / じつはＡＲＭＳの中の / さらに発密部隊の人じゃないかってね<f05a><b:8a3c>い人たちが / ＡＲＭＳとして / 最前<b:8a3d>で戦っているのですね

rows.en: @If there is anything people like us can do to help you, just ask.
rows.jp: 「僕たちにも / なにか協力できることがあると / いいのですが平<b:8a40>のために立ち上がるなら / 僕たちはあなたたちを支持します

rows.en: @I'm sure there are many other people out there in need of you!
rows.jp: 「きっとまだ多くの人たちが / あなたたちＡＲＭＳの力を / 必要としているはずですッ！<b:8a3a>胞は / いったい誰だったんだろう / あなたたちＡＲＭＳのかたですか？

rows.en: @I really wanted to thank him, but he left so quickly...
rows.jp: 「あのときは足早に怪ってしまったので / お<8928>のひとつもいえなくて / とても残念に思っているのですが<b:8a3a>胞は / あなたたちＡＲＭＳのかたですか？

rows.en: @If so, I would love to meet him and give thanks.
rows.jp: 「もしそうなら / 式って一言<8928>をいいたいのですが鐘つき音が<8865>れば、場の人たちの心も / 少しは<89bf>まると思うんだがねぇ鐘つき音の / 修理にまわす<888e>許が / ないのは分かるけどねぇ〜

rows.en: @I did think the Queen had more of a heart, though...
rows.jp: 「もっと、シルヴァラント女<89fb><8a0b>辺は / 話の分かるお方だと思っておったのだが<b:8a46>のバックに<888c>い空とは / 結<8968>、シュールな信じだねぇ

rows.en: @Please ask her to repair our Bell Tower...
rows.jp: 「ハルメッツの鐘つき音を / 早く<8865>すようにって鐘つき音は滅れたままじゃよ / 場の名物だっただけに / 早く<8865>してほしいんだけどねぇ

rows.en: @That's why we don't want to hear about money! I hate those bureaucrats!
rows.jp: 「<888e>許が出ないとかなんとかで / まったくこれだから / お役所仕事はダメだっていうんじゃ鐘つき音の音を / 聞かせてあげたいんじゃがなぁ

rows.en: @There is not talk of it being fixed anytime soon, but we are all waiting and hoping.
rows.jp: 「いまだに修理するっていう話が / ぜんぜんないんじゃよ / 一回も早く<8865>してほしいんじゃが<b:8a48>いもんじゃ / あんな<b:8a49>盟の<b:8a4b>みたいなのを / やっつけるなんて

rows.en: @They sure put their tails between their legs and ran!
rows.jp: 「あんたたちにかかれば / やつらもしっぽを<8812>くしかないじゃろう

rows.en: @This Bell Tower was the symbol of this town! What a fate for it...
rows.jp: 「この鐘つき音は / ハルメッツの場のシンボルだったのじゃが / なんて惜いことをするんじゃ奴らに滅されてしまったけど / 場の鐘つき音の音は / 本当にいい音がしたんじゃよ

rows.en: @I would have liked for you all to hear it, too...
rows.jp: 「あんたたちにも / 聞かせてあげたかったねぇ

rows.en: @Nor can I believe that you defeated it!
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>しかし、それを倒してしまった / お前さんたちもすごいのぉ

rows.en: @Who had any idea that there was a monster inside it?
rows.jp: 「なんでも、こいつには / 魔物が封印されているそうなんじゃ

rows.en: @So don't do any mischief, ya hear! Makin' noise here is inexcusable.
rows.jp: 「じゃから、決して悪さしてはいかんぞ / まわりで騒ぐなどもってのほかじゃ<b:8a50>みの名前に変更する？<b:8a51>さん、魔法使えないでしょ？<b:8a52>き込むクレストグラフはどれかしら？<b:8a53><b:8a54>）を選んでね<b:8a52>き込むけど、いいかしら？

rows.en: @One must be especially careful at times like this... That includes you all!
rows.jp: 「ま、こんな時は慎重にならない方が / バカを見るのさ / あんたたちも気を付けな

rows.en: @Don't threaten to use a weapon of mass destruction, if the world you want to conquer would be destroyed.
rows.jp: 「強力な同盟を振りかざすのは苦手だが / そんなモノ使っちまったら / 支配する世界が無くなっちまうってのに〜盟なんかじゃなくて / それをあつかうオデッサの方さ

rows.en: @Who knows what could happen? It's all the harder to confront them because they're so unpredictable.
rows.jp: 「『ハサミ』のあつかい方を / 全<8844>、知らない何とやらは / 手におえなくて、まいるよな

rows.en: @Realizing that you don't have enough items once you're there is already too late!

rows.jp: 「やっと気づいたの / 世界はひとりで<b:8a52>ろうとするから / つらくて、たいへんなのよ
rows.re: I've finally realized that any one / person trying to save the world by / themselves is pure folly.

rows.en: @If everyone protects just a little piece of it, then your burden will be lessened.
rows.jp: 「みんなで少しずつファルガイアを<b:8a52>れば / あなたひとりに / すべてを<b:8a50>しつけることなんて無かったのよ<b:8a50>しつけてしまうことで / 私たちは誰よりも / 現実から<8a10>ざかっていたのかもしれません
rows.re: If everyone protects just a little / piece of it, then your burden will / be lessened.

rows.en: @The reality being that we must fight together as well as live together.
rows.jp: 「いっしょに戦い / そして、生きていくという / 現実から〜<b:8a53>〜 / 死ぬのは<b:8a54>いのよ
rows.re: The reality being that we must / fight together as well as live / together.

rows.en: @That's why we tried to leave everything up to the |Pillars.|
rows.jp: 「だから、『鍵』に / すべてを<b:8a55>そうとしたの
rows.re: That's why we tried to leave / everything up to the |Pillars.|

rows.en: @But because of that, something inside of us has died.
rows.jp: 「でもね、そうすることで / 人間として大切な心が死んでいったわ / その<b:8a56>みが、今はとてもつらい〜<b:8a40><b:8a41>は / <b:8a57>険なるウラルトゥの谷間に / 人目を<b:8a58>けて建てられているわ
rows.re: But because of that, something / inside of us has died.

rows.en: @There, those who control the hearts of men, the Guardian Lords, the avatars of the
rows.jp: 「そこでは / ガーディアンが<b:8a59>りし幻意<b:8a5a>体『ガイア』と / そして<f040><f042>
rows.re: There, those who control the hearts / of men, the Guardian Lords, the / avatars of the

rows.en: @Guardian Lord, wait for the arrival of the |Pillar| ...
rows.jp: 「人の心を<b:8a5b>る / ガーディアンロードたちが / 『鍵』の<b:8a5c>着を待っていると〜<b:8a5d>かとなってしまった / 星の命『マナ』〜
rows.re: Guardian Lord, wait for the arrival / of the |Pillar| ...

rows.en: @If the life-energy that makes the planet alive is used for the wrong purposes...
rows.jp: 「星を<b:8a5e>かせる / 大いなる生命のエネルギーが / もしも、悪用されたなら〜
rows.re: If the life-energy that makes the / planet alive is used for the wrong / purposes...

rows.en: @...it would threaten all of us as well as harm the life force itself.
rows.jp: 「それは、大きな脅威であると同時に / 星の命が<b:8a5f>しく<b:8a60>つけられてしまうことに / 他ならないのです<b:8a61>になられましたか？
rows.re: ...it would threaten all of us as / well as harm the life force itself.

rows.en: @We must husband dearly the forest's remaining beauty, just as we must Filgaia's remaining |Mana.|
rows.jp: 「わずかに残る山の<b:8a62>しさ〜 / 私たちはファルガイアに残る『マナ』を / 大切にしなければいけません<b:8a63>び<88f1>しく<b:8a64>やすには / あなたの命が必要なのよ
rows.re: We must husband dearly the forest's / remaining beauty, just as we must / Filgaia's remaining |Mana.|

rows.en: @We can use your life to help the Guardians reclaim their power, which they'll use to save Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「あなたの命を得ることで / ガーディアンは力を取り戻して / きっと世界を<8832>ってくださるわ
rows.re: We can use your life to help the / Guardians reclaim their power, / which they'll use to save Filgaia.

rows.en: @The Guardian's waning power may very well seal the doom of all Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ガーディアンの力が<b:8a65>えるということは / ファルガイアの命運が<b:8a66>きると / 言い<8864>えることができるのです<b:8a60>ついてほしくはありません / もちろん、倒れてほしくもありません
rows.re: The Guardian's waning power may / very well seal the doom of all / Filgaia.

rows.en: @You must now face the Sacrificial Altar and open yourself to the will of the stone Guardians.
rows.jp: 「あなたには / 谷と合したガーディアンの意<b:8a3e>と置に / 生け左の<b:8a40><b:8a41>に向かってもらわなくては〜
rows.re: You must now face the Sacrificial / Altar and open yourself to the will / of the stone Guardians.

rows.en: @...but I am more interested in the unseen threat of the sky being gnawed away.
rows.jp: 「ですが、私は〜 / 『空が<b:8a43>われる』という / 未だ目に<b:8a67>らない脅威が気になります
rows.re: ...but I am more interested in the / unseen threat of the sky being / gnawed away.

rows.en: @...you all are our only hope. The fate of Filgaia rests with you.
rows.jp: 「私たちがすがるのは / あなたしかいないのよ / わかってちょうだい
rows.lit: You are the only ones we can lean on. Please understand that.
rows.re: ...you all are our only hope. The / fate of Filgaia rests with you.

rows.en: @Now...as the |Pillar,| please face the Sacrificial Altar.
rows.jp: 「そして〜 / 『鍵』として / 生け左の<b:8a40><b:8a41>に立ってちょうだい〜
rows.re: Now...as the |Pillar,| please face / the Sacrificial Altar.

rows.en: @But we of Baskar are doing more than anybody else to secure Filgaia's fate.
rows.jp: 「でも、私たちバスカーは / 他の誰よりも / ファルガイアの未来を<b:8a68>じているわ
rows.re: But we of Baskar are doing more / than anybody else to secure / Filgaia's fate.

rows.en: @We only expect to be reviled for our actions.
rows.jp: 「だから、どんなにそしりをうけようと / 信念はできているわ<b:8a6a>さんにそっくりだわ
rows.re: We only expect to be reviled for / our actions.

rows.en: @Kind of a waste on a boy...
rows.jp: 「剣の家にしておくの / もったいないわ
rows.lit: It'd be a waste to leave it as a house of the sword. (or: to keep it shut away)
rows.re: Kind of a waste on a boy...

rows.en: @You have inherited much from Sabrina, it seems.
rows.jp: 「やっぱり、あなた / サブリナの<b:8a44>を招いているのね〜
rows.re: You have inherited much from / Sabrina, it seems.

rows.en: @Indeed, it is crucial to secure the future of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアの未来を / 発えるために / 無くてはならない命なんです
rows.lit: It's a life that cannot be spared, if the future of Filgaia is to be upheld. (発える->支える)
rows.re: Indeed, it is crucial to secure the / future of Filgaia.

rows.en: @Please look to his training.
rows.jp: 「試<8a01>の道中 / よろしくお願いします
rows.re: Please look to his training.

rows.en: @It is your fate to shoulder the destiny of Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアを発えるべき / 運命を<89a3>右いし者である〜
rows.re: It is your fate to shoulder the / destiny of Filgaia.

rows.en: @The people of Baskar will support you, so we may fight together.
rows.jp: 「ならば、バスカーの<b:8a38>は / お前を発える『鍵』となろう / そうすれば、いっしょに戦えるじゃろう<b:8a6b>えて / もっと大きな可能性を / 身につけようとしている
rows.re: The people of Baskar will support / you, so we may fight together.

rows.en: @3 might be able to help us out of this dangerous period.
rows.jp: 「[05]がならば / この脅威を<b:8a6c>けられるかもしれぬ
rows.re: 3 might be able to help us out of / this dangerous period.

rows.en: @It might be possible to escape the sad fate of a |Pillar.|
rows.jp: 「<b:8a6d>しき『鍵』の運命を / <b:8a6e>り<b:8a6b>えて行けるかもしれぬ〜<b:8a6f>れし者は / 運命を<b:8a70>け入れるがいい〜
rows.re: It might be possible to escape the / sad fate of a |Pillar.|

rows.en: @But if you think you have the power to overcome destiny, then there's no reason not to try.
rows.jp: 「だが、運命を切り開く力を / その<b:8a71>に、まだ込められるのならば / <b:8a72>ってみるのも悪くないかもしれぬ〜
rows.re: But if you think you have the power / to overcome destiny, then there's / no reason not to try.

rows.en: @That's what I think when I look at you.
rows.jp: 「お前たちを見ていると / そんな<89f9>にも思えてきよる<b:8a47>見の<8804>げし / ビジョンが現実のものとなって / ファルガイアを<b:8a73>わんとしておる〜
rows.re: That's what I think when I look at / you.

rows.en: @The place for a |Pillar| is in front of the Sacrificial Altar.
rows.jp: 「『鍵』の立つべきは、生け左の<b:8a40><b:8a41>〜
rows.re: The place for a |Pillar| is in / front of the Sacrificial Altar.

rows.en: @The time has come for the |Pillar| to save the world at a Sacrificial Altar in the mountains of Urartu.
rows.jp: 「<8a10>く、ウラルトゥの谷地にあるという / 生け左の<b:8a40><b:8a41>にて / 『鍵』が世界を発える時が来たようじゃ<b:8a52>りし意<b:8a3e>ある力〜 / それをガーディアンと呼ぶのは知っておろう
rows.re: The time has come for the |Pillar| / to save the world at a Sacrificial / Altar in the mountains of Urartu.

rows.en: @Do you know what we call that which used to be Guardian but is no more?
rows.jp: 「では、かつてはガーディアン / またはガーディアンの一部であったものを / 何と呼ぶか知っておるかの？
rows.lit: So then, do you know what we call that which once was a Guardian, or part of one?
rows.re: Do you know what we call that which / used to be Guardian but is no more?

rows.en: @|Disaster.| Those with the will and the power to destroy Filgaia we call |Disaster.|
rows.jp: 「『<b:8a74><b:8a75>』（ディザスター）〜 / ファルガイアを破滅せんとする / 意<b:8a3e>ある力を『<b:8a74><b:8a75>』と呼ぶのじゃ<b:8a76>の山<b:8a77>が<89da>がっておる
rows.re: |Disaster.| Those with the will and / the power to destroy Filgaia we / call |Disaster.|

rows.en: @It is a land ripe with |Mana.| Indeed, there are few places like it left in Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアでも年少ない / 星の命『マナ』の<b:8a78>かな<b:8a79>地じゃからな<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』よりファルガイアを<b:8a52>るため / ガーディアンの力はひとつに<8880>められ / 幻意<b:8a5a>体を生み出したのじゃ
rows.re: It is a land ripe with |Mana.| / Indeed, there are few places like / it left in Filgaia.

rows.en: @It's name was |Gaia,| and it was a protector of the earth swathed in holy light.
rows.jp: 「その名は『ガイア』〜 / まばゆき<89e0>に<b:8a7b>まれた / <b:8a52>護者となるはずであったが〜<b:8a7c>地に / かつて、ガーディアンを<8958>じていた / <b:8a7d><b:8a7e>の名残があるそうですじゃ
rows.re: It's name was |Gaia,| and it was a / protector of the earth swathed in / holy light.

rows.en: @Please gather the Mediums from these fallen Sanctuaries.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a7f>ちてしまった<b:8a80><b:8a81>より / ミーディアムを<8880>めてくだされ
rows.re: Please gather the Mediums from / these fallen Sanctuaries.

rows.en: @The stone Mediums, which contain the embodied will of the Guardians, will lead us to a brighter future.
rows.jp: 「ガーディアンの意<b:8a3e>が / 谷となりしミーディアムは / きっと未来へ<b:8a82>いてくれましょう<b:8a83>げられし『鍵』の命は / ガーディアンの力を解き放ち / 大いなる脅威を<b:8a6c>けるという
rows.re: The stone Mediums, which contain / the embodied will of the Guardians, / will lead us to a brighter future.

rows.en: @Do not falter, 3, for neither the planet nor its people could survive an error on our part.
rows.jp: 「<8954>わないでおくれ[05]が〜 / 人も、この星も / これ以上<b:8a60>つくのは<b:8a84>えられないんじゃよ<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』によって / 封<b:8a85>されたと聞いておる
rows.re: Do not falter, 3, for neither the / planet nor its people could survive / an error on our part.

rows.en: @And it was none other than this |Blaze of Disaster| that deprived the planet of its life-force.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアから / 星の命を<b:8a86>っていったのは / 他ならぬ『<b:8a7a>の<b:8a74><b:8a75>』なんじゃよ
rows.re: And it was none other than this / |Blaze of Disaster| that deprived / the planet of its life-force.

rows.en: @Please release the power of the Guardians! You are a good child, are you not?
rows.jp: 「封じられしガーディアンの力を / ここに解放しておくれ〜 / お前は<89ab>しい家なんじゃろう〜？<b:8a6d>しき運命〜 / 誰かが発えねばならない / 世界の運命そのものなんだよ〜
rows.re: Please release the power of the / Guardians! You are a good child, / are you not?
