rows.re: Of course I won't. None of us will. / Not me, or or 3. Or even {0}.

rows.en: @You'd better promise not to, otherwise I'll never be able to care for anyone again.
rows.jp: 「<b:8b71>重してよ。でないと<f040><f042> / わたしは一生 / 誰も<b:8a91>きになれないよ<b:8b71>重するよ / 俺もみんなが大<b:8a91>きだからな<b:8a44>けて / いつも<b:8a5b>探でいられるようにっておまじない
rows.re: You'd better promise not to, / otherwise I'll never be able to / care for anyone again.

rows.en: @My big sister taught it to me.
rows.jp: 「お<b:8a64>ちゃんに / <b:8a60>えてもらったんだ
rows.re: My big sister taught it to me.

rows.en: @I want to be like my sister. I want to create my own charm to make people smile.
rows.jp: 「わたしも、お<b:8a64>ちゃんみたいになるんだ / 誰かを<b:8a5b>探にさせる / おまじないを見つけるんだ〜
rows.re: I want to be like my sister. I want / to create my own charm to make / people smile.

rows.en: @Well, then, let's get busy!
rows.jp: 「じゃあ / そうと決まれば急がなくっちゃッ！
rows.lit: All right then, if that's decided, we'd better hurry!
rows.re: Well, then, let's get busy!

rows.en: @Hmm. Let me see that for a minute.
rows.jp: 「ちょっと<b:8b19><b:8a9a>するの<b:8b6c>発の<b:8b72>撃をね、異空間に<b:8a85>着する / <b:8b33>利な魔法<b:8b6c><b:8b29>があったんだよ〜
rows.re: Hmm. Let me see that for a minute.

rows.en: @Hey... That's strange.
rows.jp: 「あっれ〜 / おかしいな〜<b:8b6c>破するつもりだったのか？
rows.re: Hey... That's strange.

rows.en: >Only you-know-who could have pulled off something like this.
rows.jp: ＞こんなことができるのは / ヤツらしかいない
rows.lit: >Only those guys could have done something like this.
rows.re: >Only you-know-who could have / pulled off something like this.

rows.en: >I need your help.
rows.jp: ＞貴様らの出番だ
rows.lit: >It's your turn now. (your time to act)
rows.re: >I need your help.

rows.en: >The data tablets' ID pattern was detected moving 1southwest0 out of Sielje.
rows.jp: ＞データタブレットから<b:8b73>知される / <8947>作パターンは / シエルジェより[11]お先東の方<894b>[11]ぉに移動中
rows.re: >The data tablets' ID pattern was / detected moving southwest out of / Sielje.

rows.en: >I want you to begin pursuit immediately.
rows.jp: ＞ただちに / 追跡にあたってほしい
rows.lit: >I want you to give chase at once.
rows.re: >I want you to begin pursuit / immediately.

rows.en: @Ah ha! They're going to go through Gate Bridge!
rows.jp: 「そうかッ！ / ゲートブリッジを抜けるつもりだな
rows.lit: I see! They mean to slip through the Gate Bridge.
rows.re: Ah ha! They're going to go through / Gate Bridge!

rows.en: @This key will get you across Gate Bridge. Take it with you.
rows.jp: 「こいつがゲートを渡るのに必要なカギだ / 持っていくがいいよ放を試みている事が〜
rows.lit: This is the key you need to cross the gate. Take it with you.
rows.re: This key will get you across Gate / Bridge. Take it with you.

rows.en: (Wait a sec... How did they even find out we were in Sielje?)
rows.jp: （それよりも〜 / シエルジェ自分<89b7>に<b:8b74>れている事が / 連中にわかったのだろう〜？
rows.re: (Wait a sec... How did they even / find out we were in Sielje?)

rows.en: (Could someone be feeding them information? No! It couldn't be!)
rows.jp: （まさか、街通者が〜 / いや、そんなことは<b:8af2>対に〜）
rows.re: (Could someone be feeding them / information? No! It couldn't be!)

rows.en: @A Spell Bomb that sends a bomb blast between dimensions. Don't you remember that from class?
rows.jp: 「異世界に<b:8b6c>発の<b:8b72>撃を / <b:8a85>移させる結単な魔法<b:8b6c><b:8b29><f040><f042> / <b:8a56><b:8a57>で<b:8a8a>っただろ？
rows.re: A Spell Bomb that sends a bomb / blast between dimensions. Don't you / remember that from class?

rows.jp: [17]<b:8b75>違いするなよなッ！

rows.en: @You'd better not get killed out there, 'cause when you get back, we're going head to head!
rows.jp: 「無事に帰って<b:8a8d>いよ / 帰ってきたら / 俺と<b:8b62><b:8a42>するんだッ！
rows.re: You'd better not get killed out / there, 'cause when you get back, / we're going head to head!

rows.en: @And let me tell you...
rows.jp: 「そして今度こそは<f040><f042><b:8a42>けないから
rows.re: And let me tell you...

rows.en: @I don't have time for this now!
rows.jp: 「こんなところで / 立ち止まってられないの
rows.lit: I can't stand around in a place like this.
rows.re: I don't have time for this now!

rows.en: @Catch ya later!
rows.jp: 「じゃあねッ！
rows.re: Catch ya later!

rows.en: @No matter how many times I measure it, I get the same results.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>そして、何度やっても / 特待結果は同じです〜
rows.re: No matter how many times I measure / it, I get the same results.

rows.en: @It's a huge thermonuclear mass near Sector 326 in Cradle Constellation and it's heading for Filgaia!
rows.jp: 「ゆりかご<8860>方<b:8a76>、３２６付近に / <88bf>大な<8868><b:8a43>反応を確認ッ！ / 現在、ファルガイアに向かって搭近中
rows.re: It's a huge thermonuclear mass near / Sector 326 in Cradle Constellation / and it's heading for Filgaia!

rows.en: @We matched it against the patterns Guild Galad gave us, and it looks like the nuclear weapon Grauswein.
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードから<b:8ac3>族された / パターン<b:8acd>合の結果 / <b:8a43>同時『グラウスヴァイン』と思われます
rows.re: We matched it against the patterns / Guild Galad gave us, and it looks / like the nuclear weapon Grauswein.

rows.en: *Do you want to read it?2
rows.jp: ＊進みますか？[18]か

rows.en: @Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません

rows.en: *Unfortunately, this service is unavailable in the Demo Version.
rows.jp: ＊〜ですが、今回の体験版では / 残念ながら使用することができません

rows.en: @Why is it that people never try to do anything to help the world until a serious danger comes along?
rows.jp: 「でも、いけませんね〜 / 本当に危険な目にあわないと / 立ち上がろうとしないなんて〜
rows.lit: But it won't do; that people won't rise up until they truly face danger... (危機信->危機感)
rows.re: Why is it that people never try to / do anything to help the world until / a serious danger comes along?

rows.en: @But people aren't that worried anymore, because so far nothing bad has happened to them.
rows.jp: 「<8a1b>体的に<889a><889b>を右けないから / 誰も、危機信を乗れさせているけど / これこそ危険なことなのでは？
rows.re: But people aren't that worried / anymore, because so far nothing bad / has happened to them.

rows.en: @Until the other day, I had forgotten how serious things are.
rows.jp: 「私もこのあいだまで / 危機信を失っていましたが〜
rows.lit: Until just the other day, I too had lost my sense of crisis. (危機信->危機感)
rows.re: Until the other day, I had / forgotten how serious things are.

rows.en: @But nothing really terrible happened down here, so after a while, the shock wore off.
rows.jp: 「でも、とくに大きな発ぎが / 起きたわけじゃないから / <b:8a38>々に<b:8a39>れてきちゃったわ
rows.re: But nothing really terrible / happened down here, so after a / while, the shock wore off.

rows.en: @I use the past tense because Archheim is a city of the past. A lost city.
rows.jp: 「そう、過<b:8a3a>面で<b:8a3b>られるように / アークハイムは / 失われた、過<b:8a3a>の場なのです<b:8a3c>の娘エリザは / <b:8a3e><8a0e>を<b:8a3f>ったスレイハイム解放軍を / ひどく恨んでいました
rows.re: I use the past tense because / Archheim is a city of the past. A / lost city.

rows.en: @But she was just a young girl unable to act on her anger. At some point, she disappeared.
rows.jp: 「ですが、数<b:8a42>き娘に / 何ができるものではなく / やがて、この地より<b:8a43>を消したのです
rows.re: But she was just a young girl / unable to act on her anger. At some / point, she disappeared.

rows.en: @If she still lives, she must be a beautiful, full-grown woman by now. I wonder what she's doing now.
rows.jp: 「生きていれば / <b:8a44>しく成長しているはず / 今は、どこで何をしているのか〜<b:8a45><b:8a46>、ヴィクトリア<b:8a3c>は / <b:8a47><b:8a48><8a1e>であるにもかかわらず / 解放軍によって<b:8a49><898e>されたのです
rows.re: If she still lives, she must be a / beautiful, full-grown woman by now. / I wonder what she's doing now.

rows.en: @Only the daughter, Eliza, survived. She harbored a fierce hatred for the Liberation Army.
rows.jp: 「残されたひとり娘のエリザ<b:8a4a>は / 解放軍に強い恨みを / いだいていたといいますが〜
rows.lit: The one surviving daughter, Eliza, is said to have held a fierce hatred for the Liberation Army.
rows.re: The lone surviving daughter, / Eliza, held a fierce hatred / for the Liberation Army.
rows.speaker: townsperson, on Eliza

rows.en: @After the civil war, the Liberation Army disbanded, and Eliza lost her chance to get revenge.
rows.jp: 「街戦の<8865>後、解放軍も<b:8a4b>解してしまい / エリザ<b:8a4a>の恨みははらせぬまま / 今にいたっているのです
rows.lit: After the civil war ended, the Liberation Army fell apart, and Eliza's hatred was never avenged, right up to now.
rows.re: After the war, the Liberation / Army fell apart, and Eliza's / hatred was never avenged.
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @Just like you fought back, right?
rows.jp: 「そう〜 / あなたたちのようにね
rows.lit: Yes... just like all of you.
rows.re: Just like you fought back, right?

rows.en: @Who knows what they'll do. It's frightening just to think of it.
rows.jp: 「だからこそ / ここからの動きが / <889c>ろしいのよ〜
rows.re: Who knows what they'll do. It's / frightening just to think of it.

rows.en: @A big group came here to buy food and weapons. They were part of your team, right?
rows.jp: 「大<b:8a4c>でやってきて / <b:8a4d><b:8a4e>とか食料とかを調達していたのは / あなたと、その<b:8a4f>間だったわよね
rows.re: A big group came here to buy food / and weapons. They were part of your / team, right?

rows.en: @They bought whatever they could get their hands on, then headed for the southern desert. Was that Odessa?
rows.jp: 「大<886f>の物<b:8a50>をかき<8880>めて / 先の<88db>の道に向かっていったそうじゃない / あれがウワサのオデッサかしら？<b:8a62>
rows.re: They bought whatever they could get / their hands on, then headed for the / southern desert. Was that Odessa?

rows.en: @Just like this strange phenomenon.
rows.jp: 「この<b:8a51>変地異も、そう〜
rows.re: Just like this strange phenomenon.

rows.en: @This threat affects everyone in Filgaia. It's taken all the fun out of gossiping.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアに生きる全<b:8a52>に / ふりかかる脅威だから / ウワサを聞いてもおもしろくなんかないわ
rows.re: This threat affects everyone in / Filgaia. It's taken all the fun out / of gossiping.

rows.en: @I'm a little nervous, but to be honest, I'm not afraid.
rows.jp: 「たしかに不安はあるけど / 新<8865>言って、<b:8a53>れはないの
rows.re: I'm a little nervous, but to be / honest, I'm not afraid.

rows.en: @It's as if my senses have been numbed by the strangeness of what's happening.
rows.jp: 「あまりにも / <896a>世<b:8a54>な出<b:8a55>事ばかりだから / どこか信信がマヒしているのかも〜民衆の<b:8a58>方だった<b:8a45><b:8a46>まで / まとめて<b:8a49><898e>されたってハナシじゃない
rows.re: It's as if my senses have been / numbed by the strangeness of what's / happening.

rows.en: @The Slayheim Liberation Army may seem like heroes, but they have a lot of dark secrets.
rows.jp: 「スレイハイム解放戦役っていうと / 何だかカッコイイけれど / いろいろと<888c>いウワサは<b:8a59>えないわ
rows.re: The Slayheim Liberation Army may / seem like heroes, but they have a / lot of dark secrets.

rows.en: @War is war, no matter how lofty some people may try to make it seem.
rows.jp: 「そうよね / どんなに取り<b:8a5a>っても / 戦<b:8a5b>は戦<b:8a5b>だもの<b:8a5c>合して / <b:8a5d>の<89af><b:8a5e>で<b:8a5f>ってしまっても / ５数前の<b:8a60><b:8a61>は消えないものよ
rows.re: War is war, no matter how lofty / some people may try to make it / seem.

rows.en: @That's because people will always gossip about what happened.
rows.jp: 「人が生きている<b:8a62>り / ウワサは口の<b:8a63>にのぼるもんだからね<b:8a64><b:8a65>のために役立てたい / ３．ウワサならアテにならない[1a]が<b:8a5d>にのまれた<89af><b:8a5e>に / かつてのスレイハイムの<b:8a66> / アークハイムが今なおあるみたいだね
rows.re: That's because people will always / gossip about what happened.

rows.en: @They say it's a town of the dead, inhabited by tormented souls that can't rest.
rows.jp: 「今となっては / <b:8a67>かばれない<b:8a68>がさまよう / 死者の場となっているとか〜<b:8a5d>の鍵が見えてくるわ
rows.re: They say it's a town of the dead, / inhabited by tormented souls that / can't rest.

rows.en: @That's where Archheim, capital of Slayheim, used to be.
rows.jp: 「そこは、スレイハイムの<89fb><b:8a66> / アークハイムがあった場所なのよ
rows.re: That's where Archheim, capital of / Slayheim, used to be.

rows.en: @Archheim once prospered because of the Live Reflector there.
rows.jp: 「アークハイムには / ライブリフレクターが備えられていて / それを中心に<b:8a69>えていたの
rows.re: Archheim once prospered because of / the Live Reflector there.

rows.en: @But in the civil war 5 years ago, the city's splendor and life was engulfed in a sea of salt.
rows.jp: 「でも、５数前の街戦で / かつての<b:8a69><b:8a6a>も人の命も / 全部、<b:8a5d>にのまれてしまったけどね
rows.re: But in the civil war 5 years ago, / the city's splendor and life was / engulfed in a sea of salt.

rows.en: @The area is haunted by the ghosts of the people of Archheim, they say.
rows.jp: 「今や、アークハイムの<b:8a6b>人は / <b:8a67>かばれない亡者ばかりと聞いてるわ
rows.re: The area is haunted by the ghosts / of the people of Archheim, they / say.

rows.en: @You'd better take this so that you don't end up as one of them.
rows.jp: 「これでも持っていって / 彼らの<b:8a4f>間にならないように / 気をつけなさいよ<b:8a6c>実は<b:8a6d>まれているものよ
rows.re: You'd better take this so that you / don't end up as one of them.

rows.en: @What's important is the wisdom to see the truth in any rumor.
rows.jp: 「ようするに、見<b:8a6e>めるための / <8942><898e>力が大事ってことね民衆の<b:8a58>方だった<b:8a45><b:8a46>まで / まとめて<b:8a49><898e>されたってハナシじゃない
rows.re: What's important is the wisdom to / see the truth in any rumor.

rows.en: @The Slayheim Liberation Army may seem like heroes, but they have a lot of dark secrets.
rows.jp: 「スレイハイム解放戦役っていうと / 何だかカッコイイけれど / いろいろと<888c>いウワサは<b:8a59>えないわ
rows.re: The Slayheim Liberation Army may / seem like heroes, but they have a / lot of dark secrets.

rows.en: @War is war, no matter how lofty some people may try to make it seem.
rows.jp: 「そうよね / どんなに取り<b:8a5a>っても / 戦<b:8a5b>は戦<b:8a5b>だもの<b:8a6f>きというだけで / まゆをひそめる人もいるけれど / これは私なりの情報<8939><8880>なのよ<b:8a70>るものではないものね
rows.re: War is war, no matter how lofty / some people may try to make it / seem.

rows.en: @but there's something that's been bothering me.
rows.jp: 「ちょっと / 気になることがあるのよね
rows.lit: There's something that's been nagging at me.
rows.re: but there's something that's been / bothering me.

rows.en: @Have you noticed that wherever you go, your foes, Odessa, always appear there, too?
rows.jp: 「どうしてあんたたちの行くところ / 相であるオデッサが / 必ず現われるのかしら？
rows.lit: Why is it that Odessa, your enemy, always turns up wherever you go? (相->敵)
rows.re: Have you noticed that wherever you / go, your foes, Odessa, always / appear there, too?

rows.en: @Could it be that information about what you're doing is being leaked to Odessa?
rows.jp: 「もしかして / あんたたちの情報が / 向こうに<b:8a71>抜けなんじゃないの？
rows.re: Could it be that information about / what you're doing is being leaked / to Odessa?

rows.en: @So how is it that wherever you go, Odessa always seems to be waiting there for you?
rows.jp: 「なのに、行く先々で / オデッサに出くわすなんて / 不思議な話だとは思わない？
rows.lit: And yet you run into Odessa everywhere you go; don't you find that strange?
rows.re: So how is it that wherever you go, / Odessa always seems to be waiting / there for you?

rows.en: @There must be a spy in your midst!
rows.jp: 「そうよッ！ / スパイよ、<b:8a72><8804>者、街通者よッ！
rows.re: There must be a spy in your midst!

rows.en: @There just HAS to be! I'm sure of it!
rows.jp: 「きっとそういうのが / いるに違わないわッ！
rows.lit: There's got to be something like that! I'm sure of it! (違わない->違いない)
rows.re: There just HAS to be! I'm sure of / it!

rows.en: @You must have some idea of who it could be...
rows.jp: 「気をつけてごらんなさい / ホラ、心当たりが / あるんじゃないかしら〜<b:8a64>時にあっては<88f6><889b>なのかもしれません
rows.re: You must have some idea of who it / could be...

rows.en: @Or it could be a large-scale disaster, something with massive powers. Or...
rows.jp: 「それも大きな<88f6><889b>〜 / <b:8a73><889b>、<b:8a73><b:8a74>と呼ばれるような / <88bf>大な力が、あるいは〜<b:8a75>げとなっていた / 大地の<b:8a76><b:8a77>、ビッグバレー〜
rows.re: Or it could be a large-scale / disaster, something with massive / powers. Or...

rows.en: @But it did stop the land from being completely engulfed in salt.
rows.jp: 「ですが、大地が<88ad>全に<b:8a5d>にのまれるのを / <8988>止してくれたのも事実なのです
rows.re: But it did stop the land from being / completely engulfed in salt.

rows.en: @You never know how something is going to benefit you.
rows.jp: 「世の中、いったい何が / うまく作用するのかわからないものです<b:8a78>てるのでしょう？
rows.re: You never know how something is / going to benefit you.

rows.en: @This planet has already been ruined. There's nothing to be so surprised about now.
rows.jp: 「ここはかつて / 大地を失った世界〜 / 今さら<8845>きはしませんよ<b:8a5e>[11]ぉにて / <b:8a5d>にのみこまれた場を発見しても / そこには近づかない方がいいですよ
rows.re: This planet has already been / ruined. There's nothing to be so / surprised about now.

rows.en: @It is what's left of Archheim, heart of the former Slayheim Kingdom.
rows.jp: 「その<b:8a79><b:8a66>の名はアークハイム〜 / スレイハイム<b:8a7a>の中心ともいえる / 大きな場の亡<b:8a7b>です<b:8a7c>次の遺<b:8a7d>が / 年多く<89bb>っているそうです
rows.re: It is what's left of Archheim, / heart of the former Slayheim / Kingdom.

rows.en: @The Mercs are convinced they'll strike it rich there, but I have my doubts.
rows.jp: 「渡り左たちが / 一<b:8a7e><b:8a7f>金を<b:8a80>見ているそうですが / さて、うまくいくのでしょうか？<b:8a5d>に<b:8a5f>われた<89af><b:8a5e>が<89da>がっています
rows.re: The Mercs are convinced they'll / strike it rich there, but I have my / doubts.

rows.en: @Buried in the sand are the remains of the former military superpower of Slayheim.
rows.jp: 「その<b:8a5d>の辺には / かつて、スレイハイムと呼ばれた / 軍事大<b:8a7a>があったのです〜<b:8a76><b:8a77>、ビッグバレーにかけられた / 谷の<89ec>の上にできた場なんですよ<b:8a81><b:8a82>を呼び / <b:8a60>しみを<b:8a83>く〜
rows.re: Buried in the sand are the remains / of the former military superpower / of Slayheim.

rows.en: @But the weak-hearted may also be more willing to turn to others and join hands with them for help.
rows.jp: 「だけど、<89b9>い心ゆえに / 手を取り合い<b:8a84>力していくすべを / 知っているものなのかもしれない<b:8a85>に対して / <b:8a86><b:8a7a>一<88a8>で<88cc>撃にあたったらしいな
rows.re: But the weak-hearted may also be / more willing to turn to others and / join hands with them for help.

rows.en: @This would have been unthinkable in the past. But today, nations are joining in unity.
rows.jp: 「以前では考えられなかったことだ / <b:8a7a>と<b:8a7a>、人と人とが / 手を取り合っていくなんて…<b:8a81>う心ってのは / どんなに小さな一帯でも / <b:8a38>々に<89da>がって、心を<b:8a87>んでいく
rows.re: This would have been unthinkable in / the past. But today, nations are / joining in unity.

rows.en: @In the end, the heart is devoured, just as the sky was.
rows.jp: 「最後には / この空のようになっちまうものさ<b:8a81>われるようなことが / あったんじゃないのか？
rows.re: In the end, the heart is devoured, / just as the sky was.

rows.en: @If you truly believed in your friend, you could have found a way to disprove your suspicions.
rows.jp: 「あんたも本当に<b:8a4f>間を信じているなら / <b:8a81>いを<b:8a88>らす方法だって / あったと僕は思うぜ<b:8a4f>間を<b:8a81>わせてしまったかもな / 〜悪かったと思ってる<b:8a81>うってのは / それだけ心が<89b9>いからさ
rows.re: If you truly believed in your / friend, you could have found a way / to disprove your suspicions.

rows.en: @But then, someone with no weaknesses at all would be flawed as a human being.
rows.jp: 「でもよ、<89b9>さを<89b8><b:8a89>も持っていない / <88ad><b:8a8a>な心を持っているヤツは / 人間として、どこか欠けているに違いない
rows.re: But then, someone with no / weaknesses at all would be flawed / as a human being.

rows.en: @Don't you think so?
rows.jp: 「そう、思わないか？
rows.re: Don't you think so?

rows.en: @You were with that shady-looking bunch that came to town!
rows.jp: 「あんた、あやしい連中とつるんで / 近頃この場に出<b:8a8b>しているよな？
rows.re: You were with that shady-looking / bunch that came to town!

rows.en: @You aren't part of that terrorist group, Odessa, are you?
rows.jp: 「あんた、まさか / テロリスト・オデッサに / <b:8a8c>しているんじゃないだろうな<b:8a4f>間の誰とは言わないけど / <b:8a4d><b:8a8d>した一<897d>といっしょに行動しているのを / 僕は確かに見たんだ
rows.re: You aren't part of that terrorist / group, Odessa, are you?

rows.en: @And, no, I'm not mistaken!
rows.jp: 「見間違いなんかじゃないッ！
rows.re: And, no, I'm not mistaken!

rows.en: @I won't say who, but I'm sure there is a traitor in your group. Be careful.
rows.jp: 「悪いことは言わない / あんたらの中に<b:8a8e>切り者がいる / 気をつけたほうがいい<b:8a8f>地の人間が / スレイハイム解放戦役を生き抜けたのは / 誰もが手を取り、あきらめなかったからだ
rows.re: I won't say who, but I'm sure there / is a traitor in your group. Be / careful.

rows.en: @If the people of Filgaia would pull together like that, we could make it through this peril.
rows.jp: 「もしも、ファルガイア中の人間が / 同方に手を取り、あきらめなかったとすれば / この異世事態、切り抜けられるのかもな<b:8a90>作の危機〜 / <894f>げる場所なんて、どこにもない
rows.re: If the people of Filgaia would pull / together like that, we could make / it through this peril.

rows.en: @But that doesn't mean we should just give up.
rows.jp: 「だからといって / すべてを<88ab>げ出すつもりはない
rows.re: But that doesn't mean we should / just give up.

rows.en: @The people of Slayheim have beat the odds before.
rows.jp: 「私たち、スレイハイムの民は / かつて<b:8a59><b:8a91>を<b:8a92>り<b:8a93>えてきたんだ
rows.re: The people of Slayheim have beat / the odds before.

rows.en: @And we can do it again.
rows.jp: 「今度も右け止めてみせるだけだ
rows.lit: This time too, I'll just have to hold it back. (右け->受け止める)
rows.re: And we can do it again.

rows.en: @But how long can we stand up to something that devours the sky itself?
rows.jp: 「だが、空を失うといった / <b:8a94>無的な<b:8a73><889b>に対して / どこまで<b:8a95>えるのだろうか？
rows.re: But how long can we stand up to / something that devours the sky / itself?

rows.en: @I don't know the answer to that one.
rows.jp: 「私には / わかりかねるな<b:8a96><b:8a97>〜
rows.re: I don't know the answer to that / one.

rows.en: @Vinsfeld made a deal with Slayheim, they say.
rows.jp: 「ヴィンスフェルトは / スレイハイム<b:8a7a>と / 取り招きを<88fa>わそうとしたという
rows.re: Vinsfeld made a deal with Slayheim, / they say.

rows.en: @In exchange for shutting down the resistance, he schemed to acquire wealth and power.
rows.jp: 「レジスタンス<b:8a98>動の<8996>止と招き<88fb>えに / <b:8a99>と<88b2>力をつかもうと / <b:8a9a><88ce>したそうだ
rows.re: In exchange for shutting down the / resistance, he schemed to acquire / wealth and power.

rows.en: @But that wasn't what the people who joined the Liberation Army were risking their lives for.
rows.jp: 「そんなつもりのために / 解放軍に<b:8a9b><b:8a9c>した民衆たちは / 命を<b:8a9d>したわけではない
rows.re: But that wasn't what the people who / joined the Liberation Army were / risking their lives for.

rows.en: @Naturally, there was a great backlash, and support for Vinsfeld plummeted.
rows.jp: 「当<8844>、大きく反発され / その時を<b:8a9e>にヴィンスフェルトの<b:8a9f>持は / 辺降<b:8aa0>の一<b:8aa1>をたどったらしい
rows.re: Naturally, there was a great / backlash, and support for Vinsfeld / plummeted.

rows.en: @That backlash must have been what drove Vinsfeld to sell out the Liberation Army.
rows.jp: 「その時の確<b:8aa2>が / 後に解放軍を売り渡すなどという / <b:8aa4><b:8a86>につながったんだろうな軍といえば / あの街戦の立役者〜 / <b:8a6a>々しいイメージがつきものだ
rows.re: That backlash must have been what / drove Vinsfeld to sell out the / Liberation Army.

rows.en: @But what happened to them after the war was tragic.
rows.jp: 「だが、その最後は / あまりにも<b:8a60><b:8aa5>であったと
rows.lit: But their end, they say, was far too tragic.
rows.re: But their end, they say, / was far too tragic.
rows.speaker: townsperson

rows.en: @Their leader, Vinsfeld, sought to use the Liberation Army for his own personal gain, some say.
rows.jp: 「リーダーのヴィンスフェルトは / 私的な目<b:8aa6>見のために解放軍を利用しようと / たくらんでいたというではないか
rows.lit: Their leader Vinsfeld, they say, schemed to use the Liberation Army for his own private ends.
rows.re: Their leader Vinsfeld schemed / to use the Liberation Army / for his own private ends.
rows.speaker: townsperson, on Vinsfeld

rows.en: @Some say he sold out the Liberation Army to avoid being condemned as a war criminal along with the rest.
rows.jp: 「それどころか / 戦後、戦犯として自身の立場が危うくなると / 保身のために解放軍を売ったとも〜
rows.lit: Worse, when his standing grew shaky as a war criminal after the war, he sold out the Liberation Army to save his own skin.
rows.re: Worse: when he faced war-crime / charges, he sold out the / Army to save his own skin.
rows.speaker: townsperson, the betrayal

rows.en: @Who knows what Vinsfeld really did, or why he did it.
rows.jp: 「<b:8a3b>られる事実と / <b:8a3b>られない<b:8a6c>実〜
rows.re: Who knows what Vinsfeld really did, / or why he did it.

rows.en: @The same goes for the Slayheim Liberation War.
rows.jp: 「スレイハイムの戦いもまた / <8844>りなのだ〜<b:8a60><b:8a61>の / 終結だったのだろうか？
rows.re: The same goes for the Slayheim / Liberation War.

rows.en: @The Victorias were moderates, but were executed on the grounds they collaborated with the king.
rows.jp: 「スレイハイムの<b:8a7a><b:8aa7>に異を<b:8aa8>えていた / <b:8a47><b:8a48><8a1e><b:8a45><b:8a46>ヴィクトリア<b:8a3c>は / <89fb>に連なるものとして<b:8a49><898e>されたという
rows.re: The Victorias were moderates, but / were executed on the grounds they / collaborated with the king.

rows.en: @Only one escaped the guillotine, a young daughter who fled filled with hatred for the Liberation Army.
rows.jp: 「当<b:8aa9>は<898e><b:8aaa><b:8aab>の<b:8aac>と消え / 数<b:8a42>いひとり娘は解放軍を<b:8aad>みながら / 行方をくらませたと聞いている
rows.lit: The head of the house vanished on the gallows; the one surviving daughter fled, hating the Liberation Army.
rows.re: The head of the house died on / the gallows; his daughter fled, / hating the Liberation Army.
rows.speaker: townsperson, Eliza flees

rows.en: @Sadness begets sadness, they say. That's just what happened, don't you think?
rows.jp: 「<b:8a60>しみは / <b:8a60>しみを呼ぶと言うが / まさにその言葉通りだと思わないか？<b:8a89>に隠された / <88bf>大建<b:8aae>物があるとのウワサだ
rows.re: Sadness begets sadness, they say. / That's just what happened, don't / you think?

rows.en: @That may have something to do with that shady group that bought up all those supplies in town.
rows.jp: 「あやしい一<897d>がこの場から / 大<886f>の物<b:8a50>を<b:8aaf>出していたとの話と / 何か関係あるのかもしれぬ
rows.re: That may have something to do with / that shady group that bought up all / those supplies in town.

rows.en: @Maybe they were the ones everyone's making such a fuss about -- Odessa!
rows.jp: 「もしや、あの一<897d>こそが / <b:8ab0>を発がすオデッサなる<b:8ab1>だろうか？
rows.re: Maybe they were the ones everyone's / making such a fuss about, Odessa!

rows.en: @You're with the group that took supplies into the desert, right? I remember your sharp eyes.
rows.jp: 「そうだ、先の<88db>の道に物<b:8a50>を運んでいた / あの連中の<b:8a4f>間だろ？ / その<b:8ab2>い目、忘れはしないぞ
rows.re: You're with the group that took / supplies into the desert, right? I / remember your sharp eyes.

rows.en: @So how come you're not with them today?
rows.jp: 「だが、今回はなぜ / 連中と行動を<b:8ab3>にしていないのだ<b:8ab4>いるヴィンスフェルトなる悪<b:8ab5> / あいつは元・スレイハイム解放軍の / リーダーであったという
rows.re: So how come you're not with them / today?

rows.en: @Maybe Odessa is just a bunch of Liberation Army troops who were down on their luck after the war.
rows.jp: 「ならば、行き場を失った / スレイハイム解放軍の残<b:8ab6>が / オデッサなのだろうか？<b:8ab7>の<b:8ab8>は / <8a10><b:8ab9>させてもらいたいものだよ英雄』のような / 存在の人間がでてきてさ / さっさと空を元に戻してくれないかねぇ
rows.re: Maybe Odessa is just a bunch of / Liberation Army troops who were / down on their luck after the war.

rows.en: @Why such a stern look, young man? Did I offend you? What? That's how you normally look? Oh...
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>ん？ / お<b:8abc>さん、<889c>い探してどうしたんだい？ / あぁ、元からだったかねぇ英雄』のような / 存在の人間がでてきてさ / さっさと空を元に戻してくれないかねぇ英雄』が / 必要なんじゃないかね英雄の名前は知ってるけど / 実<89d2>には見たことないのよ
rows.re: Why such a stern look, young man? / Did I offend you? What? That's how / you normally look? Oh...

rows.en: @People exaggerate, but I'm still sure his exploits are beyond what the average person can do.
rows.jp: 「まぁ、英雄話に<b:8abd><b:8abe>はつきものだけど / でも世人では考えられないほどの / 戦<b:8abf>をあげたに違いないわ英雄の名前は知ってるけど / 実<89d2>には見たことないのよ
rows.re: People exaggerate, but I'm still / sure his exploits are beyond what / the average person can do.

rows.en: @Maybe that's how it is with heroes, but I still wish I could have seen him just once.
rows.jp: 「英雄なんて / 得てしてそんなものなのかねぇ / 一度くらいは見たかった気がするね<b:8ac0><b:8ac1> / そういったものが必要なのかねぇ
rows.re: Maybe that's how it is with heroes, / but I still wish I could have seen / him just once.

rows.en: @The Slayheim Liberation Army had some hero named 1 as its symbol, right?
rows.jp: 「スレイハイムの解放軍の<b:8ac0><b:8ac1>は / [05]おとかいう / 英雄だったっていう話しだけどね軍には[05]おっていう / 英雄がいたらしいけど〜〜
rows.re: The Slayheim Liberation Army had / some hero named as its symbol, / right?

rows.en: @One person can't change the course of a war, right? Isn't is strange how things get exaggerated?
rows.jp: 「戦<b:8a5b>って、一人の英雄の力で / どうにかなるものなのかしらねぇ / 話しが<b:8abd><b:8abe>されてるんじゃないのかい？軍にとっては / <b:8a60>しい<b:8ac2>利でしかないだろうね
rows.re: One person can't change the course / of a war, right? Isn't is strange / how things get exaggerated?

rows.en: @What did they fight for? What did they die for? They died in vain, if you ask me.
rows.jp: 「なんのために戦い / なんのために死んでいったのか / 無<b:8ac3>に命を<b:8ac4>らしただけじゃない<b:8a5d>となったスレイハイム / それを見るたびに / 人の<b:8ac5>かさを信じてしまうねぇ
rows.re: What did they fight for? What did / they die for? They died in vain, if / you ask me.

rows.en: @Why did things have to go that far? How foolish people are.
rows.jp: 「なんであそこまで / しなきゃならいのかねぇ / 本当に、<b:8ac5>かしいことだね<b:8ac6>う<b:8ac6>う<b:8a7c><b:8ac6>わない英雄の出現を / 待っているだけの<b:8ac7><888e>なんて / もう無いのかもしれない
rows.re: Why did things have to go that far? / How foolish people are.

rows.en: @We have to figure out what we ordinary people can do right now.
rows.jp: 「だとすれば / 英雄ではない僕たちができることを / 今回にでも見つけなければならないな英雄の<b:8ac8><b:8a55>を<b:8a91>んでいるとしたら / それは<b:8a66>合のいい考えではないだろうか？<b:8a53>れを<b:8ac9>じ得ない〜
rows.re: We have to figure out what we / ordinary people can do right now.

rows.en: @But people don't seem to be worried to the point of taking action.
rows.jp: 「だが、どこか<8886><b:8abe>信が / 欠けているようにも思われるのだ
rows.re: But people don't seem to be worried / to the point of taking action.

rows.en: @Maybe they're all waiting for a hero to appear, like during the civil war 5 years ago.
rows.jp: 「５数前の街戦のように / 誰もが英雄の出現を / <b:8a91>んでいるのではなかろうか<b:8aca><b:8abf>は / 特り知れないだろう
rows.re: Maybe they're all waiting for a / hero to appear, like during the / civil war 5 years ago.

rows.en: @But that's not the real reason he deserves to be called a hero.
rows.jp: 「だが、<b:8a6c>に[05]おを / 英雄と呼ばしめる理由は / そこではないのだ
rows.lit: But the real reason he's called a hero isn't that.
rows.re: But that's not the real reason / he's called a hero.
rows.speaker: {0}? / a saved soldier, on the true hero

rows.en: @He is a hero because he sacrificed himself to protect his war buddies after they were sold out.
rows.jp: 「あの<b:8acb><b:8acc><b:8ab5>によって売られた解放軍同胞を / <b:8ace>が身を<b:8acf><b:8ad0>にして<b:8ad1>り抜いたところこそ / 彼を英雄たらしめているのだ<b:8a96><b:8a97>〜 / 生死不次とも報じられた / 英雄[05]お・エヴァンス〜
rows.lit: What makes him a hero is that he shielded with his own body the comrades sold out by that betrayal.
rows.re: He's a hero because he shielded / with his own body the comrades / that betrayal had sold out.
rows.speaker: saved soldier, the sacrifice

rows.en: @But he reappeared and used himself as bait to save a group of his comrades from their pursuers.
rows.jp: 「でも、彼は、<b:8ac8>び<b:8a43>を現わすと / 追跡部隊から同胞の目をそらすため / <b:8ad2>の役をかって出たんだ
rows.lit: But he reappeared and volunteered to be the decoy, drawing the pursuit squad's eyes off his comrades.
rows.re: But he reappeared and made / himself the decoy, to draw the / pursuers off his comrades.
rows.speaker: saved soldier

rows.en: @Naturally, the pursuers went after 1 because they thought a |hero| would be more valuable.
rows.jp: 「英雄の名前には<b:8ad3><8875>があるから / 追っ手はこぞって / [05]おをねらったという
rows.lit: A hero's name has value, so the pursuers all went after {1}, they say.
rows.re: A |hero's| name has value, so / the pursuers all came after / {1} instead.
rows.speaker: saved soldier

rows.en: @He gave the ex-soldiers who were being chased a chance to escape. They were just peasants, you know.
rows.jp: 「彼のおかげで / 元解放軍に<b:8a9b><b:8a9c>した民衆は / 追跡部隊から<894f>れることができたんだ
rows.lit: Thanks to him, the common folk who'd joined the old Liberation Army could escape the pursuit squad.
rows.re: Thanks to him, the common folk / who'd joined the Army could / slip away from the pursuers.
rows.speaker: saved soldier

rows.en: @I'm one of those former Slayheim Liberation Army soldiers who was saved by 1 the Hero.
rows.jp: 「この僕も / 英雄[05]おに<8832>われた / 元スレイハイム解放軍なんだよ〜<b:8a50>を / <88db>の道に向かって<b:8aaf>出していったな〜
rows.lit: I too am a former Slayheim Liberation Army man, saved by {1} the hero.
rows.re: I'm one of them, an old Slayheim / Liberation Army man that / |hero| {1} saved.
rows.speaker: saved soldier, the reveal

rows.en: @I know... because they hired us to help them carry all that stuff.
rows.jp: 「僕たちも<b:8ad4>われて / 連中を手伝っていたから / まちがいはない〜
rows.re: I know... because they hired us to / help them carry all that stuff.

rows.en: @I can tell you more, but... I hate to ask you for money, but it would really help me out.3
rows.jp: 「そのことを話すのは<8968>わないが / 悪い〜 / いくらか<b:8a66>合してもらえないだろうか〜？[18]が<b:8ad5>重のギャラを / 持っていないようだが？<b:8a89>の向こうに / その、<88bf>大なプラントはあった
rows.re: I can tell you more, but... I hate / to ask you for money, but it would / really help me out.3

rows.en: @We were hired to haul weapons and food to that plant.
rows.jp: 「僕たちは、そのプラントに / <b:8a4d><b:8a4e>や食料を<b:8aaf>出しに行ったんだが〜<b:8ad5>重のギャラを / 持っていないようだが？<b:8a89>の向こうに / その、<88bf>大なプラントはあった
rows.re: We were hired to haul weapons and / food to that plant.

rows.en: @We were hired to haul weapons and food to that plant.
rows.jp: 「僕たちは、そのプラントに / <b:8a4d><b:8a4e>や食料を<b:8aaf>出しに行ったんだ
rows.re: We were hired to haul weapons and / food to that plant.

rows.en: @They brought in massive amounts of supplies for some secret plan that's underway there.
rows.jp: 「そこでは / 大<886f>の物<b:8a50>を調達して / <b:8ad6><b:8a72><b:8a8e>な特<b:8a9a>をすすめていたようだ
rows.re: They brought in massive amounts of / supplies for some secret plan / that's underway there.

rows.en: @I saw a barge anchored at the shore nearby, so they must have brought their supplies in by sea, as well.
rows.jp: 「<89f5>には、<8999>陸<b:8ad7>を<8996>められる / 海岸もあったから / 道<89ca>からの物<b:8a50>の<b:8aaf>入もあったんだろう
rows.re: I saw a barge anchored at the shore / nearby, so they must have brought / their supplies in by sea, as well.

rows.en: @But that's not all. Something else happened there that day.
rows.jp: 「だが、あの回は / それだけではなかったのだ〜
rows.lit: But on that day, that wasn't all that happened. (回->日)
rows.re: But that's not all. Something else / happened there that day.

rows.en: @When we finished bringing in the cargo we were carrying, the pigs started shooting at us!
rows.jp: 「作<b:8ad8>が終ると / 連中は僕たちに向かって / <b:8ad9>を撃ってきたんだ
rows.re: When we finished bringing in the / cargo we were carrying, the pigs / started shooting at us!

rows.en: @I managed to escape with my life, but none of the others did.
rows.jp: 「僕は命からがら<894f>げのびたが / 他の<b:8a4f>間はみんな〜
rows.re: I managed to escape with my life, / but none of the others did.

rows.en: @Damn them! Just who the hell are those guys, anyway?!
rows.jp: 「くそッ、ヤツら / いったい何だったんだッ！<b:8a4f>間の<b:8ada>を建てるため / ギャラが必要なんだがな軍の英雄 / [05]お・エヴァンスといえば / 誰でも知っている名前だ
rows.re: Damn them! Just who the hell are / those guys, anyway?!

rows.en: @But everyone who knew him died in the war, so no one knows his face. Not even a single photo survives.
rows.jp: 「だが、あの戦役の中 / <b:8adb><b:8a6c>も近しい者も失われてしまい / その探を知る者は誰もいない
rows.re: But everyone who knew him died in / the war, so no one knows his face. / Not even a single photo survives.

rows.en: @I'm sure that's part of the reason everyone wants to make him into some sort of legend.
rows.jp: 「そのあたりが / 彼の英雄合、伝説合に / <b:8adc><89dd>をかけているのじゃないのか？<b:8add><b:8aae><b:8ade><b:8add><b:8aae>するんだい？<b:8add><b:8aae>するんだい？<b:8add><b:8aae>するかい？<b:8add><b:8aae>は無理だぜ<b:8adf><b:8ae0><b:8ae1><898d><b:8add><b:8aae>
rows.re: I'm sure that's part of the reason / everyone wants to make him into / some sort of legend.

rows.en: @Do you think it was just a coincidence? Or something else?
rows.jp: 「あんたらが<b:8ae5><b:8ae6>されたのは / <b:8ae7><8844>なのか〜？ / それとも〜恨念<f040><f042> / <b:8a85>の脅威を何とか回<b:8ae8>できたのも / あんたらＡＲＭＳのおかげだよ
rows.re: Do you think it was just a / coincidence? Or something else?

rows.en: @ARMS sure was formed just in time to save us from the dangers of these turbulent times.

rows.en: @There's a soldier who stays here often, but he's run up a large bill. I hope he has money...
rows.jp: 「でも、あの同隊さんは / いつも緒まってくれるのよ / ありがたいけど〜 お金、大<b:8a3e><b:8a3f>なのかな？<b:8a40>てくれたの / 今度、お<8928>に無料で緒めてあげよかな？
rows.re: There's a soldier who stays here / often, but he's run up a large / bill. I hope he has money...

rows.en: @I always thought of soldiers as tough, macho types, but this one was very kind to me!
rows.jp: 「とても、うれしかったよ / 同隊って、<889c>そうなイメージがあったけど / あの同隊さんはやさしかったな
rows.re: I always thought of soldiers as / tough, macho types, but this one / was very kind to me!

rows.en: @I wonder why?
rows.jp: 「なんでだろ？<b:8a64>の<b:8a5e>をお探し？ / ウチの<b:8a5e>に何回も緒まれば / 何かいいコトがあるかもよ<f04a><b:8a3e><b:8a3f>だ / あの空もその街なんとかなる / なんたって<f040><f041><f042>
rows.re: I wonder why?

rows.en: @Guild Galad has the most advanced science in the world! Yee-haw!
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードの<b:8a65><b:8a66>力は / 世界一ぃぃぃぃッ！<b:8a67>の / スーパーウェポンを<b:8a3b>備してたからだろ？<b:8a64>になったって / たとえ空が<888c>くなったって / このギルドグラードには<8934>気の<89e0>があるッ！<b:8a68>口をひねれば水が出るんだぜ
rows.re: Guild Galad has the most advanced / science in the world! Yee-haw!

rows.en: @What about your village? Do they still use well water? They do? I knew it.
rows.jp: 「アンタの<89de><b:8a69>はどうなの？ / やっぱり、<b:8a6a><b:8a6b>？ / そっかそっか、やっぱりそうだろうなぁ<b:8a40>た人たちだね？
rows.re: What about your village? Do they / still use well water? They do? I / knew it.

rows.en: @Here in Guild Galad, city-state of industry, people dress flashier.
rows.jp: 「ここは、<8a13><b:8a50><b:8a51><b:8a52>置<b:8a6c>ギルドグラードッ！ / ハイテクな場だぜ<b:8a6d>の<b:8a5e><b:8a39>に緒まるのが / つらくなってきたよ〜<b:8a6e>ッ！ / ドラゴンを倒してくれたキミたちにも信<b:8a6e>ッ / おかげで、またキッカケがつくれたよ
rows.re: Here in Guild Galad, city-state of / industry, people dress flashier.

rows.en: @Oops. Maybe it was indiscreet of me to say that. Ahem.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>あ、ごめん / ちょっと不<b:8a6f><b:8a70>だったね〜<b:8a6d>と話をするコトができたよ / キッカケが、あの<888c>い空っていうのが / ちょっと<88c4>けないけどね〜<b:8a5e><b:8a39>の<b:8a6d>さん〜 / かわいいよなぁ / 何かキッカケがあれば〜<b:8a71>次と同じく / 滅びの道を<b:8a72>むしかないのか〜？<b:8a73>ドラゴンは、我々がドラゴンの遺跡を / <88ea><b:8a67>していることへの / <b:8a75>みもあったのかもしれんの〜
rows.re: Oops. Maybe it was indiscreet of me / to say that. Ahem.

rows.en: @What we are doing is a form of blasphemy against the gods and the dragons.
rows.jp: 「我々のしていることは / <b:8a76>とドラゴンに対する / いわば<8a2b><b:8a77>行為じゃからな〜<b:8a66>的に見てもかなり<b:8a78><b:8a79>があるな<b:8a7a><b:8a7b>を見たまえ / すばらしいだろう / これが『幻獣ドラゴン』の『合谷』だッ！
rows.re: What we are doing is a form of / blasphemy against the gods and the / dragons.

rows.en: @Long, long, ago, in a galaxy... I mean, in Filgaia, these frightful creatures ruled the world!
rows.jp: 「はるか<b:8a7c> / このファルガイアに様<b:8a7d>していた / <889c>るべき<b:8a7e>配者の<b:8a7f>だッ！<b:8a73>ドラゴンを倒してしまうとは / さすがＡＲＭＳだ
rows.re: Long, long, ago, in a galaxy... I / mean, in Filgaia, these frightful / creatures ruled the world!

rows.en: @With Guild Galad's technology, we could clean up that dirty sky in no time!
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードの<b:8a42><b:8a5b>力を持ってすれば / あの<b:8a88>ねぇ空なんか / イッパツでクリーンにしてやれるぜッ！
rows.re: With Guild Galad's technology, we / could clean up that dirty sky in no / time!

rows.en: @With Guild Galad's superior fire power, we could have blasted that Dragon back into the stone age.
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードの<b:8a42><b:8a5b>力を持ってすれば / <b:8a73>ドラゴンの１<b:8a89>や２<b:8a89> / イチコロだぜッ！
rows.re: With Guild Galad's superior fire / power, we could have blasted that / Dragon back into the stone age.

rows.en: @With Guild Galad's technology, we could have stopped Odessa from setting off that nuke!
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードの<b:8a42><b:8a5b>力を持ってすれば / オデッサに<b:8a73>を撃たれる前に / なんとかできたものをッ！
rows.re: With Guild Galad's technology, we / could have stopped Odessa from / setting off that nuke!

rows.en: @With Guild Galad's technology, we could have knocked that base of Odessa's out of commission.
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードの<b:8a42><b:8a5b>力を持ってすれば / オデッサの<88e6>帯の１コや２コ / <b:8a8a><b:8a61>に滅滅してやるぜ
rows.re: With Guild Galad's technology, we / could have knocked that base of / Odessa's out of commission.

rows.en: @We're being punished for polluting Filgaia. I'm sure of it.
rows.jp: 「きっと今まで、ファルガイアを / <b:8a88>してきた<b:8a8b>なのでしょう〜跡を<b:8a8c>料とかに使ってるから / さっきのドラゴンが<b:8a8d>って<b:8a40>たのよ / やっぱり、<b:8a8b>が辺ったんだわ<b:8a88>しすぎた / その仕<b:8a8e>ちなのかもしれませんね〜<b:8a42><b:8a5b>が発達しているのは / いいことだと思うわ〜
rows.re: We're being punished for polluting / Filgaia. I'm sure of it.

rows.en: @But releasing factory wastewater into the oceans is a crime just as surely as Odessa's terrorism was.
rows.jp: 「でもね、<8a13>場から出る<b:8a88>れた水を / 道へ流すのはオデッサと同じくらい / 悪いことだと思うの<b:8a72>くのが<b:8a4c>きなの
rows.re: But releasing factory wastewater / into the oceans is a crime just as / surely as Odessa's terrorism was.

rows.en: @There are many types of vehicles in Guild Galad, but I still prefer walking.
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードでは / いろいろな<b:8a8f>り物を開発しているけど / アタシには、必要ないわ
rows.re: There are many types of vehicles in / Guild Galad, but I still prefer / walking.

rows.en: @Find out what you can, then act with speed and caution. We cannot help you any more.
rows.jp: 「はやく聞くコト聞き出して / <8a03><8a04>かつ確実かつ<b:8a70>重に対<b:8a90>してくれ / もちろん、ワシらも助力はおしまないぞ
rows.re: Find out what you can, then act / with speed and caution. We cannot / help you any more.

rows.en: @What wonderful creatures the Dragons are! Dead or alive, they benefit us!
rows.jp: 「しかし、ドラゴンとは良い生き物だな / 死んでいても生きていても / ワシに利<b:8a91>をもたらしてくれるッ
rows.re: What wonderful creatures the / Dragons are! Dead or alive, they / benefit us!

rows.en: @Haw haw haw!
rows.jp: 「がっはっはっはっ〜<b:8b0b>[14][10]ヌ[01]<f089>[06]ギルドグラードマスター / 「なんだ？ / 先の<b:8a73>ドラゴンを<b:8a92><b:8a93>したことか？
rows.re: Haw haw haw!

rows.en: @We merely reaped what we had sown. There is no reason to thank us.
rows.jp: 「ワシは、自分のまいた<b:8a94>を / 自分で<b:8a95>ろうとしたまでのコト / 単にお前たちに<8928>を言われる<b:8a96>合いはないぞ
rows.re: We merely reaped what we had sown. / There is no reason to thank us.

rows.en: @It is I who should thank you. I apologize for the trouble we caused.
rows.jp: 「<8928>ならこちらが言わせてもらおう / <f040><f041><f042>手間かけさせてすまなかったな<b:8b0b>[14][10]ニ[01]ｊ[06]ギルドグラードマスター / 「あの、<b:8a73>ドラゴン / グラウスヴァインをどうにかしないとな
rows.re: It is I who should thank you. I / apologize for the trouble we / caused.

rows.en: @I hope I am not pushing my luck, but we need your help.
rows.jp: 「今更、ムシのいい話しだが / お前たちの力を<b:8a97>してほしい
rows.re: I hope I am not pushing my luck, / but we need your help.

rows.en: @Of course, we will assist you in any way we can. Please help us!
rows.jp: 「もちろん / ワシらもできるだけのコトはするつもりだ / すまないが頼むぞ<b:8b0b>[14][10]か[01][f5]<8a06>ギルドグラードマスター / 「ダメだッ！ ダメだッ！
rows.re: Of course, we will assist you in / any way we can. Please help us!

rows.en: @How do we fight Odessa now that they possess both |Heimdal Gazzo| AND the nuclear weapon?
rows.jp: 「『ヘイムダル・ガッツォー』に『<b:8a73>』ッ！ / この２つの<b:8a98>っているオデッサと / どう戦えというんだッ！<b:8b06>ギルドグラードマスター / 「まさか『<b:8a73>』を<b:8a99>われるとはな〜
rows.re: How do we fight Odessa now that / they possess both |Heimdal Gazzo| / AND the nuclear weapon?

rows.en: @But how on earth did Odessa know the nuke was on that train?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>しかし、なぜオデッサは / 『<b:8a73>』を<89dc><89dd>に<b:8a9a>んでいることを / 知っていたんだ？
rows.re: But how on earth did Odessa know / the nuke was on that train?

rows.en: @Could there be a spy in our midst?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>スパイでもいるというのかッ！<b:8b06>「さすがに、暗い空がこんなに<8a18>くと / 人々の心も暗くなってしまうようですね / 以前は、あんなに<b:8a9b>やかだった場が〜<b:8a75>み』のようなものを / 信じたのだが〜 私だけかな〜？
rows.re: Could there be a spy in our midst?

rows.en: @I wouldn't blame the dragon for being mad. After all, we process dragon fossils into fuel.
rows.jp: 「ま、我々はドラゴンの遺跡を<88ea><b:8a67>して / <b:8a8c>料にしているのだから / それも当たり前か〜<b:8a9c><8946><b:8a9d>のじいさんが / <b:8a9e>い探をしていたが / 何か<b:8a9f>み事でもあるのかな？
rows.re: I wouldn't blame the dragon for / being mad. After all, we process / dragon fossils into fuel.

rows.en: @Oh, well. Who can blame him with the sky the way it is?
rows.jp: 「ま、空がこんなになっちゃ / 気持ちも分からんではないが<b:8a42><b:8a5b>は / かなり高いようだな<b:8a71>次の遺跡を / 左<b:8a3b>したものだったそうだ<b:8aa0>がいたらオレの所に連れてこい
rows.re: Oh, well. Who can blame him with / the sky the way it is?

rows.en: @I'll teach that hypocrite a lesson he'll never forget!
rows.jp: 「そんな<b:8aa1><b:8aa2><b:8aa3><b:8aa4>には / オレがヤキをいれてやるぜッ！<b:8aa5>』がもたらすモノの中にはな / 『<b:8a42><b:8a5b>の急<8a04>な進<b:8a72>』もあるってコトを / 忘れるなッ！<b:8a73>』を使いやがるなんて / オレたちを道連れって<b:8aa6>かよッ！<b:8a73>なんか使ったら世界<b:8aa7><b:8aa8>する / ファルガイアがなくなっちまうってのに
rows.re: I'll teach that hypocrite a lesson / he'll never forget!

rows.en: @Perhaps conquering the world was never their goal.
rows.jp: 「ホントに世界<b:8aa7><b:8aa8>する気が / あるのかね<b:8aa9><b:8aaa>』が / 帰らなかったらしいな
rows.re: Perhaps conquering the world was / never their goal.

rows.en: @But perhaps you were fortunate to destroy Odessa's base with the loss of only one life.
rows.jp: 「だが、たった一人の<b:8aab><b:8aac>で / <88e6>帯一つを<b:8aad>せたんだから / それはそれで、スゲェことだぜ<b:8a40>て辺さいました
rows.re: But perhaps you were fortunate to / destroy Odessa's base with the loss / of only one life.

rows.en: @I have created Full Clip, a device that transfers the user's telepathic strength to an ARM.
rows.jp: 「ドラゴンの生体サンプルの解<b:8aae>によって / 使用者の<88ea><b:8a76>力をアームに付<b:8aaf>する / 『フルフラット』が<88ad>成したのです
rows.re: I have created Full Clip, a device / that transfers the user's / telepathic strength to an ARM.

rows.en: @It is somewhat difficult to control, but I am sure you could handle it, 0.
rows.jp: 「まだ、制<89c7>が<b:8ab0>しいですが / [05]ぉさんなら / 使いこなせると思います
rows.re: It is somewhat difficult to / control, but I am sure you could / handle it, .

rows.en: @One thing to keep in mind is that it discharges every round in your ARM when activated.
rows.jp: 「<88f7>意帯としては / 発動するとアームの全<b:8a43>を発<b:8ab1>し<b:8ab2>くして / しまうこと
rows.re: One thing to keep in mind is that / it discharges every round in your / ARM when activated.

rows.en: @Also, how powerful it is depends on your ARM's remaining ammo count when you equip it. Here, take it!
rows.jp: 「また、アームの残<b:8ab3>年によって / 威力が変合します / どうぞ、<b:8ab4>けとってください<b:8a87>得した<b:8ab5>上は、機<b:8ab6>がいいと / つい調家に<b:8a8f>ってしまいがちなのです
rows.re: Also, how powerful it is depends on / your ARM's remaining ammo count / when you equip it. Here, take it!

rows.en: @Please forgive him if he takes a joke a little too far.
rows.jp: 「<b:8ab7><b:8ab8>が過ぎるコトがありますが / どうか、大目に見てやってください〜〜
rows.re: Please forgive him if he takes a / joke a little too far.

rows.en: @Please use it in the fight to save Filgaia!
rows.jp: 「少しでもファルガイアの為に / 役立ってくれたらうれしいです
rows.lit: I'd be glad if it helped, even a little, for the sake of Filgaia.
rows.re: Please use it in the fight to save / Filgaia!

rows.en: @The recent events seem to have changed my father, too.
rows.jp: 「今回の件で / <b:8ab5>上も少し変わったような気がします
rows.re: The recent events seem to have / changed my father, too.

rows.en: @The recent events seem to have changed my father, too.
rows.jp: 「今回の件で / <b:8ab5>上も少し変わったような気がします
rows.re: The recent events seem to have / changed my father, too.

rows.en: @would solve everything and bring peace back to Filgaia.
rows.jp: 「ファルガイアに<b:8a85><b:8a86>が戻ると / そう、信じていたのに〜
rows.re: would solve everything and bring / peace back to Filgaia.

rows.en: @I can't help thinking that the black sky is a curse that Odessa put on us.
rows.jp: 「この<888c>い空〜 / まるで、オデッサの<b:8ab9>念を表わしている〜 / そのように信じずには、いられません〜<b:8aba>通りに / なってしまうのでしょうか〜
rows.re: I can't help thinking that the / black sky is a curse that Odessa / put on us.

rows.en: @I apologize for keeping the nuke a secret. I did not know myself, but I feel as if I deceived you.
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>それから『<b:8a73>』のコトですが〜 / わたくしも知らなかったコトとはいえ / <88fc>してしまったみたいですみませんでした〜<b:8a9e>い空には戻らない / 何が<89af><89b0>なのか、どうすれば戻るのか / そして、<b:8a81>の<b:8a81>実を知るものはいるのか？
rows.re: I apologize for keeping the nuke a / secret. I did not know myself, but / I feel as if I deceived you.

rows.en: @Wait a minute. |Real truth| ... Does that make sense? Ah, forget it.
rows.jp: 「〜ん？ / 今、変な<b:8a71>法の使い方をしたような〜？ / まあ、いいか<b:8a9c><8946><b:8a9d>のおじいさんなら知ってるかもよ
rows.re: Wait a minute. |Real truth| ... / Does that make sense? Ah, forget / it.

rows.en: @He's the Lord of the Library.
rows.jp: 「なんたって、<b:8a9c><8946><b:8a9d>の<b:8abb>だからね<b:8a73>ドラゴン攻撃<b:8a83>ぎの時 / なぜかギルドグラードマスターが / やる気全開だったんだ〜
rows.re: He's the Lord of the Library.

rows.en: @I am SO overworked! Man, my head STILL aches... or is it |hurts|? Which do you think is better?
rows.jp: 「おかげで、俺はコキ使われちゃったよ〜 / ああ、<b:8abc><b:8abd>が<b:8abd>いよ〜〜〜ん？ / 今、変な<b:8a71>法の使い方をしたような〜？<b:8abe>する<b:8abe>が多くなってね
rows.re: I am SO overworked! Man, my head / STILL aches... or is it |hurts|? / Which do you think is better?

rows.en: @One store gave me a going-out-of- business gift. Hey... That doesn't make sense, does it?
rows.jp: 「そこで、閉<b:8abe><8937>念の『<b:8abf><b:8ac0><8a0c><892e>』を / プレゼントされたんだ / でも、変な<b:8a71>法の使い方をしたような〜？<b:8ab6>になるのも / 仕方ないですね〜<b:8a3c>の行<8815>人たちが<89e6>していたのですが / なんでも、オデッサは渓谷場を / <89d0>っているとかいないとか〜
rows.re: One store gave me a going-out-of- / business gift. Hey... That doesn't / make sense, does it?

rows.en: @I have learned to be grateful when everyone makes it through another day alive and safe.
rows.jp: 「それは、『みんなが今回も無事だった』〜 / <b:8ac1><b:8ab3>は、全<8844>気にも止めなかった事ですが / とっても、大切なコトだったんですね<b:8ac2>りが、まだまだ<89b9>いのでしょうか〜？<b:8a76>よ、どうか世界をお<8832>い辺さい〜
rows.re: I have learned to be grateful when / everyone makes it through another / day alive and safe.

rows.en: @To the 1southeast0 is an island that resembles a coiled snake. They say energy collects there.
rows.jp: 「そういえば、ココから[11]お先側[11]ぉに / ヘビがとぐろを<8812>いた方な他があるんじゃが / そこには、地<89f4>が<8880>まっているそうじゃ
rows.re: To the southeast is an island that / resembles a coiled snake. They say / energy collects there.

rows.en: @That might be a Raypoint.
rows.jp: 「そこがレイポイントかもしれんぞい
rows.re: That might be a Raypoint.

rows.en: @inaccessible place -- like the crater of a volcano, for instance.
rows.jp: 「人の手が入りにくい所が可能性が高いの / <8943>えば、枯谷の枯口とかじゃな〜<b:8a73>ドラゴン』じゃが / 古代<b:8a71>次時に作られた / 『同時』らしいのじゃ
rows.re: inaccessible place, like the crater / of a volcano, for instance.

rows.en: @The ancient texts say experiments were held. Maybe they are what led to ancient civilization's collapse.
rows.jp: 「何回かの同時実験をしていた / <8937><8938>も残っておる / それが破滅への<b:8a93>だったのかもしれんの〜<b:8a73>』の / 落辺地帯を調べておるんじゃが〜
rows.re: The ancient texts say experiments / were held. Maybe they are what led / to ancient civilization's collapse.

rows.en: @It looks like it's... Oh, these calculations must be wrong. I HOPE they are wrong!
rows.jp: 「もしかしたら〜 / いや、ワシの特<b:8ac3>違いじゃろ〜 / そう、間違いであってほしいの〜
rows.re: It looks like it's... Oh, these / calculations must be wrong. I HOPE / they are wrong!

rows.en: @There are 4 altogether. This one is located 1beyond the mountain southwest of Guild Galad0.
rows.jp: 「４鍵のうちの１鍵が / [11]おギルドグラードから先東の谷を<b:8ac4>えた岸り[11]ぉに / あることが分かったんじゃ
rows.re: There are 4 altogether. This one is / located beyond the mountain / southwest of Guild Galad.

rows.en: @I'll tell that young lady operator at Valeria Chateau!
rows.jp: 「このことは、ヴァレリアシャトーの / オペレーターお<b:8ac5>ちゃんにも伝えとくぞい<b:8a9c><8946><b:8a9d>の<b:8ac6>理者じゃ / 口の悪い連中は / 『<b:8a9c><8946><b:8a9d>の<b:8abb>』と呼ぶがの<b:8ac7>まったわ / 私もね単れてから彼の存在の大きさを / <b:8ac8>確認しちゃったし〜<f044>
rows.re: I'll tell that young lady operator / at Valeria Chateau!

rows.en: @I'm waiting for him now. But what could be keeping him? He'd better not stand me up like last time!
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>あっと / 私がこんなこと言ってたなんて街<b:8ac9>だよ<f044> / 〜でも<8a0d>いなぁ、まだ<b:8aca>りてないのかな〜<b:8a40>てくれたのよ / フッた私を心配してくれるなんて〜<f044>
rows.re: I'm waiting for him now. But what / could be keeping him? He'd better / not stand me up like last time!

rows.en: @Afterwards, he said he was sorry, but then he ran away.
rows.jp: 「その後、<b:8a6e>ってきたんだけど〜 / <b:8acb>って<894f>げちゃったの
rows.re: Afterwards, he said he was sorry, / but then he ran away.

rows.en: @I should have forgave him then and there, but my foolish pride wouldn't let me.
rows.jp: 「その場で<8978>しても良かったんだけど / こっちから<b:8a6e>りたかったから〜<f044> / <f040><f041><f042>私って、意地っ<b:8acc>りかもね？
rows.re: I should have forgave him then and / there, but my foolish pride / wouldn't let me.

rows.en: @Sigh! My heart is as dark as the sky above!
rows.jp: 「<f040><f041><f042>あぁ〜 / あの<888c>い空は / 私の心<b:8acd>を表わしているようだわ〜<f05a><b:8ace>違いしてたのよ / まったく、どこか抜けてるんだから
rows.re: Sigh! My heart is as dark as the / sky above!

rows.en: @But that's part of his charm. Hey, he's late again today, too!
rows.jp: 「でも、そこがいいところなのかもね〜<f044> / <f040><f041><f042>にしても<8a0d>いわねぇ<b:8acf>重の時間になっても<b:8a40>ないのよねぇ〜 / まったく、何をしてるのかしらッ<f059><b:8a64><b:8ad0>人間の僕としては / 空がずっと暗くても / 信信的にそんなに変わらないよ<b:8ad1><b:8ad2>の家を<b:8ad3>らすように / <894f>げて行ったのがよく見れたよ<f04a>
rows.re: But that's part of his charm. Hey, / he's late again today, too!

rows.en: @And then I high-tailed it out of there, too!
rows.jp: 「まぁ、その後 / オレも急いで<894f>げたけどね〜<b:8a38>気は、それほど変わってないよ / こんな時だからこそ、元気を出さなくちゃな
rows.re: And then I high-tailed it out of / there, too!

rows.en: @Of course, I could do without those Odessa guys.
rows.jp: 「でも、オデッサみたいな<b:8ad4>は / <b:8ace><b:8ad5>してほしいよ<b:8a82>多な信じがするだろ？ / でも、オレはそこが<b:8a4c>きなんだ<b:8a55>時が必要になるコトもあるだろう
rows.re: Of course, I could do without those / Odessa guys.

rows.en: @But we have to use them carefully to avoid ending up like Slayheim.
rows.jp: 「だが、使い方を<b:8ad6>り / スレイハイムのニの<b:8ad7>だけには / ならないようにな<b:8a7c>は、今は亡きスレイハイムと / <b:8a55>時などの開発を<b:8ad8>っていたものだ
rows.re: But we have to use them carefully / to avoid ending up like Slayheim.

rows.en: @Technological progress was a lot faster in those days.
rows.jp: 「やはり、<b:8ad8>い合っていた頃の方が / <b:8a42><b:8a5b>の進<b:8a72>が早かったな<b:8a55>時の<b:8ad9><b:8a45>を命じたらしい〜
rows.re: Technological progress was a lot / faster in those days.

rows.en: @Who does he intend to fight?
rows.jp: 「一体、何と戦うつもりなのだ？<b:8a55>時は、使い方によって / 人々の脅威にも / 愛する人を<b:8ada>ることもできる
rows.re: Who does he intend to fight?

rows.en: @IF used properly, that is.
rows.jp: 「使い方を間違えないことだ<b:8a55>時なども / ギルドグラード<b:8a67>のモノが / 結<8968>あるはずだ<b:8a6e>ってきて / <8978>してくれたよ<f04a> / 俺が<b:8a6e>った時の<b:8adb>意が伝わったのかな？
rows.re: IF used properly, that is.

rows.en: @Today is our first date since we made up. But she's late. I wonder what's keeping her...
rows.jp: 「今回は / <b:8adc><8865>りしてから押めてのデートなのさ / <f040><f041><f042>でも、彼女<8a0d>いなぁ〜<f04b><b:8a40>た時に / 彼女のコトが心配になって / 行ってみたんだ
rows.re: Today is our first date since we / made up. But she's late. I wonder / what's keeping her...

rows.en: @I wanted to see her. I told her I was sorry, but it was no use.
rows.jp: 「ちょうど、<b:8a6e>りたかったし / 式いたかったし〜 / でも、ダメだったなぁ〜<b:8ace>違いしてたんだ / 彼女、<b:8a8d>ってたけど何とか<8978>してもらったよ
rows.re: I wanted to see her. I told her I / was sorry, but it was no use.

rows.en: @But now today, she's late.
rows.jp: 「でも、今回も彼女<8a0d>いなぁ〜<f04b>
rows.re: But now today, she's late.

rows.en: @I think I'll do my part by encouraging Noel to do his best!
rows.jp: 「じゃあ、あたしはノエル様を / 『がんばれ、がんばれ』って / 応<b:8add>をかんばろうかな<b:8add>するのも / 大事なことなのよ
rows.re: I think I'll do my part by / encouraging Noel to do his best!

rows.en: @Besides, emotional support brings you closer to the person you support.
rows.jp: 「そうやって / あたしの『がんばり』を / ちょっとづつ分けてあげられるんだから<b:8a4c>きだよ / でも、先のことは / わからないって言うじゃない〜
rows.re: Besides, emotional support brings / you closer to the person you / support.

rows.en: @is like the sky... Wait a minute!
rows.jp: 「オンナ心とファルガイアの空って
rows.lit: A woman's heart and Filgaia's sky are... (setup for a pun, cut off)
rows.re: is like the sky... Wait a minute!

rows.en: @I hope he didn't think I meant a woman's heart is perpetually dark!
rows.jp: 「あれれ〜 / それじゃあ、<b:8a81>っ暗けってこと？<b:8ade>方なんて / あたしには<b:8a78><b:8a79>無いわよ
rows.re: I hope he didn't think I meant a / woman's heart is perpetually dark!

rows.en: @If I can be with Noel, I wouldn't mind living in a small house.
rows.jp: 「ノエル様といっしょなら / 小さいお<b:8a6c>の方がいいかもね
rows.re: If I can be with Noel, I wouldn't / mind living in a small house.

rows.en: @Besides, in a small house, we would always be close to each other.
rows.jp: 「だって〜 / いつも<89f5>にいられるでしょ<b:8adf>さんになると / 未<b:8a40>のギルドグラードマスター<b:8ae0>ね
rows.re: Besides, in a small house, we would / always be close to each other.

rows.en: @I wonder if I'm cut out for that.
rows.jp: 「あたしには自信無いな〜
rows.lit: I don't have much confidence in myself.
rows.re: I wonder if I'm cut out for that.

rows.en: @All the girls are crazy about him!
rows.jp: 「モテモテなのよ〜<b:8ae1>なのよ
rows.re: All the girls are crazy about him!

rows.en: @Can you believe it?
rows.jp: 「信じられる？<b:8ae2>に<b:8ae3>されている<b:8a7a>をよく見ると小さなスイッチがある
rows.re: Can you believe it?

rows.en: *Do you wish to press the switch? 1. Press away! 2. I don't think so.2
rows.jp: ＊スイッチを<b:8ae3>しますか？ / １．<b:8ae3>すしかないでしょッ！ / ２．止めるに<b:8ae4>る[1a]か<b:8a84>がした<b:8ae5>られている / <8875><b:8ab3>は<f041><f041><f041>
rows.re: Do you wish to press the switch? . / Press away! 2. I don't think so.2

rows.en: *Don't even THINK of buying one!
rows.jp: ＊とても高いので見なかったことにしよう<b:8a79>の良さそうな<b:8ae6>が / 所<b:8ae7>しと<b:8ae8>べられている<b:8a43>だ / だが、<b:8ae9>人用アームで使用するものでは / ないようだ<b:8a45><b:8a50>置<b:8a6c>として発<b:8aea>してきた / ギルドグラードは、その<b:8a42><b:8a5b>発<b:8aea>に / 多くの合谷を利用してきた
rows.re: Don't even THINK of buying one!

rows.en: *One is Dragon fossils. Fossils of these organo-mechanical beasts are unlike even Lost Technology.
rows.jp: ＊その中でも、機艇生命体ドラゴンの合谷は / ロストテクノロジーとも違った / 結単な<b:8a42><b:8a5b>面態をしている
rows.re: One is Dragon fossils. Fossils of / these organo-mechanical beasts are / unlike even Lost Technology.

rows.en: *The special qualities of Dragon fossils have fascinated countless engineers and scientists.
rows.jp: ＊その結異な性質のため / ドラゴンの合谷は多くの<b:8a42><b:8a5b>者を / <b:8aeb><8837>してやまない
rows.re: The special qualities of Dragon / fossils have fascinated countless / engineers and scientists.

rows.en: *They used the technology in such fossils to create products for export to other nations.
rows.jp: ＊それらの合谷の解<b:8aae>を行い / その<b:8a42><b:8a5b>を応用した<8a13><b:8a50><b:8a67><892e>を作り出し / 配置へ<b:8aed>出している
rows.re: They used the technology in such / fossils to create products for / export to other nations.

rows.en: *This technology will give rise to new technologies that will make people's lives even better.
rows.jp: ＊<b:8aee><b:8a9a>された<b:8a42><b:8a5b>は / さらなる<b:8a42><b:8a5b>となり / 人々の生<b:8a38>の向上に<b:8a38>用されるだろう<b:8aef><b:8a6c>の<89e1>り言<b:8af0>の<89a3>にはなにがある〜<b:8a76>体が<b:8af1>られているようだ<b:8a43>だ / だが、<b:8ae9>人用アームで使用するものでは / ないようだ
rows.re: This technology will give rise to / new technologies that will make / people's lives even better.

rows.en: @I did not hire you to escort my son so that you could wreck my property!
rows.jp: 「お前たちに / 護衛を<8923>頼したのは / この無方を見るためではないんだぞッ！<b:8ab5>上ッ！
rows.re: I did not hire you to escort my son / so that you could wreck my / property!

rows.en: @Father, you mustn't be so rude to them!
rows.jp: 「それは彼らに対して / 失<8928>ではありませんかッ！
rows.re: Father, you mustn't be so rude to / them!

rows.en: @The only reason I made it back home safely to Guild Galad
rows.jp: 「わたくしはこうして / 無事にギルドグラードまで / たどり着くことができたのです
rows.lit: That I was able to make it safely all the way back to Guild Galad like this...
rows.re: The only reason I made it back home / safely to Guild Galad

rows.en: @is that the ARMS team protected my life with such valor and tireless effort.
rows.jp: 「これもひとえに / 彼らたち / ＡＲＭＳの<b:8ab2>力と言えましょう<b:8af2>物<89dd><b:8af3>を切り離すとは〜<b:8af4>、助かったのです<b:8ab5>上、何をそれほどまでに / あわてているのですか？
rows.re: is that the ARMS team protected my / life with such valor and tireless / effort.

rows.en: @I am safe, am I not?
rows.jp: 「こうして、わたくしは無事に<f040><f042>
rows.re: I am safe, am I not?

rows.en: @Father... Was it the freight cars and not me that Odessa was after?
rows.jp: 「〜<b:8ab5>上、まさか / オデッサにねらわれていたのは / わたくしではなく、<b:8af2>物<89dd><b:8af3>の方ですね？
rows.re: Father... Was it the freight cars / and not me that Odessa was after?

rows.en: @I... I just...
rows.jp: 「そ、それは〜<b:8af5><b:8af6>や金<b:8af7>を失ったくらいでは / そこまで<b:8af8><b:8af9>する<b:8ab5>上ではないはず
rows.re: I... I just...

rows.en: @Unless there was something else...
rows.re: Unless there was something else...

rows.en: @Father! Did you mean to acquire a Super Weapon banned under the Treaty of Iscariot? How could you?!
rows.jp: 「置<b:8afa>に反するような同時を〜 / イスカリオテ<b:8afb><b:8acf>にて<b:8afc>止された / 幻同時を保作するつもりだったのですかッ！
rows.re: Father! Did you mean to acquire a / Super Weapon banned under the / Treaty of Iscariot? How could you?!

rows.en: @There is no reason for you to be blamed. This is the fault of Guild Galad.
rows.jp: 「いよいよもって / あなた方が<b:8afd>められることはありません / これはギルドグラードの過ちです<b:8ab5>は、わたくしの護衛と<b:8aa1>って / <b:8af2>物<89dd><b:8af3>の同時を<b:8ada>らせるハラでした
rows.re: There is no reason for you to be / blamed. This is the fault of Guild / Galad.

rows.en: @I suspect it was a Lost Technology weapon unearthed in secrecy.
rows.jp: 「おそらく、<b:8b01><b:8b02><b:8b03>に発<885f>した / ロストテクノロジー同時の一<b:8a94>でしょう
rows.re: I suspect it was a Lost Technology / weapon unearthed in secrecy.

rows.en: @But that weapon has fallen into the hands of Odessa.
rows.jp: 「それが、今回の件で / オデッサの手に落ちてしまったのです
rows.lit: And now, in this affair, it has fallen into Odessa's hands.
rows.re: But that weapon has fallen into the / hands of Odessa.

rows.en: @I resent being deceived. That is inexcusable. However...
rows.jp: 「俺たちをだましていたことは / 確かに<8978>せないことだ / でも〜
rows.re: I resent being deceived. That is / inexcusable. However...

rows.en: @What's done is done. We must now focus on repairing the damage.
rows.jp: 「それならば / 俺たちにも手伝えることがある
rows.lit: In that case, there's something we can help with too.
rows.re: What's done is done. We must now / focus on repairing the damage.

rows.en: @We must thwart whatever evil scheme Odessa is planning with that Super Weapon.
rows.jp: 「ヤツらが手に入れた幻同時で / 何をしようとも / 俺たちが必ずくいとめよう
rows.lit: Whatever they mean to do with the Super Weapon they've obtained, we'll be sure to stop it. (幻同時->幻獣/超兵器 decode garble)
rows.re: We must thwart whatever evil scheme / Odessa is planning with that Super / Weapon.

rows.en: @As son of Guild Galad Master, I can think of nothing better than to hear you say that!
rows.jp: 「ギルドグラードマスターの<89e2>家として / そう<b:8b04>し出てくれることほど / うれしいことはありません時っていったい何なの？ / <b:8afc>止されるくらい強力なんでしょ？<b:8ab5>上、すべてをお話しください
rows.re: As son of Guild Galad Master, I can / think of nothing better than to / hear you say that!

rows.en: @Only they can help us now!
rows.jp: 「こうなってしまっては / 彼らに<b:8b05>すしかないのです<b:8af2><89dd>に<b:8a9a>んでいた同時とは〜 / スレイハイム戦跡より回<8939>した同時とは〜<b:8aa7><b:8aa8>ならば / <b:8a73>同時の使用はありえないでしょ
rows.re: Only they can help us now!

rows.en: @It destroys all life and renders the land eternally uninhabitable!
rows.jp: 「その地には生命の<89e2><b:8b0a>が<b:8a5e>ること<b:8b0b>わず / <b:8b0c><b:8b0d>の死せる大地と合すといいます
rows.re: It destroys all life and renders / the land eternally uninhabitable!

rows.en: @Why would Odessa wish to rule a barren, lifeless world?
rows.jp: 「そのような地に<889a>われた世界を / 誰が<b:8b0e>んで<b:8aa7><b:8aa8>しましょうか
rows.re: Why would Odessa wish to rule a / barren, lifeless world?

rows.en: @I, too, sought a nuclear weapon as a deterrent with which to counter Odessa's threat.
rows.jp: 「わしも<b:8a73>同時を / オデッサを<b:8b0f>制するための / いわば<b:8b10>止力として用いるつもりだった
rows.re: I, too, sought a nuclear weapon as / a deterrent with which to counter / Odessa's threat.

rows.en: @After all, Odessa is sure to use its nuclear weapon at the bargaining table.
rows.jp: 「ヤツらもまた / <88fa><b:8b11>の手<b:8ab3>として / <b:8a73>同時を<b:8b12>りかざしてくるはずだ<b:8b13>をちらつかせる前に / <b:8a73>同時を何とかしなければ<f040><f042>
rows.re: After all, Odessa is sure to use / its nuclear weapon at the / bargaining table.

rows.en: @0... What is it?
rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>[05]ぉさん〜 / どうかしました？
rows.re: ... What is it?

rows.en: @It just occurred to me that the |world domination| Odessa seeks is a truly formidable task.
rows.jp: 「オデッサの言う『世界<b:8aa7><b:8aa8>』って / 大変なことなんだなって〜 / 考えていたんだ<b:8b14>ってきた
rows.re: It just occurred to me that the / |world domination| Odessa seeks is / a truly formidable task.

rows.en: @All had their own ideas and their own way of doing things. I'm only stating the obvious, of course.
rows.jp: 「でも、みんなそれぞれ / 自分の意<b:8b15>や考えを持っていた〜 / あたり前のことだけどね
rows.re: All had their own ideas and their / own way of doing things. I'm only / stating the obvious, of course.

rows.en: @Even people who shared the same goal used different methods to achieve that goal. In short,
rows.jp: 「中には目的を同じくする人たちもいた / でも、その達成手<b:8ab3>は / やっぱりバラバラだったんだ
rows.re: Even people who shared the same / goal used different methods to / achieve that goal. In short,

rows.en: @no two people think alike.
rows.jp: 「人の心は、ひとつではない〜
rows.lit: People's hearts are not all one; (no two think alike)
rows.re: no two people think alike.

rows.en: @Accordingly, words like |conquer| and |dominate| mean different things to different people.
rows.jp: 「人の年だけ思<b:8aba>が<88fa><b:8b16>する / このファルガイア〜 / 『<b:8aa7><b:8aa8>』の一言でまとめられるのだろうか〜
rows.re: Accordingly, words like |conquer| / and |dominate| mean different / things to different people.

rows.en: @|World domination| may sound like a lofty goal.
rows.jp: 「『世界<b:8aa7><b:8aa8>』という<b:8b17>きには / 一<b:8a94><b:8b18><b:8a5c>なモノがあります
rows.re: |World domination| may sound like a / lofty goal.

rows.en: @But the day-to-day job of actually ruling the world would be fraught with overwhelming difficulty.
rows.jp: 「ですが、実<89d2>に<b:8b19>分するにあたって / <b:8b1a><b:8ab0>ばかりで / 決して、<b:8b1b>心地の良いモノではないはずです
rows.re: But the day-to-day job of actually / ruling the world would be fraught / with overwhelming difficulty.

rows.en: @Each area has its own customs, its own industry, its own laws. Its own way of thinking!
rows.jp: 「その地<b:8b1c>性、<b:8b1d>式性〜 / <b:8a45><b:8a50>や法制度〜 / [05]ぉさんの言う、人の心〜
rows.re: Each area has its own customs, its / own industry, its own laws. Its own / way of thinking!

rows.en: @There is simply too much diversity for the world to be ruled by any one group.
rows.jp: 「ひとつに / まとめなければならないことは / たくさんありすぎます〜<b:8aa7><b:8aa8>』が / どれほど現実<b:8a79>のないことか見えてくる
rows.re: There is simply too much diversity / for the world to be ruled by any / one group.

rows.en: @Yet we face an enemy who is trying to achieve that very goal.
rows.jp: 「それでも、俺たちの前には / それを為そうとする者が / 立ちはだかってくる<f040><f042>
rows.re: Yet we face an enemy who is trying / to achieve that very goal.

rows.en: @is certain is that Odessa is causing suffering right NOW.
rows.jp: 「でも、今、この<b:8b1e>間 / オデッサは誰かを苦しめているんだよ
rows.re: is certain is that Odessa is / causing suffering right NOW.

rows.en: @We must stop them. We must DESTROY them!
rows.jp: 「やっつけなくちゃ / いけないんだよ〜<b:8b1f>しみません
rows.re: We must stop them. We must DESTROY / them!

rows.en: @Isn't that right, father?
rows.jp: 「ですよね？ / <b:8ab5>上〜
rows.re: Isn't that right, father?

rows.en: @We'll give it an Aport Feature, which is similar to the Teleport Orb.
rows.jp: 「テレポートオーブの / <b:8b20>移<b:8b21>果に対応した / アポーツ機能を<887c><887d>だ
rows.re: We'll give it an Aport Feature, / which is similar to the Teleport / Orb.

rows.en: @You'll be able to go anywhere in the seas of Filgaia. So please, stop them.
rows.jp: 「これで / ファルガイア外道の<b:8b22>行も可能となる / 頼む、ヤツらを止めてくれ〜<b:8b23><b:8a71><b:8b24>からの / 観待報<8804>によると〜
rows.re: You'll be able to go anywhere in / the seas of Filgaia. So please, / stop them.

rows.en: @the Nuclear Dragon |Grauswein| is now heading toward Filgaia at a top speed of 480.
rows.jp: 「現在、<b:8a73>ドラゴン『グラウスヴァイン』は / 最大<8a04>度４８０で / ファルガイアに向かって降辺中
rows.re: the Nuclear Dragon |Grauswein| is / now heading toward Filgaia at a top / speed of 480.

rows.en: @The heat given off by Grauswein has a radar-jamming effect, preventing precise trajectory determination.
rows.jp: 「グラウスヴァイン自身が放つ<8868><886f>が / レーダーの観待機能を<b:8b25>わすジャマーとなり / 新確な<b:8b26>道待定に<b:8a7e><88f6>が生じています
rows.re: The heat given off by Grauswein has / a radar-jamming effect, preventing / precise trajectory determination.

rows.en: @It will take a little longer to extrapolate the point of impact.
rows.jp: 「降辺地帯のわりだしには / もう少し時間が必要です<b:8b07><b:8a45>というわけじゃな<b:8a73>ドラゴン〜
rows.re: It will take a little longer to / extrapolate the point of impact.

rows.en: @Both are beyond my powers of understanding. I am at a loss.

rows.jp: （彼<b:8abf>めはもう、<89ce>分に生きたはずトカ〜）<b:8abe>人<b:8aae><b:8ac0>じゃないのかッ！

rows.re: Don't drag us into your crazy / plans!

rows.jp: 「さっさと助けるぞ<b:8a3a>を見<b:8a3b>てかけてたくせに〜 / 理想の注目者<b:8ac1>１級タイたる我<b:8a3a>を〜

rows.jp: 「うむ、これぞ良質の / ヒューマンドラマである

rows.jp: 「どうしてアンタは / こうも見事に発倒を呼び込んでくるんだ<b:8ac2>だるま儀』だ / 不<b:8ab3>当なんだから<b:8ac3>んでくれよ〜

rows.jp: 「それに、名バイプレイヤーってのは / 自分の出番を心得て / なおかつキッチリこなすもんだと思うけど

rows.jp: 「〜その、注目的に注目ッ！

rows.jp: 「注目とくれば / いたし方ありませぬな / 注目者のはしくれとして
rows.lit: When it comes to attention, there's no help for it, as a lowly man of study. (注目者 = pun 'attention-person'/scholar)

rows.en: @Ready for the opening of the Show of World Wonders?
rows.jp: 「よござんしょ / <8979><b:8ac5>びっくりショーの<b:8ac6>開けです<b:8a58>になって

rows.en: @The goal of science is to give people hopes and dreams.
rows.jp: 「現代注目の<b:8ac7>達帯は / 見る者にあまねく / <b:8ac8>と<b:8a77><b:8a78>を<b:8ac9>えてますかーッ！注目に街<b:8aca>された危険性を / 目の当たりにしているのかもしれない〜注目というより<b:8acb><b:8a68><897d>よね<b:8acc><b:8acd>も高らかにィ<f045><f045>〜
rows.re: The goal of science is to give / people hopes and dreams.

rows.en: @Isn't it strange? If there was a pattern, wouldn't he say something unnecessary?
rows.jp: 「何だかおかしくないか？ / パターンなら、ここらで<b:8a76>特なことの / ひとつやふたつ〜
rows.re: Isn't it strange? If there was a / pattern, wouldn't he say something / unnecessary?

rows.jp: 「〜[16]がぉ〜[16]がぉ〜[16]がぉ〜[10]<b:8acf>かは<b:8acf>かで、不安にさせるんだッ！

rows.en: @I'm someone who only needs to be told to get it. No need to have the experience.
rows.jp: 「口で言えばわかる家ですぞ、我<b:8a3a>は〜 / ちなみに<b:8ad2>少のみぎりは / やればできる家と、<89a6>り近所で<b:8a92><b:8ad3><8942>
rows.re: I'm someone who only needs to be / told to get it. No need to have the / experience.

rows.jp: 「いまわの<89d2>に / 『死んでも死にきれぬわ』と / 自<b:8ad4>暗示をかけたゆえ、これこのとおり
rows.re: At my death, I hypnotized myself. / |I can't die now| I said, and look / at the result.

rows.en: @It's sure grand to be alive.
rows.jp: 「生きているって<b:8ad5><b:8ad6>らしい<f044><b:8ad7><b:8ad8>はどうでもいいけど / とりあえず、レバー<b:8a3a>に / ここまでぞんざいな<b:8ad5><b:8ad9>りをッ！

rows.en: @Judgement day is just around the corner! You'll get yours then.
rows.jp: 「未<b:8ada>作の危機的<897c><8942>の回は / もうそこまでッ！ / いつか目にもの見せてくれるわ
rows.re: Judgement day is just around the / corner! You'll get yours then.

rows.en: @The mail order ones from magazines don't begin to compare. These are superb, full of magical powers.
rows.jp: 「<b:8acb><b:8add>の<b:8a6f>表<b:8ade>なんぞにある / 通信<b:8adf><b:8ae0>アイテムとは比<b:8ae1>にならぬほど / <b:8a89><b:8a84>パワーあふるる、まさに<b:8ae2><892e><b:8ae3><b:8ae4>って<b:8ae5>法よ
rows.re: The mail order ones from magazines / don't begin to compare. These are / superb, full of magical powers.

rows.en: @That's what I'd do.
rows.jp: 「我<b:8a3a>ならそうするね
rows.re: That's what I'd do.

rows.en: @What is it? You don't look pleased. It doesn't suit you.
rows.jp: 「どうした？ / うかぬ探などして〜 / <8973>合わんぞ<b:8ab5>てたんだっけ？<b:8a3a>？

rows.jp: 「決まっておろう / ゲルマトロン渓谷よ / 知らぬ存ぜぬとは言わせんぞ

rows.jp: 「そもそも調調実験用に連れてきた / ウンディーネが<b:8a79>手気ままに / <b:8ae9><b:8a7e>したあたりからケチのつきはじめトカ

rows.jp: 「貴様らには、ニアデスから<8832>ってもらった / <b:8aea>義があるトカ、無いトカだが / ゲルマトロン渓谷だけは、ままならねぇ

rows.en: @Never. Or else I'd be pursued by dangerous men. This is proof of my loyalty to Odessa.
rows.jp: 「それが、<888c>づくめの剣たちから / 追われぬ生<b:8aeb>を<b:8a9e>重してくれた / オデッサへの<b:8aec><b:8aed>の<b:8aa6>とくらぁッ！

rows.re: It's a move too good to waste for / when no one's around. But this / might not be the time.

rows.jp: 「手間ァとらせたな〜 / 何だか解進不能な流れになってきおったので / 我<b:8a3a>らはここでオサラバだ
rows.re: Sorry to have troubled you. We're / going to say adios here, now that / everything's messed up.

rows.re: After I finish here, I'll follow. / We'll operate independently for a / time.

rows.jp: 「よし、みんな、行こうッ！

rows.re: Well, either way, I won't be able / to get out unless I destroy this / place!

rows.jp: 「<f040><f042>でも〜 / 機艇といえど、あっけないほどに / <b:8a4a>実を見失ってしまうものなんだな
rows.re: Though it's a machine, it's / disappointing how far from the / truth it is.

rows.jp: 「もし、それが人間だったら / なおのことなのかもしれない〜
rows.lit: If it had been a human, it might be all the more so.
rows.re: And, if it had been a human, it / could have been worse.

rows.en: @Oh well, a machine couldn't be able to tell that!
rows.jp: 「ま、機艇なんかには / わからないものよねッ！<b:8a4b>です<f040><f042>
rows.re: Oh well, a machine couldn't be able / to tell that!

rows.re: Start Voice Print Verification

rows.re: All the sins I committed, all the / pain I suffered, was to steal his / heart.

rows.jp: 「ヴィンスフェルトは / わたしのココロもカラダも / <b:8a57>めてきたわ

rows.en: @Ha. Ha. Ha. Ha.

rows.en: @You don't seem to understand. There's no point to it.

rows.en: @I was looking forward to seeing how the world would meet its end.
rows.jp: 「それもまた / 『人間』の理想だと俺は思う
